jobs.description:
Job Title: Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE)Job Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Top SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:


CACI is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity / Information Assurance (IA) professional to support Navy Medicine Online (NMO) and its mission-critical information systems.


Working collaboratively with the NMO Information System Security Manager (ISSM), Information System Security Officer (ISSO), and government cybersecurity stakeholders, you will help assess, strengthen, and maintain the security posture of multiple computing environments. This position will conduct and review technical security assessments, identify vulnerabilities, threat vectors, potential threat actors, and areas of non-compliance with established cybersecurity and Information Assurance requirements, and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.


You will support the development, implementation, and documentation of formal cybersecurity programs, policies, procedures, and controls while monitoring ongoing compliance. The role will actively support the Risk Management Framework (RMF) process in accordance with Defense Health Agency (DHA) requirements, including Annual Security Reviews (ASRs), Authority to Operate (ATO) activities, and Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) reviews.


Artificial Intelligence (AI) is also an important component of this environment. You will leverage approved AI capabilities to enhance cybersecurity activities, automation, analysis, and operational efficiency while partnering with the ISSM and ISSO teams to help maintain the security posture of AI-assisted development across NMO.


Responsibilities:


  • Conduct and review technical security assessments across multiple computing environments to identify vulnerabilities, threat vectors, security risks, and non-compliance with applicable cybersecurity standards and requirements.
  • Support the implementation and ongoing execution of the Risk Management Framework (RMF), including security control assessments, documentation, remediation activities, and continuous monitoring.
  • Support Annual Security Reviews (ASRs), Authority to Operate (ATO) activities, and IV&V assessments in accordance with DHA, NIST, and applicable Department of Defense cybersecurity requirements.
  • Develop, implement, maintain, and document cybersecurity policies, procedures, controls, and formal security programs.
  • Evaluate identified vulnerabilities and security risks and recommend practical mitigation and remediation strategies.
  • Support vulnerability management, penetration testing, security assessments, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), incident response, and Zero Trust security initiatives.
  • Evaluate network architectures, protocols, firewalls, IDS/IPS technologies, encryption solutions, cloud environments, and associated security vulnerabilities.
  • Partner with ISSMs, ISSOs, system administrators, developers, engineers, and government stakeholders to maintain and continuously improve system security.
  • Leverage approved AI platforms, models, programming, and scripting capabilities to support cybersecurity analysis, automation, documentation, and operational activities.
  • Assess cybersecurity considerations associated with AI-assisted software development and help ensure AI-enabled solutions are implemented in accordance with established security requirements.
  • Participate in cybersecurity incident response activities, including analysis, documentation, remediation, and recommendations for preventing recurrence.
  • Prepare and maintain security documentation, assessment results, findings, remediation plans, and other cybersecurity artifacts required to support compliance and authorization activities.
  • Communicate cybersecurity risks, findings, recommendations, and remediation requirements clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Professional cybersecurity certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, or a comparable industry-recognized certification.
  • Experience conducting Annual Security Reviews (ASRs), IV&V activities, or comparable security assessments using NIST frameworks and cybersecurity standards.
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF), security authorization, assessment, compliance, or continuous monitoring activities.
  • Experience with vulnerability management, security assessments, penetration testing, Data Loss Prevention (DLP) best practices, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Strong knowledge of network architectures and protocols, firewalls, IDS/IPS technologies, encryption, and associated vulnerabilities.
  • Familiarity with cloud security concepts, controls, and best practices.
  • Experience assessing cybersecurity risks and developing or implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Proficiency with AI platforms and models, including experience applying AI and programming or scripting capabilities to automation, analysis, or technical workflows.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity incident response methodologies and practices.
  • Demonstrated analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate cybersecurity concepts and risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams while also working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Active Top Secret security clearance required.

Desired

  • Familiarity with Search Processing Language (SPL), Microsoft Visio, eMASS, ALM, and Confluence.
  • Prior experience supporting the U.S. Navy, Defense Health Agency (DHA), Bureau of Medicine and Surgery (BUMED), Department of Defense, or other military organizations.
  • Experience supporting Navy Medicine operations and mission environments.
  • Knowledge or experience related to Individual and Unit Readiness, medical waiver processing, and Global Health Engagements.
  • Experience securing or assessing AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted development environments, or emerging technologies within regulated or government environments.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

You'll work on systems at the heart of Upstart's lending marketplace. The software your team builds determines how borrowers are matched with capital, how offers are constructed, and how marketplace decisions are executed in real time. It's an opportunity to solve challenging distributed systems problems while building software with direct, measurable impact on borrowers, investors, and the business.

jobs.title: Sr. Federal Channel Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Keyfactor Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI.
jobs.description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Sr. Federal Channel Account Manager

Location: United States, DC, VA, MD (Remote)

Experience: Senior Level

Job Function: Channel

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel: 40-60%

Industry: Computer and Network Security

About the position

Keyfactor is seeking an experienced, high-performing Federal Channel Manager to lead, develop, and scale our indirect sales ecosystem within the U.S. Federal Government sector. Keyfactor is the market leader in PKI, CLM, and Quantum Readiness — securing connection keys, certificates, and cryptographic assets for the world's most demanding organizations.
This role exists to own and grow Keyfactor's relationships with the Value-Added Resellers (VARs) and Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs) that federal agencies already buy through. You will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge enterprise cybersecurity and complex public-sector procurement, managing the two-tier distribution relationships — VAR, FSI, and specialized federal distributor. Your primary objective is to deepen those partner relationships to the point where Keyfactor is the default PKI/CLM/PQC answer inside every major government modernization initiative they touch.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

• VAR & FSI Relationship Management (Primary Focus): Serve as Keyfactor's senior relationship owner for our federal VAR and FSI network. Build multi-threaded relationships across capture, contracts, sales, and technical teams at major FSIs (e.g., IBM, Booz Allen Hamilton) and premier public-sector VARs/distributors (e.g., Carahsoft, Norseman, Merlin, WWT and several others). Run a disciplined cadence of QBRs, joint planning sessions, and executive check-ins to keep Keyfactor top-of-mind as these partners shape agency solutions.
• Partner Strategy & Business Planning: Build, maintain, and execute joint business plans with each strategic VAR and FSI, with clear shared targets for pipeline, bookings, and named-account coverage.
• Revenue & Pipeline Generation: Drive predictable SaaS and on-premises software revenue growth through the VAR/FSI channel to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas, with VAR/FSI-sourced and influenced pipeline tracked as a distinct, reportable category.
• Contract Vehicle Alignment: Ensure Keyfactor solutions are easily accessible by federal agencies by aligning VAR and FSI sales activity with primary contract vehicles (e.g., GSA Schedules, SEWP), and by making sure the right partner is positioned on the right vehicle for each opportunity.
• Partner Enablement & Co-Selling: Deliver product positioning, market strategy, and compliance training to VAR and FSI sales and technical teams. Work directly with partner reps day-to-day to co-sell and position Keyfactor within active government deals — this is a hands-on, in-the-deal relationship, not a periodic check-in.
• Deal Capture & RFP Management: Collaborate closely with VAR/FSI capture teams, internal federal field sales directors, and sales engineers to identify, qualify, and win federal RFPs and bids, including shaping requirements language with FSI partners ahead of formal solicitation where appropriate.
• Channel Conflict & Governance: Manage deal registration, partner-of-record decisions, and channel conflict across a multi-VAR, multi-FSI environment so partners trust Keyfactor as a fair and predictable channel partner.
• Sales Forecasting: Maintain accurate and timely VAR/FSI partner pipeline data within CRM systems, leveraging structured sales qualification methodologies.

Minimum Experience

• Experience: 5+ years of proven software channel management or indirect sales experience specifically focused on the U.S. Federal Government ecosystem (DoD, Intelligence, and Civilian agencies), with demonstrated success building and scaling relationships with federal VARs/distributors and FSIs/prime contractors specifically — not generalist channel experience.
• Two-Tier Distribution Fluency: Deep, practical knowledge of the federal two-tier distribution model and how VARs, aggregators, and FSIs each make money, make decisions, and choose which vendors to champion.
• Cyber Security Expertise: Strong foundation in IT security infrastructure, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), cryptography, or cloudnative security.
• Procurement Acumen: In-depth knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and the federal capture process.
• Sales Methodology: Fluency in enterprise sales execution frameworks such as MEDDPICC or MEDDIC.
• Communication: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence executive-level stakeholders inside partner organizations, not just within Keyfactor.

Preferred
• Location: Based in the Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia, or Maryland (DMV) metro area to facilitate regular on-site VAR and FSI partner collaboration.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. 

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.

Keyfactor Privacy Notice

Job description:
You are passionate about the travel industry, enjoy problem-solving, and share our common goal: to help our customers plan and book luxury travel with ease. Join Chase Travel and help us build the future of travel while taking your career to new heights!

As a Travel Advisor, you will support both internal and external customers with questions related to travel reservations and more complex situations. Demonstrating problem-solving skills and functioning as a service specialist, you will take the necessary steps to recognize, research, and resolve issues through diagnosis and discussion of a particular problem, with a focus on delivering service excellence. You will proactively work with external providers to negotiate an appropriate resolution and minimize costs in a timely manner, while ensuring a seamless customer experience.

Job responsibilities:

  • Respond to customer inquiries related to travel arrangements and resolve issues by focusing on short- and long-term fixes, serving as both a company and customer advocate, and applying root-cause resolution tactics.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to troubleshoot, learn, and deliver timely resolutions, with a high regard for accuracy.
  • Maintain knowledge of all client programs, products, and procedures, and support various online booking tools and multiple websites.
  • Effectively negotiate with vendors and external customers to reach an acceptable resolution for all parties, including issues with loyalty points, redemptions, program exceptions, and fee waivers.
  • Maintain high levels of call quality based on outlined criteria; maintain an appropriate level of confidentiality regarding information shared and observed. Keep your immediate supervisor fully informed of all issues or unusual matters of significance and take prompt corrective action where necessary, or provide suggestions for alternative courses of action.
  • Assist other Travel Advisors in real time with questions related to traveler policies and different booking applications; coach Advisors on best practices for servicing all customers; monitor and manage agent errors, escalations, and customer exceptions; and update tracking information in a database.
  • Provide a professional level of energy and enthusiasm, as well as strong working relationships, when partnering with internal and external customers and all departments to increase quality and customer service levels.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Two or more years of experience in the travel industry, including intermediate to advanced knowledge/proficiency of the Global Distribution System (GDS) and/or other technology platforms, including self-booking tools.
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills to manage internal and external customer issues.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office programs such as Excel, Word, and Outlook; ability to quickly learn technical concepts.
  • Excellent time management and multitasking ability, including advanced knowledge/proficiency using multiple screens in an online environment.
  • Ability to work independently, while also functioning as a team member.

Work schedules will vary. Candidates must be willing to work during our operating hours, which include evenings and weekends. Specific information will be provided by the recruiter. jobs.description:
Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

The Client Delivery Coordinator is an essential support role on the Client Delivery team, focused on assisting with the setup and execution of lead generation programs. Working under the guidance of Client Delivery Managers and Team Leads, the CDC helps ensure accurate and timely lead delivery while learning the tools, systems, and processes that drive high-quality client fulfillment.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career to develop operational and client support skills in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. As a foundational member of the team, the Client Delivery Coordinator will gain hands-on experience with internal systems, file delivery processes, and cross-functional collaboration while being coached toward increased ownership over time.

Employment Level:Entry Level

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines

Working Hours: 9PM to 6AM PHT (Apr - Oct) or 10PM to 7AM PHT (Nov - Mar)

What you'll do

Lead Delivery Support

  • Preparing and sending lead files to clients via CSV uploads, platform submissions, or pre-configured templates.
  • Completing basic portal uploads and fulfillment-related administrative tasks.
  • Monitor lead and QA statuses for assigned programs and flag errors, duplicates, or other issues that could affect delivery.
  • Monitor assigned delivery schedules, pacing, and upcoming due dates, and promptly escalate potential delays or fulfillment risks

Program Setup & Tracking

  • Support the initial setup of programs and delivery systems using internal tools.
  • Update records, documentation, and tracking details in Salesforce and other internal platforms.
  • Send and validate test leads for new and existing integrations using established procedures, escalating errors for troubleshooting.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Respond to internal questions and client requests in a timely and professional manner.
  • Collaborate closely with Client Delivery Managers, Team Leads, and Channel Strategy partners to support daily operations.
  • Participate in team meetings, trainings, and quality reviews to learn and improve.

Learning & Development

  • Receive training in lead delivery processes, tools, and systems.
  • Shadow experienced team members to build expertise in program setup, pacing, and troubleshooting.
  • Actively seek feedback and coaching to build confidence and technical proficiency.

Who you are

  • Agile professional who excels in a fast-paced environment and thrives on continuously pivoting strategies to drive business needs forward.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace (Excel, Google Sheets)
  • Experience in customer support, operations, project coordination, or administrative work.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
  • Experience working with spreadsheets, CSV files, or data management.
  • Must have a working laptop/pc and internet and a backup connection.

**The duties and responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is in general terms and are not definitive. The job holder is expected to accept any reasonable alterations that may from time to time be necessary. **

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 14 days of annual paid time off, plus all regular Philippine government-declared holidays to unwind and recharge. Plus 5 additional days after 1 year.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Full enrollment in Philippine statutory benefits: SSS, PhilHealth, and HDMF.
  • Healthcare: Corporate HMO Plan for all full-time PH employees upon completion of two months of tenure.
  • De Minimis Allowance: Enjoy a monthly rice subsidy, following government guidelines.
  • Wellness Perks: Access the Headspace app to support your well-being.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.

Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Philippines at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the Philippines throughout their employment with our company.

Salary Range
We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.

Monthly Pay Range
₱32,500—₱42,500 PHP

EOE statement

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.excerpt: ITRI – Program Manager, Translational Research Centres About ITRIIndia's Translational Research Initiative (ITRI) is a Section 8 company dedicated to accelerating the translation of research into technologies, products and societal impact.
jobs.description:
ITRI – Program Manager, Translational Research Centres

About ITRI

India's Translational Research Initiative (ITRI) is a Section 8 company dedicated to accelerating the translation of research into technologies, products and societal impact. ITRI works with leading academic institutions, industry and the innovation ecosystem to establish and strengthen Translational Research Centres (TRCs) that bridge the gap between laboratory research and commercialization.

ITRI supports the design, operationalisation and growth of TRCs by building governance frameworks, operational capabilities, industry partnerships and sustainable operating models that enable research institutions to translate scientific excellence into real-world outcomes.

About the Role

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Program Manager will be responsible for driving the successful operationalisation and performance of a portfolio of 2–5 Translational Research Centres (TRCs).

The role is focused on ensuring that approved TRCs successfully transition from concept to execution and deliver their agreed Phase 1 outcomes. Working closely with Principal Investigators, TRC leadership teams and Operations Heads, the Program Manager will establish governance mechanisms, drive execution, monitor performance and ensure timely resolution of operational challenges.

Beyond supporting the assigned TRCs, the Program Manager will play a key role in building ITRI's institutional capability by developing programme management frameworks, operational metrics, review mechanisms, dashboards and data systems that can be replicated across future TRCs. This is a highly collaborative role combining programme management, operational excellence, stakeholder management and ecosystem engagement.

Key Responsibilities

1. TRC Operationalisation

  • Lead the operationalisation of assigned TRCs from agreement through Phase 1 implementation.
  • Drive execution against agreed milestones, timelines and operational objectives.
  • Establish programme governance, operating rhythms and review mechanisms.
  • Identify execution bottlenecks and work with TRC lead to resolve them.
  • Support to enable that each TRC is positioned to achieve its agreed Phase 1 outcomes.

2. Programme Governance & Performance Management

  • Conduct weekly and fortnightly programme reviews with the TRC Lead. Enable the lead to schedule other planned reviews
  • Monitor programme milestones, budgets, staffing, risks and dependencies.
  • Ensure timely closure of action items and escalations.
  • Track programme health and recommend corrective actions where required.
  • Implement structured governance and reporting mechanisms across assigned TRCs.
  • Implement data capture, reporting and review systems across TRCs.

3. Industry & Innovation Ecosystem Engagement

  • Through ITRI, engage with industry, start-ups and incubators to understand technology needs and identify problem statements that can be addressed through the TRCs.
  • Support the TRC lead in the development of a pipeline of industry-led translational projects.
  • Facilitate collaboration between external stakeholders and TRC teams in alignment with ITRI's priorities.

4. Performance Metrics & Operational Excellence

  • Implement operational KPIs and KRAs for assigned TRCs and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Provide data for creating dashboards and programme review frameworks.
  • Monitor operational, technical and ecosystem performance.
  • Support continuous improvement through structured reviews and performance analysis.
  • Work with the COO to define portfolio-level operational metrics for ITRI.

5. ITRI Capability Building

Working closely with the COO, the Program Manager will contribute to building ITRI's long-term institutional capability by:

  • Developing programme management frameworks and playbooks and support in designing standard operating procedures and templates.
  • Help standardise governance and operational processes across TRCs, while ensuring consistency in governance, reporting, operational excellence and delivery across TRCs.
  • Capturing cross-TRC learnings to enable translation into reusable institutional knowledge.
  • Manage a portfolio of 2–5 TRCs simultaneously - Act as the primary programme coordination interface between ITRI and the assigned TRCs.
  • Escalate strategic issues and institutional decisions to the COO as appropriate.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for individuals who enjoy building organisations, managing complex programmes and working at the intersection of research, technology and execution. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable engaging with scientists and engineers, reviewing programme execution, and translating technical discussions into actionable operational plans.

Typical profiles may include professionals with 5–7 years of experience in:

  • Program or project management
  • Engineering or technology-led organisations
  • Research and development programmes
  • Innovation and technology ecosystems
  • Product development or technology commercialisation
  • Consulting with significant execution responsibility

Technical Orientation

The Program Manager will work extensively with research institutions and R&D centres across multiple technology domains. While the role does not require deep expertise in every scientific discipline, it does require sufficient technical understanding to:

  • Understand research and technology development discussions.
  • Engage confidently with scientists, engineers and Principal Investigators.
  • Translate technical discussions into programme plans, milestones and operational actions.
  • Appreciate technology development pathways, scale-up challenges and commercialisation opportunities.
  • Bridge communication between technical teams and operational stakeholders.

Accordingly, candidates should ideally possess:

  • An undergraduate degree in Engineering, Science or Technology.
  • Experience working with technology-led organisations, engineering projects, research programmes or innovation ecosystems.
  • Strong analytical ability and a willingness to quickly learn new technology domains.

Success in the Role

The Program Manager will be expected to progressively build capability across the assigned TRCs and within ITRI. Success will be measured not only by programme delivery but also by the institutional capability created over time.

First 6 Months – Establish & Execute

  • Successfully onboard and develop a deep understanding of ITRI's operating model, TRC lifecycle and governance framework.
  • Take ownership of a portfolio of 2–5 TRCs and establish a structured programme review cadence.
  • Ensure all assigned TRCs have clearly defined Phase 1 plans, milestones, KPIs and governance mechanisms.
  • Build strong working relationships with Principal Investigators, Operations Heads and key stakeholders.
  • Identify execution bottlenecks early and establish a culture of structured follow-up and timely closure.
  • Contribute to defining baseline dashboards and reporting systems for reviews.

By the End of Year 1 – Operationalise & Institutionalise

  • Ensure assigned TRCs achieve agreed Phase 1 milestones within planned timelines.
  • Establish consistent programme governance across all assigned TRCs through regular reviews, risk management and performance monitoring.
  • Develop operational KPIs, KRAs and dashboards that enable objective measurement of TRC performance.
  • Build a robust pipeline of industry problem statements and collaborative opportunities through engagement with industry, start-ups and incubators.
  • Contribute to defining programme management templates, review mechanisms and operating processes that can be adopted across future TRCs.
  • Contribute to defining ITRI's operational metrics, reporting systems and programme management framework.

By the End of Year 3 – Scale & Build Institutional Capability

  • Successfully supports the operationalisation and growth of multiple TRCs, creating a repeatable and scalable operating model for future centres.
  • Establish ITRI's programme management framework as the standard operating model across the TRC portfolio.
  • Demonstrate measurable improvements in programme execution, governance, operational performance and stakeholder engagement across the portfolio.
  • Build a sustainable pipeline of industry partnerships, start-up collaborations and translational opportunities that strengthen the impact of the TRCs.
  • Mentor new programme managers and contribute to building a high-performing programme management capability within ITRI.

Location

Remote, India-based, with travel to partner institutions and TRCs across the country as required.

jobs.title: Director of Growth
jobs.excerpt: About Rhythm EnergyRhythm is redefining the retail energy experience through innovation, technology, and customer obsession.
jobs.description:
About Rhythm Energy

Rhythm is redefining the retail energy experience through innovation, technology, and customer obsession. We’re building a smarter, cleaner, and more customer-centric energy company focused on delivering exceptional experiences while helping customers better manage their energy usage and costs.

We move quickly, operate with high standards, and value people who are analytical, collaborative, and energized by solving complex problems.

About the Role

Rhythm is building the future of home electrification and energy independence. As consumers adopt increasingly sophisticated energy solutions, we have a significant opportunity to help them navigate complex choices while accelerating the transition to a more sustainable energy future.

We’re hiring a Director of Growth to build and scale the next phase of Rhythm’s growth engine. Reporting to the CMO, you’ll own customer acquisition and conversion across a diversified portfolio of online and offline channels, with accountability for customer growth, revenue, unit economics, and return on marketing investment.
You’ll lead the strategy for where and how Rhythm invests to grow—determining which channels to scale, where to experiment, how to improve conversion, and how to allocate resources based on marginal returns and long-term customer value.

This is a true builder-and-operator role. You’ll partner closely with Brand & Creative, Marketing Analytics, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Organic Growth to identify our biggest opportunities and turn insights into measurable business outcomes.

We’re looking for someone who thinks in systems across media, creative, product, conversion, measurement, and customer economics—and who can combine strategic judgment with the willingness to get close to the work.

What You’ll Do

Growth Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and lead Rhythm’s acquisition and conversion strategy, identifying the highest-impact opportunities to accelerate sustainable growth across brands and lines of business.
  • Own annual and quarterly growth plans, forecasts, and portfolio-level investment decisions, balancing customer volume, marginal efficiency, contribution economics, customer lifetime value, and long-term growth.
  • Partner with the CMO and Executive Leadership on growth targets, resource allocation, media investment, and strategic priorities.
  • Communicate performance, insights, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Build and lead a high-performing Growth organization and agency/partner ecosystem, developing channel leaders and creating a culture of accountability, experimentation, speed, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify and apply emerging AI, automation, and growth technologies to accelerate learning, improve decision-making, and increase marketing effectiveness.

Performance Marketing & Channel Expansion

  • Own acquisition strategy and performance across a diversified portfolio of online and offline channels, including Paid Search, Paid Social, Display & Programmatic, Affiliates, CTV, OOH, Direct Mail, creator/influencer partnerships, and emerging channels.
  • Set media mix and budget allocation across direct-response and upper-funnel investments, using marginal return, incrementality, and business economics to determine where to scale, test, reallocate, or pull back.
  • Drive performance against customer growth, revenue, CAC, LTV, payback, contribution economics, and other key business targets.
  • Continuously diversify Rhythm’s acquisition portfolio by identifying, sizing, testing, and scaling new channels, partnerships, audiences, and distribution opportunities.
  • Build scalable testing programs across audiences, creative, messaging, offers, landing experiences, creators/influencers, and channels.
  • Partner closely with Brand & Creative to develop high-performing creative and translate learnings across the broader acquisition portfolio.

Conversion, Experimentation & Digital Experience

  • Own the growth roadmap for conversion across websites, landing pages, and acquisition funnels.
  • Prioritize conversion opportunities based on customer insights, expected business impact, and speed to learning.
  • Lead a rigorous experimentation program across user experience, messaging, offers, conversion paths, and site performance.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative insights to continuously improve conversion and funnel economics.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design/UX, Engineering, and Organic Growth to deploy, evaluate, and scale improvements across the customer journey.

Organic Growth Partnership

  • Ensure SEO, AI-powered search/GEO, and organic growth are integrated into the broader Growth strategy and investment roadmap.
  • Partner closely with Organic Growth leadership to connect organic opportunities with acquisition priorities, conversion strategy, content and landing-page needs, and broader customer and revenue outcomes.
  • Ensure paid and organic growth strategies complement one another and contribute to a cohesive customer acquisition engine.

Measurement, Analytics & Growth Insights

  • Define the KPIs and measurement requirements for Rhythm’s acquisition and conversion portfolio and establish the operating cadence used to review performance and make investment decisions.
  • Use attribution, media mix modeling (MMM), incrementality testing, cohort and LTV analysis, forecasting, and other advanced measurement approaches to guide channel strategy and resource allocation.
  • Partner with Marketing Analytics on measurement frameworks, analytics infrastructure, forecasting models, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities.
  • Translate analytical insights into clear growth actions, experiments, and investment decisions.
  • Ensure acquisition and conversion initiatives are properly instrumented, testable, and measurable, with a bias toward understanding true incremental and marginal returns.

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive experience across Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, Customer Acquisition, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years leading teams, functions, or complex multi-channel growth portfolios.
  • Proven track record scaling customer and revenue growth through sophisticated multi-channel acquisition strategies.
  • Experience managing large-scale marketing investments, ideally eight-figure annual budgets.
  • Deep expertise across digital and offline performance marketing, with demonstrated success making portfolio-level investment decisions and opening new acquisition channels.
  • Strong working knowledge of conversion rate optimization (CRO), experimentation, digital customer journeys, and organic growth/SEO.
  • Sophisticated understanding of growth economics and measurement, including CAC, LTV, payback, contribution economics, attribution, MMM, incrementality, forecasting, and media investment optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage analytics, customer insights, AI, and automation to improve growth performance, experimentation velocity, decision quality, and operating efficiency.
  • Strong executive communication and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear recommendations and investment decisions.
  • Proven people leadership skills with experience building, developing, and inspiring high-performing teams.
  • Strong cross-functional influence with experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics/Data, Creative, Brand, and Operations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in energy, home electrification, clean technology, or another industry with complex customer acquisition economics.
  • Experience in healthcare, FinTech, consumer subscriptions, marketplaces, or consumer technology.
  • Experience scaling both online and offline acquisition channels within the same growth portfolio.
  • Experience building or significantly evolving a Growth function, operating model, or team.
  • Experience incorporating AI and automation into growth workflows, experimentation, creative development, or decision-making.

We know great candidates may not check every box. If you’re excited about the opportunity to build and scale Rhythm’s growth engine, we’d love to hear from you.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12–18 months, success in this role will look like:

  • Rhythm has a clear, scalable growth strategy connecting acquisition, conversion, channel investment, and customer economics.
  • Customer and revenue growth are accelerating while CAC, payback, contribution economics, and LTV remain central to investment decisions.
  • Rhythm has a more diversified acquisition portfolio, with new channels and growth opportunities systematically tested and scaled based on performance.
  • Conversion improves through a disciplined experimentation roadmap across landing pages, acquisition funnels, messaging, offers, and customer experiences.
  • Growth investment decisions increasingly reflect incrementality, marginal returns, MMM, LTV, and other advanced measurement approaches—not simply platform-reported attribution.
  • Paid, organic, creative, product, and conversion strategies operate as an increasingly connected growth system.
  • The Growth organization has clear ownership, strong operating rhythms, and a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Executive Leadership views Growth as a disciplined commercial function that can clearly articulate where Rhythm should invest—and why.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Meaningful ownership. Lead the growth engine responsible for bringing the next generation of Rhythm customers into the business.
  • Direct business impact. Own decisions that directly influence customer growth, revenue, unit economics, and marketing investment.
  • Build, don’t inherit. Shape the team, operating model, channel portfolio, experimentation capabilities, and growth playbook for Rhythm’s next stage.
  • Cross-functional influence. Work directly with the CMO and partner closely with Brand, Creative, Analytics, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Executive Leadership.
  • Room to experiment. Test new channels, technologies, partnerships, creative approaches, and AI-enabled ways of working—and scale what works.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits. We offer competitive compensation, annual performance bonuses, unlimited paid vacation, premium medical coverage, and opportunities for continued professional growth.
  • Flexible work environment. Join a collaborative team with the flexibility to do your best work while staying closely connected to the business.

Hiring Process

We aim to keep our interview process thoughtful, transparent, and respectful of your time.

  1. People Screen (30 minutes) – Meet with our Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about Rhythm, the opportunity, and your background.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes) – Meet with our CMO for a deeper conversation about your growth leadership experience, commercial approach, and how you’ve scaled acquisition organizations.
  3. Stakeholder Panel Interview (60 minutes) – Meet key cross-functional partners and explore how you collaborate, influence decisions, and operate across functions.
  4. Case Study Presentation – Work through and present a growth-focused business challenge to members of the hiring team.
  5. References – We’ll connect with professional references to learn more about your leadership style and previous impact.
  6. Offer – If it’s a mutual fit, we’ll extend an offer and discuss next steps.

We are Boosta, a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

We are looking for an Operations Manager to take ownership of core operational processes and domain infrastructure. You will manage domains, services, access, vendors, budgets, and operational workflows, identify bottlenecks, and drive process automation to support the company’s growth.

What you will do:

  • Own the full domain lifecycle: zone selection, registration, NS/DNS, email, CMS connection, renewal or disposal.

  • Centrally manage services, access, balances, and the operational budget of the function.
  • Handle abuse cases (DMCA, Cloudflare, registrars) by building processes and SLAs.
  • Identify bottlenecks and prepare technical requirements for automation for the technical team.
  • Maintain the company’s operational tracking and provide weekly reports to the CEO.
  • Directly manage the Domain & Access Specialist and, if necessary, expand the team as volumes grow.

What we expect from you:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations / project management with an operational focus.
  • Practical understanding of domain infrastructure: registrars, zones, NS/DNS, Cloudflare, SSL, domain email.
  • Experience managing a large number of accounts and services (AdsPower, proxies, Google accounts).
  • Experience working with vendors: negotiations, wholesale terms, non-standard payment methods, including crypto.
  • Experience managing an operational budget.
  • Strong Google Sheets skills: complex trackers, linked spreadsheets, pivot tables, automations.
  • Experience setting tasks in Jira: decomposition, prioritization, SLA control.
  • Experience writing and implementing SOPs from scratch.
  • English — B2+: written communication with registrars, hosting providers, and services.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience working with DMCA and abuse complaints.
  • Experience hiring and onboarding team members.
  • Basic SQL, Apps Script, or no-code skills for automating routine tasks.

As Organizer Logistics Manager, you are the front-line of ensuring the POs are appropriately scheduled based on their availability.

We’re looking for a skilled planner and problem-solver. You’re comfortable taking disparate information sets and bringing them together to create a clear system. jobs.description:
The Kardex Group is one of the world's leading manufacturers of dynamic storage, retrieval, and distribution systems. With more than 3,000 employees worldwide, we develop and manufacture innovative logistics solutions used across a wide range of industries, including industrial manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and administration.

The Manager Marketing & Communications EMEA will support the growth of the Business Partner Management (BPM) across Eastern Europe, the Balkans, the Baltics, the Middle East and South Africa.

Reporting to the Regional Senior Marketing Manager, the role will work closely with regional sales and service teams and business partners/distributors to plan and execute data- and content-driven online and offline marketing initiatives.

Do you have strong international marketing experience in a B2B environment?



The role calls for a proactive, results-driven marketer with proven expertise in generating leads through our channel business partners/distributors, building broad brand awareness, and building a strong lead pipeline for our indirect sales channels. You will coordinate day-to-day projects, determine which strategies have the highest success rates for lead conversion, and become part of our BPM team by working remotely from one of the Eastern European, Balkan, or North African countries or Lisbon.

Your tasks


Online & Offline Marketing
Plan and execute integrated marketing activities, including digital campaigns, events, exhibitions, customer activities, and sales enablement.


Content & Assets Creation

Create and promote engaging B2B content across the buyer journey, including customer stories, videos, thought leadership, and social media content.


Inbound & Demand Generation
Develop multi-channel inbound campaigns to drive awareness, engagement, conversion, and demand. Use performance data to continuously optimize results.


Lead Generation
Drive lead generation and nurturing activities in close collaboration with Sales, ensuring effective qualification and handover of opportunities.


Sales and Service Support

Educate internal & external stakeholders and manage their needs and expectations.


Partners Enablement

Drive the channel partner network in the logistics or intralogistics industry.


Collaboration
Partner with regional and global Marketing and Sales teams to translate global strategies into impactful local campaigns and bring innovative ideas to the BPM region


Your profile


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • Profund B2B experience in Marketing & Communications within an international business environment, ideally in technology, industrial, automation, logistics, or a similar environment.
  • Fluent in English; French and/or Arabic is a plus
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365, marketing automation, and CRMs (knowledge of HubSpot and Salesforce is a plus).
  • Strong experience in 360 integrated campaigns & demand generation tactics.
  • Digital Marketing Proficiency: Expert in online channels, paid marketing, social media, email marketing, inbound marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with content creation: landing pages, social media posts, video, case studies, presentations, and marketing assets.
  • Experience managing customer events, trade shows, fairs, exhibitions, and webinars.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics and conversion: pipeline generation and progression; lead nurturing & qualification.
  • Data-driven Performance: using analytics to optimize campaigns, measure performance, and drive ROI.


We offer:

  • Company culture: Respect, team spirit, reliability, and passion shape the way we work together. A positive and familiar working atmosphere is our top priority.
  • Long-term perspectives: Secure job in a growing international company with exciting development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive support: Structured onboarding process, training opportunities, and a strong collaborative team environment.
  • Work-life balance: Flexible working hours, vacation according the legal setup of the country living in and the option for mobile working.
  • Aditional benefits: Employee Assistance Program


Interested in the right position for you?

Then send us your meaningful application via our career page. Applying takes just two minutes with us. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Veronika Wieland-Kolumban, Manager Talent Acquisition +49 (8283) 999216.


We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

Job Title: Blog & Email Marketing Intern — Content & Analytics (Remote)

Location: Remote Contract Length: 3 Months (Full-time Internship)

About Us

We are a fast-growing venture development firm that builds, manages, and scales innovative businesses across multiple industries. Our mission is to launch and grow ventures that thrive — providing them with strategic, marketing, and operational support to succeed.

We are seeking a Blog & Email Marketing Intern who is passionate about content creation, storytelling, and — critically — the analytics that prove what's working. This is a hands-on opportunity to work directly with our CEO (Princeton, UCLA MBA, former Deloitte Consulting) and marketing team, gaining real-world experience across multiple ventures.

Role Overview

As a Blog and Email Marketing Intern, you will take ownership of creating, managing, and optimizing written content that drives engagement, builds brand awareness, and nurtures leads. Every piece of content you produce will be measured: your main focus will be on producing SEO-optimized blog posts and executing targeted, data-driven email campaigns — then using performance data to iterate, refine, and report on what moves the needle for each venture's growth strategy.

You will use tools like Zoho CRM, Zoho Campaigns, Zoho Analytics, and AI-based writing and analytics platforms to measure performance and streamline content workflows. If you enjoy digging into dashboards as much as drafting copy, this role is built for you.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Performance Reporting
  • Own the measurement layer of our content engine: define, track, and report on KPIs across blog and email channels (traffic, rankings, open rates, click-through rates, conversions, list growth).
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards and weekly/monthly reports using Zoho Analytics, Google Analytics/Search Console, and campaign-level data.
  • Translate data into insight: identify which topics, formats, subject lines, and send times drive results, and present clear, actionable recommendations to leadership.
  • Run structured A/B tests across email and content, document learnings, and feed them back into the content strategy.

Blog Content & SEO
  • Research, write, and edit engaging blog posts aligned with brand voice and SEO best practices.
  • Develop topic ideas and content calendars grounded in audience data, keyword research, and industry trends — not guesswork.
  • Optimize posts with keywords, formatting, and internal linking to increase search visibility.
  • Track blog performance (organic traffic, rankings, engagement, conversions) and use those metrics to prioritize and shape future content.

Email Marketing & Lifecycle Campaigns
  • Create and manage newsletters, drip campaigns, and promotional emails using Zoho Campaigns or similar tools.
  • Segment email lists using behavioral and engagement data, personalize content, and run A/B tests to improve performance.
  • Support lead nurturing workflows within Zoho CRM, ensuring data accuracy, proper tagging, and clean reporting pipelines.
  • Monitor campaign analytics end-to-end (deliverability, open rates, click-through rates, conversions) and recommend data-backed improvements each cycle.

AI & Automation
  • Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Jasper, SurferSEO, or Writesonic) to enhance blog writing, keyword optimization, campaign copy, and performance analysis.
  • Explore automation and reporting opportunities within Zoho CRM, Campaigns, and Analytics to streamline content, outreach, and measurement workflows.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience
  • 0–1 year of experience in digital marketing, content writing, or email marketing (internship or project experience counts).
  • Knowledge or exposure to Zoho CRM is a must.
  • Demonstrated comfort with marketing analytics — experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, Zoho Analytics, or campaign reporting dashboards is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for content creation and optimization is required.
  • Experience with email marketing platforms (Zoho Campaigns, Mailchimp, HubSpot, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals and content performance metrics.

Skills
  • Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills.
  • Strong analytical mindset: comfortable working with data, spotting trends, and turning metrics into recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of spreadsheets (pivot tables, basic formulas) for campaign and content analysis.
  • Detail-oriented with a knack for creating engaging, reader-focused content.
  • Self-motivated, creative, and eager to learn new marketing and analytics technologies.

Education
  • Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

How to Apply

Send your resume, cover letter, and writing samples or email campaign examples (if available). Bonus points for including a campaign report, dashboard, or A/B test result you've worked on — show us how you use data, Zoho CRM, and AI tools to enhance content performance.

Why Join Us

This role offers a unique opportunity to build real-world expertise in content marketing and marketing analytics — a combination that sets candidates apart early in their careers. You'll work directly with senior leadership, own measurable outcomes across multiple high-growth ventures, and master modern tools like Zoho CRM, Zoho Campaigns, Zoho Analytics, and AI-powered platforms.

  • Mentorship from experienced marketing and venture-building professionals.

jobs.description:
About The Role:

    Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.

    We embed engineers and leaders inside client operations as Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and Forward Deployed Executives (FDX) — people who learn the work, ship the system, and own the outcome. Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Bluprints.

    You will do the customer’s job before you automate it.

    Most AI engagements fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a PRD, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements-gathering step is the bug. So we remove it.

    A Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Provectus spends the first weeks of an engagement in the operator’s seat — as the underwriter, the analyst, the RCM specialist, the claims clinician, whoever actually does the work we’ve been asked to change. You do the job. You learn the constraints from the inside, the ones nobody writes down. Then you sit at a table with that operator and a Forward Deployed Executive and rebuild the function from first principles — and you are the one who builds it.

    Three things define how you work:

    • Embedded, not engaged. You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it.
    • Real tasks, not scope. You are not fenced into a siloed deliverable. You go where the operating problem is.
    • Autonomous. Embedded is not staff-augmented. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.

      • You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. That loop is the difference between an outcome and an invoice.

      You’ll be measured on whether the Business Unit’s number moved — not on hours, not on scope delivered.

      This is a role for engineers who have led before — as a founder, a CTO, a staff engineer — and who want to stay in the code while owning the outcome. On most days you’ll be the most senior technical person in the room, and you’ll still be the one shipping.

What You'll Bring:

    • 8+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands-on today and intend to stay that way
    • You will take the operator’s seat. You are genuinely willing to spend weeks doing someone else’s job — claims processing, underwriting, revenue-cycle work — before you write a line of code. Engineers who need to stay in the IDE should not apply
    • You learn domains fast. Demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly enough to argue with the people who do it for a living
    • Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works
    • You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why
    • Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack
    • Cloud-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus): containers, Kubernetes/ECS, IaC, CI/CD, and the operational reality of a system someone else inherits
    • Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room
    • Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job
    • Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes, not just call the API
    • Fluent English, written and spoken

Nice To Have:

    • Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution
    • Real depth in one of our blueprint industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare, asset management
    • Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery
    • Data platform depth: data lakes, warehouses, streaming and real-time analytics, data mesh and data contracts, governance and data quality
    • MLOps and classical ML: PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow
    • Fine-tuning, distillation, or inference/serving optimization
    • Graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune)
    • IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform
    • Open-source contributions or public writing on applied AI

How We Hire:

    Short loop, hands-on, no take-home:

    1. Intro conversation — the role, your background, what you want to be doing
    2. Two live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor. You may use an LLM assistant (ChatGPT, Claude) — how you work now includes these tools. Autocomplete/agentic coding tools are off for these sessions
    3. The redesign session. We hand you an unfamiliar business function and the constraints of the person who performs it. You have to understand the job well enough to rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. No LLMs for this one
    4. Team and practice conversation

What We Offer:

  • Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare
  • The chance to shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment
  • A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers
  • A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them
  • Remote-friendly culture

jobs.description:
Wizcorpでは、次世代型ゲーム機向けのプロジェクトに携わる3D 背景アーティスを募集しています。あなたのこれまでのご経歴、スキル、経験に応じて、当社のチーム内で最適なポジションをご紹介させていただきます。

全世界21カ国に拠点を持つ当社グループ会社のアーティストとしてワールドワイドで活躍するチャンスです。　世界各国の様々なスタイルのアートにふれあい、制作に携わる事であなた自身の経験と技術はより一層豊になるでしょう。

業務内容 🎮📆🕹

ゲーム開発における背景デザインや3D背景モデリングの業務全般に携わっていただきます。

具体的な業務は以下のようです。

  • プランナー・プログラマと連携してゲームデザインに則した背景の考案及び制作

  • 3D背景モデル制作(モデリング・スカルプト・テクスチャリング・セットアップなど)

  • 3D背景制作におけるテクニカルサポート業務

🤹 求めるスキル 🤹

  • 3D背景モデリングの制作工程の中で特化した技術や知識をお持ちの方

⭐ 必須条件 ⭐

  • Maya、Zbrush、Substance Painter、Houdiniなど複数のDCC使用経験をお持ちの方

  • UnityやUnrealエンジンを使用しての背景モデリングの経験をお持ちの方

  • シェーダーやスクリプトの知識を有する方

  • 3DCGのハイエンドグラフィックに関する知識をお持ちの方

👍 歓迎条件 👍

  • 英語の理解力、英語が必要とされる制作現場においての経験をお持ちの方

  • プロジェクト内のリーダー経験、管理などを行った実績をお持ちの方

  • 外部会社との折衝、管理などの経験をお持ちの方

  • ワールドワイドで3Dモデラーとして活躍したい方

選考の流れ🈸⚙️😊

① 書類選考: すべての応募者の履歴書を2週間以内に審査します。プロフィールが要件に合致する場合、その結果に基づいて、初回面接の日程をご連絡いたします。

② 面接: お人柄、情熱、スキル、そして私たちの仕事への関心を評価するため、3回の面接を実施します。また、私たちのビジョンや価値観を共有する時間も大切にしています。私たちがあなたを面接するのと同じように、あなたも私たちを面接していると考えているからです。

③ リファレンスチェック: あなたの経験や働き方をより深く理解するため、前職の雇用主または専門的な関係者にリファレンスチェックを実施します。

④ 内定: 最終面接後、2週間以内に最終決定を行い、採用となった場合は詳細な内定通知をお送りします。

入社プロセス 🈴🗼🌅

入社プロセスをできる限りスムーズで心配のないものにするよう努めています。

内定承諾後、労働契約書と就業規則をお送りします。

理想的には1ヶ月以内にご入社いただきたいと考えていますが、現在の就業状況に応じて調整可能です。

初日には、マネージャーがチームメンバーを紹介し、6ヶ月の試用期間中のレビュースケジュールを設定します。試用期間を無事に完了できるよう、必要なサポートをすべて提供します。

Wizcorpでは、共に成長します。

シニアスタッフがサポートとメンターシップを提供します。デジタル学習教材へのアクセスも可能で、マネージャーがキャリア目標に基づいたトレーニングカリキュラムの策定を支援します。

当社のキャリア理念については、こちらをご覧ください:

待遇・福利厚生

📍 勤務地と時間 📍

⏲ フレックスタイム制

クリエイティブな時間の使い方は人それぞれで異なり、自分に合う使い方はご自身が一番ご存じでしょう。

月曜日から金曜日の間で、コアタイムを11:00から16:00とし、一日あたり8時間仕事をしていただきます（1時間の休憩時間を除く）。コアタイム以外の時間配分はお任せいたします。

正社員

年額480～840万円　（月額40～70万円）

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

Keywords Studios is strongly committed to protecting your personal information. By sending your CV/Resume, you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and consent to your data being managed and retained in accordance with our data privacy and retention policy

Wizcorpについて 🦄🇯🇵🎮

Wizcorpは東京を拠点とし、100%リモートワークで運営される高度に専門化されたゲーム開発スタジオです。私たちは異文化が融合する情熱的なチームとして、ひとつの目標に向かって取り組んでいます。それは、ゲーム開発に魔法を取り戻すこと。

私たちの取り組み

  • 日々成長する: 技術力が私たちのアイデアを制限することがあってはならない

  • 常識を疑う: 昨日の答えで明日の課題に立ち向かうことはしない

  • 価値観を大切にする: 私たちの意思決定は、道徳的な指針に導かれている

  • 同じビジョンを持つ仲間と: スタッフ、クライアント、パートナーすべてが私たちのミッションの一部

  • 学び、共有する: 私たちの成功も失敗も、業界全体の知恵に貢献していく

Wizcorpは、フレンドリーで誠実な職場環境を提供しています。やりがいのある仕事を通じて、個人としても専門家としても成長できる機会が無数にあります。

jobs.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment (East)

Our Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment (East)is responsible forleading theend to enddelivery of long haul OSP deployment programs in the western U.S., with a primary focus on managing 1–2 turnkey engineering and construction contractors across 5–8 simultaneous projects. These builds willbe primarilygreenfield, with occasional overpull components.

Our Director ensures that each contractorexecutes tothe defined scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards by applying disciplined project management, rigorous contract oversight, and proactive risk mitigation. This rolemaintainsstrong communicationwith internal stakeholders, contractor leadership,permittingauthorities, and customers. Our Director reports to the Head of Long Haul OSP Deployment.

NOTE: The team is open to this position working remotely within the United States - East Coast.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Contractor Management

  • Lead the overall delivery of 5–8 long haul OSP projects executed by 1–2 large turnkey contractors.

  • Serve as the primary operational and contractual interface with turnkey partners, ensuring compliance with all terms, milestones, deliverables, and performance metrics.

  • Conduct regular contractor performance reviews focused on schedule adherence, budget performance, production rates, safety, and quality.

  • Drive accountability through structured reporting, issue escalation, and corrective action planning when contractor output deviates from expectations.

Project Planning & Execution

  • Validate each project’s greenfield route scope, fiber counts, structure type, and constructability to ensure clear alignment between requirements and contracted deliverables.

  • Oversee route feasibility and risk analysis to accurately forecast project cost, schedule, andrequiredresources before construction begins.

  • Manage andmaintainproject-level schedules and budgets, ensuring turnkey partners update and track progress accurately and transparently.

  • Ensuretimelysubmittal and approval of engineering packages,permittingapplications, traffic control plans, and environmental/regulatory filings.

Contract Governance & Compliance

  • Own the contract execution strategy, from contract kickoff through construction closeout.

  • Monitor contractor compliance with unit pricing, milestone requirements, SLAs, and change-order procedures.

  • Validate quantities, production reports, invoicing accuracy, and adherence to the agreed-upon schedule of values.

  • Ensure change orders are justified, properly documented, and aligned with contractual terms before approval.

Material & Construction Oversight

  • Overseecontractormaterial forecasting, ordering, receiving, and field distribution to ensure alignment with project timelines.

  • Monitor field production rates and collaborate with project managers and contractors to implement recovery plans if deviations occur.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Deliveraccurate, concise project reporting at both the program and executive levels, including progress summaries, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.

  • Providetimelyupdates to customer teams and internal partners throughout construction.

  • Deliver complete andaccurateasbuiltpackages to GIS, network operations, and inventory teams.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of project managers, fostering strong execution discipline and a culture of accountability.

  • Promote continuous improvement in vendor management, project controls, andlong hauldelivery practices.

  • Support cross-functional collaboration with regional OSP teams to ensure program alignment with local initiatives and broader network strategy.

Education, Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; equivalent work experience considered.

  • Business, finance, or project management coursework or degree a plus.

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of successful people leadership experience in largescale network deployment or construction environments.

  • Minimum of ten (10) years managing complex, multiphase telecommunications projects, ideally involving OSP,longhaulfiber, Ethernet, or wireless networks.

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of OSP construction management experience withdemonstratedexpertiseinlonghaulbuilds, greenfield construction, and contractor oversight.

  • Extensive experience managing turnkey (EPC) contractors, including tracking deliverables, enforcing contract terms, and driving performance.

  • Proven history of delivering large,multimilliondollarfiber deployment programs on schedule and within budget.

  • Experience administering NTIA or similar federal program requirements (e.g.,DavisBacon, BABA, environmental assessments).

  • Specific experience navigating complex permitting and regulatory processes such as NEPA, Section 106, Tribal engagement, and ROW negotiations.

  • Strong understanding of OSP construction standards, fiber cable specifications, andlonghauldesign principles.

  • Working knowledge of optical network concepts, fiber testing standards, and acceptance criteria.

  • Ability to read, understand, andvalidatefiber testing output; experience with tools such as EXFOFastReportera plus.

  • Familiarity withGISbasedtools (e.g., ArcGIS/ArcView, MapInfo, Google Earth).

  • Knowledge of the U.S. carrier,longhaul, anddarkfibermarket landscape.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and contractors in afastpaced,highvisibilityenvironment.

  • Strong financial acumen, including budget creation, cost control,unitpricevalidation, and invoice verification.

  • Experience developing, negotiating, and administering largescale construction and engineering contracts.

  • Skilled in risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalating issues to resolution.

  • Proficiencywith MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace tools.

  • Experience with project management platforms such asSitetrackerstronglypreferred.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRMtoolsa plus.

  • Exceptionalproblem solvingandcritical thinkingcapabilities.

  • Strong communicationskills withanability to convey complex technical issues to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated leadership qualities with the ability to mentor teams, build consensus, and drive high contractor accountability.

  • High levelof organization, urgency, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to travel up to ~10% for key field visits, vendor oversight,permitmeetings, and escalations.

  • Mustbe authorized towork in the United States.

Estimated base salary range: $117,000 - $180,000 USD/annually.

Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.
