Role Overview

The VP, Compensation Strategy, Design, and Architecture is responsible for establishing, governing, and evolving Circana's enterprise-wide job architecture and broad-based compensation framework. This role owns the foundational structures that define how work is organized, evaluated, leveled, and compensated globally, ensuring consistency, scalability, and alignment with business and talent strategies.

The VP leads the design and ongoing stewardship of Circana's job architecture, including job families, career streams, level definitions, job evaluation methodologies, leveling criteria, and related governance processes. The role also owns the design of market-aligned compensation structures and frameworks that support equitable, competitive, and consistent pay practices across the organization.

Working closely with Compensation Administration, Total Rewards, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders, this role will lead the transformation of Circana's current-state framework into a modern global architecture that supports organizational growth, workforce planning, career development, and compensation decision-making. In partnership with external subject matter experts, the VP will establish sustainable governance practices for maintaining and evolving the architecture over time, including processes for creating, modifying, evaluating, and retiring jobs as business needs evolve.

In addition to designing the future-state framework, this role will play a critical leadership role in driving organizational adoption, stakeholder alignment, and change management to ensure successful implementation of large-scale compensation and workforce architecture transformation initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

Job Architecture Design & Framework Development

  • Own the design and evolution of Circana's global job architecture, including job families, career streams, level definitions, job evaluation methodologies, and leveling criteria.
  • Establish and maintain a consistent enterprise framework for organizing, evaluating, and leveling work across functions, geographies, and business units.
  • Design scalable architecture frameworks that support workforce planning, organizational design, talent mobility, career progression, and compensation decision-making.
  • Develop architecture standards and principles that enable consistency and scalability across the enterprise.
  • Ensure alignment between job architecture, career frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and compensation structures.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to ensure architecture frameworks can be effectively operationalized, administered, and sustained over time.

Global Pay Structure & Salary Range Design

  • Own the design and evolution of Circana's global salary structure framework, ensuring alignment with the company's job architecture, compensation philosophy, and market position.
  • Develop market-informed salary structures and range methodologies through analysis of external benchmark data, competitive market practices, and internal workforce considerations.
  • Design geographic pay frameworks and market differentiation approaches appropriate to Circana's global operating model.
  • Lead financial modeling and impact assessments for proposed compensation structures in partnership with Finance, Legal, Compensation Strategy, and other key stakeholders.
  • Establish scalable compensation design principles, methodologies, and governance standards that support consistent and equitable pay decisions across the enterprise.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to operationalize compensation structures and support ongoing administration, market updates, and annual range review processes.
  • Ensure alignment between job architecture, grade structures, salary ranges, and market pricing methodologies to create an integrated and scalable compensation framework.

External Job Evaluation & Architecture Partnership

  • Lead architecture, job evaluation, and workforce design initiatives conducted with external advisors and subject matter experts.
  • Assess and adapt external methodologies and recommendations to align with Circana's business, talent, and compensation objectives.
  • Partner closely with external advisors and consulting firms to guide methodology implementation, translate recommendations into practical business solutions, and ensure successful organizational adoption.
  • Ensure sustainable internal ownership of architecture frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and governance standards.

Job Evaluation Methodology

  • Own and maintain Circana's enterprise job evaluation methodology, including the frameworks, criteria, and standards used to assess, compare, and level work across the organization.
  • Establish consistent evaluation principles and decision-making guidelines to support equitable, transparent, and scalable leveling outcomes globally.
  • Ensure alignment between job evaluation, job architecture, career frameworks, and compensation structures to create an integrated workforce architecture.
  • Design evaluation methodologies that support sustainable pay equity, regulatory compliance, and defensible compensation practices across geographies.
  • Define evaluation standards and documentation requirements to support consistent application of the methodology across the enterprise.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to operationalize evaluation standards and maintain consistent application of the methodology.

Architecture Governance & Evolution

  • Own the governance and stewardship of Circana's global job architecture, ensuring continued alignment with business strategy, organizational design, and evolving workforce needs.
  • Establish and lead periodic reviews of job families, career streams, level definitions, evaluation methodologies, and architecture standards to maintain the relevance and integrity of the framework.
  • Define and oversee architecture decision rights, governance processes, and approval mechanisms for creating, modifying, consolidating, and retiring jobs and job families.
  • Lead enterprise-wide architecture reviews associated with reorganizations, acquisitions, new business models, emerging skills, and significant workforce changes.
  • Monitor architecture health, consistency, and adoption across functions and geographies, addressing exceptions and governance issues as needed.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders to ensure consistent application of architecture standards and decision-making frameworks.
  • Lead change management, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness activities associated with compensation, job architecture, and workforce framework transformation initiatives.

Career Frameworks & Talent Alignment

  • Partner with Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders to align job architecture with career development, workforce planning, organizational design, and talent management strategies.
  • Ensure job families, career streams, and level definitions support clear and consistent career progression opportunities across the enterprise.
  • Establish architecture standards that enable talent mobility, career growth, succession planning, and workforce planning across functions and geographies.
  • Collaborate with Talent Management to align career frameworks, competency models, and development pathways with the broader job architecture.
  • Provide thought leadership on the intersection of workforce architecture, career progression, and organizational effectiveness to support evolving business and talent needs.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to business leaders and HR stakeholders, translating compensation and workforce architecture principles into practical solutions that support organizational effectiveness and evolving business needs.

Compensation Framework Governance

  • Own the governance framework for Circana's global salary structures, including range design methodologies, market positioning approaches, geographic pay strategies, and compensation design principles.
  • Lead periodic strategic reviews of compensation frameworks to ensure continued alignment with market conditions, business strategy, workforce needs, and compensation philosophy.
  • Evaluate emerging compensation trends, labor market developments, regulatory changes, and organizational shifts to inform future compensation framework enhancements.
  • Assess the effectiveness of salary structures, geographic pay approaches, and market positioning strategies, recommending changes as business and talent needs evolve.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to ensure compensation frameworks are effectively operationalized, maintained, and monitored across the enterprise.

Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive compensation experience, including significant responsibility for job architecture, job evaluation, leveling frameworks, compensation design, and workforce architecture strategy within complex global organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and governing enterprise-wide job architecture frameworks across multiple functions, business units, countries, and regions.
  • Deep expertise in job evaluation methodologies and market-leading grading frameworks, including direct experience with Willis Towers Watson, Korn Ferry, Mercer, Aon, or comparable methodologies. Experience implementing, administering, or operating within Willis Towers Watson Global Grading frameworks is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in compensation consulting, workforce architecture consulting, or similar advisory environments is strongly preferred.
  • Strong compensation design expertise, including salary structure development, market pricing methodologies, geographic pay strategies, compensation governance, and broad-based compensation program design.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale job architecture, workforce design, job leveling, or compensation transformation initiatives from strategy and design through implementation, organizational adoption, and long-term governance.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change and global rollouts, including stakeholder alignment, communication, and adoption strategies associated with compensation, workforce architecture, or organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Experience translating external methodologies, market practices, and business requirements into practical enterprise frameworks that support workforce planning, career progression, talent mobility, and compensation decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and apply governance frameworks, decision-making standards, and operating models that ensure consistency, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including workforce modeling, scenario analysis, compensation cost modeling, and assessment of organizational and compensation design alternatives.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Finance, Legal, Employee Relations, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders to implement enterprise-wide workforce and compensation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated understanding of global regulatory considerations and pay transparency requirements, including experience supporting EU pay transparency initiatives, works council environments, and country-specific employment practices impacting job architecture and compensation design.
  • Exceptional judgment, influence, consultative leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and lead through significant organizational change.
  • Ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor while leading complex enterprise initiatives, balancing strategic design work with detailed analytical, implementation, and change management responsibilities.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

As Kheyti's founding Head of Evidence and Evaluation, you will build the evidence function from scratch — defining what we measure and generating the evidence that guides how we learn, improve, and scale.   • Evidence Strategy:Assess what Kheyti measures today, what it needs to know, and where the gaps are. jobs.description:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem—homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents—onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Within Qualia, you'll join the Payments team. Every real estate closing ends with money changing hands: earnest money deposits, loan funding, mortgage payoffs, seller proceeds, and commissions. Qualia powers a substantial portion of U.S. residential home sales every year, totaling billions of dollars in transaction volume. The Payments team builds the systems that move those funds safely, accurately, and on time.

The stakes are high. A single closing often moves hundreds of thousands of dollars between multiple parties on a tight deadline, and real estate wires are a prime target for fraud. Our mission is to make money movement the most trustworthy part of the closing, so title and escrow teams, and the homebuyers they serve, never have to wonder where their funds are.

HOW WE WORK

Our engineers are entrepreneurial, pragmatic builders who move quickly without cutting corners, and who are as comfortable owning a project end to end as they are collaborating with a team. We ship frequently, as often as multiple times a day, and work directly with design, compliance, and customer-facing teams to build payment experiences our customers depend on.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain systems that process ACH and wire transfers at scale (billions of dollars annually), including origination, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
  • Build and harden payment-processing pipelines that integrate with banking partners, payment rails, and third-party financial APIs
  • Implement controls for wire fraud prevention, transaction verification, and anomaly detection alongside our security and compliance teams
  • Improve and extend core web applications (frontend and backend) that support escrow accounting and closing-day money movement
  • Own architectural decisions for payments infrastructure, including data integrity, idempotency, retry/failure handling, and audit logging
  • Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Accounting stakeholders to ensure systems meet regulatory and audit requirements (e.g., NACHA rules, wire fraud regulations, SOC 2 controls)
  • Participate in on-call rotation for payment-critical systems

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

  • You've taken full ownership of complex, high-liability systems in production, and you know how to respond calmly and methodically when funds are on the line
  • 5+ years of experience as a strong full-stack web developer is required
  • Direct experience building or maintaining other money-movement systems (banking, fintech, payments processors, or similar regulated environments strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of transactional integrity, idempotency, and failure-mode design in financial systems
  • Familiarity with payment rails, banking APIs, or financial compliance standards (NACHA, OFAC screening, PCI, SOC 2) is a strong plus
  • You have made key architectural decisions for large, high-stakes projects
  • You have mentored junior developers
  • You have worked on multiple engineering teams, both small and large
  • Good product sense, strong attention to detail, and a passion for building systems people can trust with their money

THE TECH STACK YOU'LL USE

  • JavaScript / TypeScript / NodeJS
  • SPA Frontend libraries like React and MeteorJS
  • MongoDB
  • Microservice architecture / Kubernetes
  • AWS

We are a remote-first development organization that values flexibility in how our teams work. Because of that, while the role is based in Austin, TX, we are open to remote candidates for this position. We have other physical office locations in San Francisco, California, and Concord, New Hampshire.

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems-and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. The role provides strategic and operational leadership over the global benefits portfolio, builds the governance model, operating model, and data foundation needed for scalable delivery, and leads a growing team of benefits professionals as the function centralizes. This is a unique opportunity to help build and modernize Circana's global benefits capability at a pivotal stage of growth. This role is best suited for a leader who has successfully built, transformed, or centralized benefits capabilities and can quickly establish credibility, influence, and results in a complex global environment.

This is an evolving role, built for how work should be organized in an AI-enabled function. The leader will architect a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, anchored on the organization's most important priorities (determined through our Business Strategy, HR Mission and Vision, and People Strategy), deliberately elevating team members to complex, judgment-driven, and people-centric work while putting automation and AI to work on repetitive, transactional tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Global Benefits Strategy Partnership

  • Partner with the Head of Total Rewards to shape and execute the global benefits strategy, ensuring programs remain market-competitive, cost-effective, and aligned to Circana’s Total Rewards philosophy and talent priorities.
  • Oversee execution of global benefit design, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns day-to-day design decisions across health & welfare, retirement/pension, wellbeing, and voluntary benefits.
  • Partner with Compensation on the broader Total Rewards Framework to ensure benefits are positioned consistently with pay philosophy and market positioning.

Transformation & M&A Integration

  • Oversee harmonization of benefits plan design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring outcomes align to enterprise strategy and budget.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for benefits due diligence and integration planning for future M&A activity, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design on design execution.
  • Approve new-country benefit program design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring alignment to global strategy and budget.

Governance & Centralization

  • Build and lead the governance model, standards, decision rights, and operating framework needed to centralize benefits administration currently managed by regional HR Business Partners.
  • Establish and lead the transition plan, timeline, and change management approach for migrating benefits from HRBP teams to a centralized Benefit function.
  • Set the standards for global benefits policies, procedures, and documentation, and govern their consistent application across regions.

Vendor, Broker & Financial Management

  • Own broker, carrier, and third-party administrator relationships and contracts globally for material renewals, partnering with Procurement on RFP mechanics and formal vendor process, and using AI-assisted analysis for renewal-package review and first-pass prep.
  • Lead negotiation and final decisions on broker/carrier renewals and RFP outcomes for material renewals, ensuring service quality and cost discipline; routine renewal documentation and coordination is supported by the Benefits Vendor & Systems Coordinator.
  • Own the global benefits budget; monitor spending, forecast costs, and identify efficiency opportunities in partnership with Finance.

Compliance & Regulatory Governance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable benefits regulations across all countries of operation, including ERISA, ACA, and country-specific statutory requirements.
  • Partner with Legal and Total Rewards on regulatory readiness for initiatives such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive and country-specific benefits mandates (e.g., India).
  • Maintain audit readiness, required filings, and documentation for all benefits programs.

Administration, Systems & Data

  • Ensure end-to-end benefits administration — including enrollment, life events, leave of absence coordination, and escalations — is delivered effectively by the Manager, Benefits – Administration & Delivery, determining outsourcing/co-sourcing opportunities as needed.
  • Partner with HR Technology/EE&T on benefits system configuration, data integrity, and integration with the broader HR technology ecosystem, including the Job Architecture data foundation.
  • Establish benefits reporting and analytics that support decision-making — cost, utilization, and compliance data framed to inform plan renewal, vendor negotiation, and design choices, not just tracked for visibility.
  • Leverage AI and automation to redesign repetitive, transactional benefits processes — enrollment, eligibility, compliance monitoring, and reporting — freeing the team’s capacity for higher-judgment, people-centric work.

Employee Experience & Communication

  • Ensure employee sentiment on benefits satisfaction is monitored and incorporated into program design, led by the Director, Benefit Design.
  • Partner with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns the benefits journey map and end-to-end employee experience strategy, ensuring alignment with Circana’s talent strategy and HR Mission and Vision.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for employee communication, education, and enrollment campaigns led by the Director, Benefit Design, in partnership with HR Business Partners and Talent Management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex benefits matters, partnering with HR Business Partners during the centralization transition.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Team Leadership

  • Partner with Compensation, Talent Management, Payroll, Legal, Finance, and HR Business Partners to ensure benefits programs support broader Total Rewards and talent strategy.
  • Build and evolve a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, structured around the organization’s most important priorities; deliberately allocating complex, people-centric work to team members and repetitive work to automation and AI as capabilities are built.
  • Partner with Procurement on vendor sourcing, contracting, and cost management strategy for benefits vendors, brokers, and carriers.
  • Leverage partners across the HR organization — including HR Business Partners, Talent Management, and HR Technology — to bring broader expertise and reach global benefits initiatives.
  • Represent Global Benefits in Total Rewards leadership discussions and HRLT initiatives as needed.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive benefits experience, including demonstrated expertise in global benefits design, governance, vendor management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong global benefits and regulatory acumen, including deep knowledge of U.S. requirements (ERISA, ACA) and experience navigating multi-country frameworks such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Demonstrated experience leading benefits strategy, administration, or governance across multiple countries and regions is required.
  • Fluency in applying AI and automation to redesign operational and administrative processes, with a track record of shifting team capacity from transactional work toward higher-judgment, strategic, and people-centric priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience building, centralizing, harmonizing, or transforming benefits operations, ideally in a multi-country, multi-entity, or post-merger environment.
  • Proven vendor and broker management skills, including RFPs, contract negotiation, and performance governance.
  • Strong financial acumen, with experience owning and managing a global benefits budget.
  • Experience partnering with HR Technology teams on benefits systems, data integrity, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication, consultation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex benefits concepts for executive and employee audiences.
  • People leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams, including experience designing flexible, virtual, or hybrid team structures that flex with business priorities.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of strengthening governance, controls, and scalable benefits solutions that support organizational growth.
  • Experience building new capabilities, operating models, governance structures, or shared-service approaches within a benefits or Total Rewards function.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities with experience leveraging technology and reporting to improve outcomes.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location:Remote, USA.Candidates must be comfortable supporting a global workforce and working across multiple time zones, including North America and Europe, as needed.

An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this position begins at $200,000 USD and will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and overall alignment with the role. This position is also eligible for an annual bonus.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Talent Technology team. This role will play a key part in shaping and executing the roadmap for our internal talent systems. You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and stakeholders across HR and business functions to deliver seamless, scalable experiences that support the full employee lifecycle: from candidate experience to employee growth and retention. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a cross-functional environment and is excited to work hands-on with engineering and business partners to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role will go deep into talent data systems and architecture to be able to lay the foundation for AI initiatives and a broader talent ecosystem strategy.

About You:

You are curious and creative, and have experience applying product management frameworks to create enterprise or consumer products. You are highly adaptable and when faced with challenges, you become more creative, not less. You like solving problems and can drive clarity to build the optimal products. You are biased toward execution and can lead the team to bring projects from concept to completion, doing everything possible to ensure a successful launch. You are data-driven with a knack for using data to identify business opportunities, have a can-do attitude, are confident, and a skilled communicator who welcomes honest and candid feedback. You are comfortable working with engineers, customers, and executives and know how to articulate your communication to each audience effectively.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for talent management systems, including but not limited to our custom solutions for studio workforce management and feedback & performance.

  • Deeply understand the needs of HR stakeholders, people leaders, and employees through research, data analysis, and close partnership.

  • Translate complex business problems and talent strategies into intuitive, user-focused product experiences.

  • Prioritize competing demands from stakeholders across the organization using a clear, strategic framework.

  • Partner closely with engineering and design teams to deliver high-quality product experiences and solutions on time and at scale.

  • Monitor product performance, adoption, and satisfaction using data and use these insights to continuously improve.

  • Stay current on market trends in HR tech and bring new thinking into our product approach.

  • Lead product discussions with senior HR, engineering and business leaders, influencing strategic direction.

  • Have a deep understanding and empathy for customer needs, using user research and creative feedback mechanisms to validate product hypotheses and optimal product solutions.

  • Be driven to explore advanced AI and large language concepts, and their potential applications in an evolving Talent Technology space.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree.

  • 6+ years of product management and/or data architecture experience with a strong track record in enterprise applications or HR/Talent technology.

  • Brings a deep appreciation for the complexity and nuance of the talent domain, including the systems and processes that support employee lifecycle events.Knowledge of Talent Data systems and experience developing analytical systems around talent data lakes.

  • Experience with GenAI and working with core engineering teams

  • Comfortable collaborating with engineers and making tradeoffs based on technical considerations and business priorities

  • Ability to operate strategically, envisioning scalable solutions, while also diving deep with engineers into edge cases, technical tradeoffs, and implementation details.

  • Familiarity with the talent ecosystem: learning systems (LMS), employee engagement

  • Self-directed and comfortable operating in a decentralized, fast-paced environment

  • Empathy for internal users and ability to turn business needs into delightful product experiences.

  • Lead product requirements, technical development, product testing, launch, end-user training, and rollout.

  • Ability to drive and influence business decisions based on data and metrics.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $310,000.00 - $545,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: React (Next JS) Developer_Offshore
jobs.excerpt: The React (Next. js) Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance web applications using React.
jobs.description:
The React (Next.js) Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance web applications using React.js and Next.js. This role involves building production-ready features, integrating with backend/BFF APIs, ensuring high code quality, and implementing best practices in performance, accessibility, and security.

The developer will work closely with the React Lead, UX/UI designers, QA, DevOps, and backend teams to deliver modern web applications aligned with enterprise architecture and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive, interactive, and accessible web pages using React.js and Next.js.
  • Implement server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR) as required.
  • Build reusable components, custom hooks, and libraries.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

2. Next.js Framework Implementation

  • Utilize Next.js features effectively:
    • getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, getStaticPaths
    • API routes and middleware
    • Dynamic routing, layouts, and nested routes
  • Optimize hydration, lazy-loading, and client/server data fetching.
  • Implement efficient caching and prefetching strategies for faster UX.

3. State Management & Data Handling

  • Manage application state using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, or Context API + Hooks.
  • Integrate with REST or GraphQL APIs from BFF/backend layers.
  • Handle errors, loading states, and fallback UI for smoother user experiences.

4. UI/UX & Design System Integration

  • Work with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs aligned with the enterprise design system.
  • Integrate components from Storybook or other design libraries.
  • Implement accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design best practices.

5. Performance Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS).
  • Reduce bundle size using code splitting, lazy loading, and tree shaking.
  • Optimize rendering performance and memory usage.

6. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Write unit and integration tests using:
    • Jest
    • React Testing Library
  • Support end-to-end testing with Cypress or Playwright.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high-quality, maintainable code.

7. Security & Best Practices

  • Implement secure coding practices (input validation, XSS prevention, secure storage of tokens).
  • Follow best practices for API integration, routing, and data handling.
  • Collaborate with security teams to comply with enterprise security policies.

8. Collaboration & Agile Practices

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with React Lead, QA, DevOps, backend/BFF developers, and product teams.
  • Communicate technical challenges and propose solutions clearly.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years experience in frontend development.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • React.js (Hooks, Context, Custom Hooks)
    • Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, Routing, API routes)
    • TypeScript
    • HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS
  • Experience with:
    • State management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil)
    • RESTful APIs / GraphQL
    • Performance optimization and debugging
    • Unit & integration testing frameworks (Jest, RTL)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern build tools (Webpack, Vite).

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to debug complex issues.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Detail-oriented with focus on high-quality, maintainable code.

Education & Background

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Portfolio of web applications using React and Next.js preferred.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Role:Head of AI Enablement & Transformation
Company:Vulcury Consulting
Location:Flexible (U.S. preferred; remote with periodic collaboration)
Compensation:Base + revenue share + equity participation tied to practice performance

About Vulcury Consulting

Vulcury Consulting is the advisory and execution arm ofVulcury, a venture studio and consulting platform that builds and scales sophisticated businesses. Our consulting practice supports both external clients and internally incubated ventures across strategy, technology, operations, and growth.

Unlike traditional consultancies that focus on slide decks and recommendations, Vulcury is structured todesign and implement real systemsthat drive measurable business outcomes.

One of the most significant opportunities today isAI transformation—the replacement or augmentation of legacy software and manual workflows through agentic systems, intelligent automation, and modern AI infrastructure. Vulcury is building a dedicated practice focused on delivering these capabilities to clients.

The Opportunity

Vulcury is seeking aHead of AI Enablement & Transformationto build and lead our AI implementation practice.

This role is effectively the leader of atechnology implementation consultancy focused on deploying AI solutions. The practice will design and implement systems such as:

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate knowledge work

  • AI copilots that augment existing teams

  • AI-native tools replacing legacy SaaS platforms

  • AI-powered operational automation across departments

In many cases, Vulcury will bebuilding custom AI systems for clients, integrating LLMs, orchestration layers, APIs, and internal data systems.

The person in this role will lead bothclient development and delivery, building a profitable consulting vertical while leveraging Vulcury’s infrastructure, talent network, and venture studio ecosystem.

The role is designed for someonea few years out of an MBA or strategy/technology consulting careerwho recognizes that the traditional partnership track at large firms can take a decade. Instead, this person is excited tobuild a practice now, operating with significant autonomy and sharing directly in the upside created.

While candidates may eventually have built their own AI consultancy, the ideal person prefers toaccelerate that journey within Vulcury’s platform, gaining access to delivery infrastructure, technical collaborators, and an existing client ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Build and Lead the AI Transformation Practice

  • Establish and lead Vulcury’s AI enablement and transformation practice.

  • Define service offerings around:

    • Agentic workflow design and deployment

    • AI automation of operational processes

    • Replacement of legacy SaaS tools with AI-native systems

    • AI copilots for internal teams

    • AI infrastructure integration with existing data systems

  • Develop repeatable frameworks for assessing AI opportunities inside client organizations.

Client Development

  • Bring an initialclient network or book of businesswhere possible.

  • Develop new client relationships through thought leadership, partnerships, and targeted outreach.

  • Identify AI transformation opportunities within Vulcury’s consulting and venture studio ecosystem.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Lead the design of AI-enabled workflows and systems for client organizations.

  • Coordinate with Vulcury engineers, analysts, and technical specialists to build solutions.

  • Oversee deployment, testing, and iteration of AI systems within client environments.

Practice Economics

  • Own theP&L of the AI transformation practice.

  • Develop scalable delivery models combining advisory, engineering, and implementation.

  • Recruit and mentor technical consultants and AI specialists as the practice grows.

Advisory Strength in Agentic AI

The AI enablement practice will be supported by advisory input from asenior leader in agentic AI at a global financial institution, providing strategic perspective on emerging architectures and enterprise adoption patterns.

This relationship ensures the practice remains aligned withcutting-edge developments in AI-driven operational transformation.

What Makes This Different

This is not a traditional consulting job.

You will be:

  • Building and owning a new consulting practice

  • Delivering real AI systems rather than theoretical transformation plans

  • Leveraging Vulcury’s infrastructure rather than building from scratch

  • Participating directly in the upside you create

Instead of spending a decade navigating a consulting partnership track, this role offers the opportunity tobuild a high-value AI consulting franchise immediately.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is structured to reflect the entrepreneurial nature of the role.

Components may include:

  • Competitive base salary

  • Revenue share from AI consulting engagements

  • Equity or profit participation tied to practice performance

  • Participation in broader Vulcury upside depending on long-term role

Top performers in this role should expect compensationclosely aligned with the value they create for clients and the practice.

​

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for abuilder who understands both consulting and modern AI capabilities.

Typical background may include:

  • MBA from a leading program

  • 3–7 years experience in one or more of:

    • Strategy consulting

    • Technology consulting or digital transformation

    • AI implementation within a startup or enterprise

    • Building or deploying AI tools internally

  • Familiarity with modern AI architecture including:

    • LLM-based systems

    • agentic workflows

    • automation platforms

    • API integrations

  • Experience working with executive stakeholders on technology initiatives

  • Demonstrated ability to originate business or manage client relationships

The ideal candidate likely:

  • Has begun buildingclient relationships or advisory engagements

  • Recognizes the limits of large consulting firms

  • Is motivated byownership and autonomy

  • Wants to build a practice with real economic participation


Benefits

Why Join Vulcury

Vulcury is designed as a platform for builders.

You will have access to:

  • A venture studio launching new technology businesses

  • Existing consulting infrastructure and delivery teams

  • A network of engineers, analysts, and operators

  • Opportunities to design and deploy cutting-edge AI systems

For the right person, this role is an opportunity tobuild a modern AI implementation consultancy with meaningful ownership and long-term upside.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Mobile App Developer for a one-time, project-based engagement focused on the enhancement, optimization, and improvement of an existing mobile application.

The developer will be responsible for assessing the current application and its codebase, identifying performance issues and areas for improvement, implementing approved enhancements, and ensuring that existing functionalities remain stable and reliable. The role will involve debugging, code optimization, API integration, performance testing, and resolution of identified technical issues.

Responsibilities

  • Review and assess the existing mobile application's source code, architecture, functionality, and overall performance.
  • Identify technical issues, performance bottlenecks, bugs, and areas requiring improvement.
  • Enhance and optimize existing mobile application features based on the approved project requirements.
  • Improve application speed, responsiveness, stability, and overall user experience.
  • Refactor and optimize existing code to improve maintainability, efficiency, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve existing application bugs, crashes, errors, and technical issues.
  • Review and improve existing API integrations, database interactions, and backend connectivity, where applicable.
  • Implement approved enhancements and modifications without compromising existing application functionality.
  • Conduct functional, regression, compatibility, and performance testing after implementing enhancements.
  • Ensure that existing features remain operational following modifications and optimizations.
  • Identify potential technical risks and recommend practical solutions or improvements.
  • Prepare the optimized application build for deployment or release, where applicable.
  • Maintain proper version control of the modified source code.
  • Provide technical documentation covering the implemented changes and relevant technical recommendations.
  • Turn over the updated source code, documentation, credentials/access required for the project, and other agreed deliverables upon completion.
  • Provide agreed post-project support for identified bugs or issues arising from the completed enhancements.
  • Complete all project deliverables within the agreed project timeline and acceptance criteria.
Desirable Skills and Experiences
Must-haves
  • Proven experience in mobile application enhancement, maintenance, or optimization.
  • Demonstrable experience working with an existing mobile application or codebase.
  • Portfolio or relevant project samples showing previous mobile application development work.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following:
    • Flutter / Dart
    • React Native / JavaScript / TypeScript
    • Android / Kotlin / Java
    • iOS / Swift
  • Experience with API integration and backend connectivity.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Knowledge of application performance optimization and code refactoring.
  • Ability to understand and work with an existing codebase rather than developing an application entirely from scratch.
  • Willingness to provide the updated source code, technical documentation, and complete project turnover upon completion.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience optimizing applications with existing users or production deployments.
  • Experience resolving application crashes, slow performance, memory issues, and compatibility problems.
  • Experience with Firebase Crashlytics, Firebase Analytics, or similar monitoring tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Experience with Google Play Store and/or Apple App Store deployment.
  • Experience optimizing API calls, database queries, and network performance.
  • Experience working with legacy or previously developed mobile applications.
  • Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésCette fonction s’inscrit dans un environnement comprenant environ 800 applications, dont près de 400 applications web, basées sur des technologies et des prestataires variés.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Cette fonction s’inscrit dans un environnement comprenant environ 800 applications, dont près de 400 applications web, basées sur des technologies et des prestataires variés. Une maîtrise insuffisante de leur cycle de vie peut entraîner des interruptions de services, des compromissions de données ou de fonctionnalités, l’exploitation de vulnérabilités dans le code, les composants ou les configurations, ainsi qu’une augmentation de la dette technique, des risques d’obsolescence et des écarts de conformité.

Dans ce contexte, vous contribuez à une équipe dédiée au Secure Application Lifecycle Management (SALM), avec pour objectif de renforcer et d’automatiser la sécurité applicative sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie logiciel.

  • Déterminer la criticité des applications et les contrôles de sécurité à appliquer.
  • Réaliser les analyses de risques et assurer le suivi des mesures décidées selon la méthodologie en place.
  • Définir et faire évoluer les standards et bonnes pratiques de sécurité applicative.
  • Intégrer les contrôles de sécurité dans les projets et dans les chaînes DevSecOps/CI/CD.
  • Mettre en œuvre et exploiter des outils de sécurité applicative tels que SAST, DAST, SCA, la détection de secrets, les scans de vulnérabilités et les tests d’intrusion.
  • Analyser et qualifier les vulnérabilités en évaluant leur exploitabilité, leur impact, les faux positifs et leur niveau de priorité.
  • Suivre les dérogations, les risques résiduels et les recommandations avant la mise en production.
  • Assurer le suivi des vulnérabilités, de l’obsolescence et du décommissionnement des applications.
  • Accompagner les équipes de développement sur la sécurisation du code, des API, des dépendances logicielles, des conteneurs et de la gestion des secrets.
  • Produire une restitution technique claire, ainsi qu’une documentation structurée à destination des parties prenantes.

Vous collaborez étroitement avec les chefs de projet, développeurs, architectes, équipes d’exploitation, responsables fonctionnels, centres de services, équipes DevSecOps et SecOps, SOC, métiers et prestataires.

L’enjeu est de faire évoluer des contrôles encore ponctuels ou manuels vers une approche commune, proportionnée aux risques, davantage automatisée et couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie des applications.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant qu’IT Security Analyst.

Compétences essentielles :

  • Analyse et qualification des vulnérabilités : exploitabilité, impact, faux positifs et priorisation.
  • Architecture et sécurité applicative : flux, authentification, autorisation, chiffrement, API et dépendances.
  • Chaînes CI/CD et pratiques DevSecOps : intégration, paramétrage, automatisation et quality gates.
  • Outils de sécurité applicative : SAST, DAST, SCA, détection de secrets et scans de vulnérabilités.
  • Connaissance des référentiels techniques : OWASP Top 10, ASVS, SAMM, CWE, CVSS et NIST SSDF.
  • Capacité de restitution technique, de documentation et d’accompagnement des équipes de développement.
  • Bonne compréhension de la sécurité du développement, des API, des dépendances logicielles, des conteneurs et de la gestion des secrets.

Langue requise : français.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

jobs.description:
About Eve
Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

The Role

Eve is doubling revenue quarter over quarter, and the platform is being built to keep pace. A medallion architecture is in place on a Terraform-managed Snowflake footprint. Most of what goes on top is still ahead: ingestion and orchestration built for the volume coming, reliability practice, the access and governance model, and the standards every contributor works inside.

The data spans product usage, case and firm data, and every go-to-market system Eve runs on. Analytics engineers and business analysts build models and reporting on top of it, AI agents query it directly, and leadership makes calls on it weekly. When a pipeline fails quietly, all three inherit the mistake.

You'll own the pipelines carrying all of that, end to end, from an ambiguous ask through to production. Moving nightly rebuilds onto incremental patterns. Deciding how a new source gets ingested and what happens when it changes shape. Building the alerting that catches a broken model before anyone downstream does, and being the one who picks it up when it breaks.

You'll have real say in how the platform gets built. You'll work on our central team and report to the Head of Data Engineering, who reports directly to the CEO. Data is a first-class function at Eve and the fuel to drive our future growth.

What You'll Do

Build and run the platform

  • Own ingestion through Fivetran, third-party connectors, and custom extraction where no connector exists
  • Own orchestration across dbt platform and GitHub Actions, own materialization strategy and model performance, move critical models off nightly full rebuilds onto incremental patterns, and cut latency where decisions are waiting on stale data
  • Build source-schema change detection, so an upstream field change surfaces as an alert before it reaches a report
  • Stand up observability: freshness SLAs on critical tables, alerting on failure and drift, and an incident path with clear ownership
  • Be a first responder when pipelines break, and drive the fix upstream so the same failure doesn't recur
  • Manage pipeline compute cost, and make the tradeoffs between freshness and spend explicit rather than accidental
  • Share Snowflake administration: implementing the role-based access model, security and network policies, data masking and PII controls, and storage organization
  • Extend the medallion architecture and the Terraform-managed footprint, including full separation of development and production
  • Contribute to the foundational modeling layer the Analytics Engineers build on: source-to-staging patterns, conformed dimensions, shared entities, and SCD patterns that make history reliable

Raise the bar

  • Build and maintain the development environments and CI that let analysts contribute models safely, and review their contributions so more of the company can build on the foundation
  • Build the tooling and setup that gets a new engineer or analyst productive in days, not weeks
  • Administer the data tooling stack: access, integrations, and the connective work between systems
  • Use AI-assisted development as part of how you work: Claude Code skills, agents, and evals, held to the same review bar as anything else
  • Document as you build. If it isn't written down, it isn't done

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in data engineering, owning production systems other people depended on
  • Strong Python and SQL, with production experience across ingestion (Fivetran or similar), orchestration (dbt platform, GitHub Actions, or Airflow), and cloud infrastructure
  • Solid Snowflake: access control, warehouse sizing, query performance, and cost management
  • Practical dbt: incremental models, testing, macros, and a git-based workflow with CI. Experience building SCD tables from multiple sources
  • Comfort in a Terraform-managed environment. Infrastructure changes go through code review here, not the Snowflake console
  • You've built reliability practice where none existed: alerting, freshness SLAs, incident response, schema change detection
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development such as Claude Code, including agentic pipeline design and skill-based workflows, and comfort integrating tools via MCP servers
  • Able to tell a stakeholder what broke, what it affected, and when it'll be fixed, without the jargon
  • Comfort building where the playbook doesn't exist yet

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in a regulated or high-sensitivity data environment (legal, healthcare, financial services)
  • Experience with streaming or near-real-time ingestion, and knowing when it isn't worth it
  • Exposure to Iceberg, Parquet, or unstructured data at scale
  • B2B SaaS, especially selling to small and mid-sized businesses or professional services firms

Wanted: Controller - 12 month contract

Do you enjoy turning financial complexity into clarity? Do you instinctively look around corners for risk, opportunity, and what the numbers are really telling you? Does understanding the details within the general ledger bring you joy? If so, we’re looking for you!

You:

We:

  • Work to protect and restore the environment
  • Aren't afraid to make mistakes as long as we learn
  • Care more about your values and intelligence than your experience
  • Are committed to creating team dynamics that create empowerment vs. entitlement

Our Core Values:

  1. Commit to a culture that builds a strong COMMUNITY
  2. Foster CREATIVITY to inspire fresh innovation
  3. Embrace COURAGE by taking action despite uncertainty
  4. Live with Awareness and CONSCIOUSNESS of our choices

We're a Kelowna-born, Certified B Corporation on a simple mission: make everyday products that help people waste less. With team members in Canada, the US, China and the Philippines, we're a small, scrappy crew doing big things!

The Opportunity:

As our Controller, you’ll help us maintain a close pulse on the business — cash, costs, margins, forecasts and risk — while ensuring our accounting fundamentals are exceptionally well managed. You’ll be comfortable getting into the details, questioning assumptions, identifying issues early and helping leaders understand the financial implications of the decisions in front of them.

Working through others to achieve timely and accurate results, this role will require an individual that thrives in an environment of continuous improvement and collaborative problem-solving. If you are a leader who is passionate about bringing clarity, control and sound financial judgment to a business, this role is for you.

The Responsibilities:

Financial Management & Stewardship

  • Maintain a strong and accurate financial foundation, ensuring leaders have clear visibility into the financial health of the business.
  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, cash management and the effective use of our accounting systems.
  • Maintain and strengthen financial policies, processes and internal controls that safeguard company assets, improve accuracy and support disciplined financial management.
  • Keep a close pulse on cash flow, working capital, expenses and financial commitments, identifying emerging risks or concerns early.
  • Partner with department leaders to strengthen financial acumen, improve accountability to budgets and better understand how operational decisions impact the bottom line.
  • Look for practical opportunities to simplify processes, reduce unnecessary costs and improve the quality and efficiency of financial operations.

Financial Reporting, Controls & Compliance

  • Deliver accurate, timely and decision-useful monthly financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets and cash flow reporting.
  • Own the monthly close process and preparation or review of supporting reconciliations, schedules and documentation.
  • Analyze revenue, gross margin, operating expenses and balance sheet movements, identifying variances, trends and areas requiring attention.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements and financial reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate with external accountants, auditors and other financial partners, ensuring audit and year-end requirements are well prepared and efficiently managed.
  • Oversee required tax, government and regulatory filings and ensure deadlines and financial obligations are consistently met.

Forecasting & Financial Planning

  • Maintain practical, forward-looking financial forecasts that give leadership an early view of cash requirements, financial risks and changes in business performance.
  • Support the annual budgeting process and regularly compare actual performance against budget and forecast.
  • Pressure-test assumptions and help leadership understand the financial implications of business decisions before commitments are made.
  • Translate financial results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for the leadership team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve margins, manage costs, strengthen cash position and increase operational efficiency.

Finance Team Leadership

  • Provide clear direction, oversight and support to the Finance team, ensuring strong execution of core accounting responsibilities.
  • Establish appropriate rhythms, accountabilities and controls so that financial work is accurate, timely and dependable.
  • Coach and develop team members while remaining willing to step into the details when the business requires it.
  • Foster a Finance function that is collaborative, responsive and comfortable asking thoughtful questions in service of better business decisions.

We’re flexible on what the right partnership looks like. This could be a part-time employee or a fractional/contract finance partner able to dedicate a consistent Controller who will get to know our business, our team and our numbers deeply.

Qualifications:

  • CPA designation is required
  • Proven experience as a Controller or similar role, preferably in a physical product, ecommerce or retail environment
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and variance analysis.
  • Proficient in Netsuite, or similar large ERP and comfort with financial software systems and tools;
  • Desire to drive projects forward.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Strong leadership abilities with the ability to inspire and motivate a small team.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating across diverse teams.

Commitment to Diversity

Pela & Lomi are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We value unique perspectives and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart's Growth team is dedicated to creating a seamless product experience that allows customers to effortlessly discover and access Upstart's credit products, both for the first time and on an ongoing basis. By building exceptional, customer-centric experiences, this team plays a crucial role in making Upstart the premier destination for consumer credit, driving growth and unifying Upstart's product portfolio into a cohesive, multi-product marketplace.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will own the strategy and evolution of Upstart's end-to-end credit conversion experience, helping users move from intent, to the right credit offering, to approval and funding. You'll identify and solve the highest-leverage points of friction across the funnel, creating an experience that feels intelligently matched, transparent, and human while driving meaningful growth for the business.

  • Own and evolve the strategy for Upstart's end-to-end conversion experience, from application start through offer acceptance and beyond.

  • Set the success metrics for your area and use them to prioritize the highest-ROI opportunities, experimenting where an experiment is the right way to decide.
  • Turn data into decisions, segmenting aggressively since aggregate conversion rates often mask very different user problems.
  • Build deep customer understanding alongside research, consumer insights, and product marketing so the borrower experience feels intuitive and human.
  • Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, analytics, ML, marketing, compliance, and executive leadership, creating clarity where ownership crosses teams.

    • Demonstrated success materially improving a complex conversion funnel through a combination of product strategy, experimentation, analytics, and customer insight, with a track record of leading a team to specific KPIs (e.g., conversion improvements, revenue)
    • Exceptional quantitative judgment, with the ability to assess funnel data, segment behavior, size opportunities, interpret experiments, and recognize unintended downstream effects
    • Strong experimentation instincts, including hypothesis development, experiment design, A/B testing, funnel and results analysis, and knowing when a test is (or is not) the right decision-making mechanism
    • Strong consumer product intuition, particularly around high-consideration decisions involving trust, uncertainty, or meaningful tradeoffs
    • Ability to move fluidly, and quickly, between strategic questions (“What fundamentally prevents users from getting what they came for?”) and detailed product questions (“What exactly should happen on this screen for this user segment?”)
    • Track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives and aligning diverse stakeholders, from executive leaders to cross-functional partners, without relying on organizational authority
    • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear priorities and decisions

jobs.description:
The Trust and Entity Review Specialist is a critical part of the Non-Agency/Non-QM mortgage process, responsible for reviewing and validating borrower entity documentation, including Limited Liability Companies (LLCs), Partnerships, Corporations, and Trusts—to ensure compliance with internal underwriting standards and applicable agency and investor guidelines. This role ensures all entity and trust structures are appropriately documented, authorized, and compliant before loans move forward to underwriting or closing. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, solid understanding of business and trust structures, and familiarity with Non-QM and Non-Agency lending requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate documentation for LLCs, Corporations, Partnerships, and Trusts, including but not limited to: Articles of Organization/Incorporation, Operating Agreements, Partnership Agreements, Trust Agreements, Corporate Resolutions, EIN documentation, and Certificates of Good Standing.
  • Confirm that business entities and trusts are valid, active, and properly documented and registered as applicable.
  • Ensure authorized signers and trustees are clearly identified and have authority to act on behalf of the entity or trust.
  • Identify missing, inconsistent, or non-compliant documentation, and communicate with internal teams to resolve issues promptly.
  • Analyze entity and trust structures to ensure alignment with internal policies and applicable agency and investor guidelines.
  • Collaborate closely with underwriters, processors, and closers to ensure entity and trust documentation is complete prior to loan decision or funding.
  • Maintain accurate documentation logs and support QC and post-close audit efforts related to entity and trust eligibility.
  • Stay informed of updates to agency and investor guidelines, compliance standards, and internal procedures impacting entity and trust borrowers.
  • Support internal team training and act as a subject matter resource for trust and entity documentation-related questions.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Legal Studies, Finance, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mortgage operations or underwriting, with Non-QM or Non-Agency product experience strongly preferred.
  • Proficient in reviewing and interpreting a variety of business and trust entity documents.
  • Familiarity with Non-QM underwriting processes and applicable agency and investor requirements.
  • Highly detail-oriented with excellent analytical and documentation skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proficiency in mortgage LOS platforms (e.g., Encompass) and standard office applications (Microsoft Office, Adobe PDF tools, etc.).
  • Familiarity with legal documentation for trusts or other complex entity structures is a plus.
  • Prior experience validating signer authority for corporate, partnership, and trust entities.
  • Understanding of Secretary of State business search tools and public entity verification processes.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).
