jobs.excerpt: Pay: $100–$150/hour Location: Global, fully remote Job Type: Contract (~15 hours per week) Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.
jobs.description:
Pay: $100–$150/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contract (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

This role is designed for experienced ML engineers and researchers who understand the systems beneath high-level APIs. Candidates should have meaningful practical experience with multiple tools from the modern ML stack and be able to explain what they personally built, optimized, or operated.

What You’ll Work On

  • Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.

  • Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.

  • Work with tensor operations, automatic differentiation, model architectures, tokenization, batching, and generation.

  • Optimize training or inference for latency, throughput, memory usage, and hardware utilization.

  • Diagnose numerical instability, incorrect tensor behavior, memory bottlenecks, distributed-system failures, and performance regressions.

  • Compare model implementations and determine whether results are correct and reproducible.

  • Review AI-generated code and technical solutions for correctness, efficiency, and engineering quality.

  • Design objective tests, benchmarks, and verification criteria.

  • Clearly document technical decisions, trade-offs, and limitations.

Required Qualifications

  • A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

  • Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.

  • Practical proficiency withPython.

  • Meaningful experience with at least two relevant ML frameworks, libraries, or inference tools.

  • Strong understanding of model training, evaluation, numerical computation, or inference.

  • Ability to debug ML systems beyond surface-level API usage.

  • Ability to explain implementation decisions, performance trade-offs, and failure modes clearly.

  • Experience building reproducible technical workflows.

Relevant tools may include:

  • PyTorch

  • JAX

  • NumPy and SciPy

  • SGLang

  • vLLM

  • llama.cpp

  • Hugging Face Transformers

  • Hugging Face Tokenizers

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.

  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

  • Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

  • Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Role Purpose

The Advocacy Officer supports the implementation of MenEngage Global Alliance’s advocacy strategy. The role contributes to the Alliance’s advocacy work by assisting with policy monitoring, coordination of advocacy activities, and the production of analytical and broader communications materials. The position works under the guidance of the Advocacy Manager and in close collaboration with the wider team.

Key Functions
​

  • Support the Advocacy Manager and other team members on key advocacy-related activities and projects

  • Support the strategizing, coordination, and participation in various global and regional advocacy spaces and initiatives, in coordination with AWG and regional networks, and in accompanying members in national advocacy efforts

  • Assist development of accessible materials that translate advocacy-related outcomes into actionable insights for Alliance members.

  • Monitor relevant policy processes and provide timely analysis for internal and external use.

  • Support the organization of advocacy learning and capacity-strengthening spaces for Alliance members.


Requirements

Primary Responsibilities

Policy Monitoring, Analysis, and Influencing

  • Track outcomes of relevant global and regional advocacy activities

  • Prepare concise updates, analytical notes, and summaries for circulation across the Alliance.

  • Contribute to monitoring and maintaining updated mappings of normative frameworks within the Alliance’s thematic priorities as related to men and masculinities.

  • Support drafting of policy briefs and agendas on various priority themes as related to men and masculinities.

  • Assist in outreach to policymakers and actors towards the vision of policy influencing.

Advocacy Coordination

  • Support planning and organization of advocacy events, consultations, and learning sessions.

  • Coordinate members’ participation in advocacy spaces and initiatives, including mobilization, information sharing, and support during advocacy events.

  • Maintain the Alliance’s advocacy calendar, including global and regional advocacy moments aligned with the strategic plan.

  • Convene and document internal advocacy meetings, ensuring accurate minutes and follow-up.

  • Support the Advocacy Manager with hosting various advocacy working groups.

  • Maintain Alliance-wide advocacy organizing, and information-sharing spaces.

Solidarity Actions

  • Monitor upcoming advocacy campaigns, sign-ons, activism, and priority spaces led by members, partners, and feminist advocacy collectives.

  • Share relevant opportunities, support coordination and engagement with external movements, and maintain communication flow with the team.

  • Facilitate regional engagement, relationship building and leadership

Communications and Knowledge Dissemination

  • Collaborate with the Advocacy Manager and Communications team to capture the Alliance’s engagement in global and regional advocacy spaces and develop accessible, timely communications, including social media and other public channels.

  • Support identification and coordination of regional and national advocacy case studies and highlighting advocates’ work at global level.

  • Assist in drafting policy briefs, advocacy updates, concept notes and related communication products.

  • Support efforts to elevate regional and national advocacy knowledge products at the global level.

Working Relationships
​

  • Reports to: Advocacy Manager

  • Collaborates with: GS team members,

  • Engages with: advocacy working group members, regional coordinators, country networks, member organisations

External-Facing Summary

The Advocacy Officer supports the implementation and development of the Alliance’s advocacy agenda. The role includes policy monitoring, research, and the development of analysis and communication materials, helping translate complex policy outcomes into accessible insights for members and partners. The Advocacy Officer coordinates advocacy activities and events, supports member participation in policy spaces, and strengthens the Alliance’s collective capacity to influence gender justice, women’s rights, and the transformation of patriarchal masculinities through policy changes. The role works closely with the Advocacy Manager, Global Secretariat colleagues, and regional and national networks to advance evidence-based advocacy and collaborative action.


Benefits

A supportive, inclusive, and values-driven working environment rooted in gender equality, social justice, climate justice, and human rights.

  • Annual Leave: 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

  • Sick Leave: 6 days of paid sick leave annually.

  • Local holidays: 12 days of local public holidays in the country of residence.

  • Year-End Break: Offices are closed between Christmas and New Year as a token of appreciation for the team’s commitment and hard work throughout the year.

  • Flexible Working: We embrace a flexible, trust-based work culture that supports healthy work–life balance, remote collaboration, and personal well-being.

  • Compensation: MenEngage Alliance offers competitive salaries aligned with the cost of living and salary benchmarks in the employee’s country and region of residence.

MenEngage Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. We are deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and strongly encourage applications from individuals of all genders, sexual orientations, races, ethnicities, abilities, and backgrounds — particularly those from historically marginalized or underrepresented communities.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub, we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

This is an affirmative position for People with Disabilities.

Why do we have affirmative positions?

We believe in fostering diversity and nurturing an inclusive workplace where everyone has equal access to opportunities to reach their full potential. For us to succeed in our mission, diverse perspectives are essential. We want every person at Wellhub to feel welcomed, valued, and empowered.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Analyst - Affirmative position for People with Disabilities (PwD/PcD) to our GlobalTalent Acquisition team in Brazil! This is an affirmative job opportunity forPeople with Disability

  • All candidates who self-identify as People with Disabilities (PwD/PcD Pessoas com Deficiência), according to applicable Brazilian legislation, may be evaluated for this role.

This role is part of our Talent Acquisition team within the People department, dedicated to attracting, engaging, and hiring top-tier talent globally. As a Talent Acquisition Analyst, you will directly impact our company's growth by managing full-cycle recruitment for non-technical business roles, partnering closely with hiring managers, and driving innovative sourcing and diversity strategies to build a high-performing, inclusive workforce.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Execute the end-to-end recruitment process for global non-technical business roles across various levels, leading job briefings, candidate sourcing, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding coordination with PeopleOps and PeopleBPs.
  • Partner closely with Hiring Managers by leading kickoff meetings to align on hiring needs, evaluation criteria, and timelines, while ensuring hiring teams adhere to SLAs and scorecard submissions.

  • Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion by actively sourcing from underrepresented talent pools and mitigating biases throughout the recruitment cycle.
  • Ensure full compliance with local labor laws, regulations, and country-specific recruitment guidelines across all hiring activities.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through timely communication, constructive feedback, and professional representation of Wellhub’s brand and culture.
  • Identify recruitment process bottlenecks and propose continuous improvements to boost team efficiency and meet or exceed Wellhub TA OKRs.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A talent acquisition professional with previous experience in full-cycle recruitment across non-technical or business disciplines.
  • Advanced English communicator (both written and verbal) who can partner seamlessly with global candidates, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • A strategic and analytical thinker with strong business acumen and HR expertise, capable of turning talent insights into actionable hiring strategies.
  • A relationship builder with solid negotiation skills and a focus on delivering against SLAs in a fast-paced environment.
  • An advocate for diversity and inclusion who brings a thoughtful, unbiased approach to candidate evaluation and pipeline building.
  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), particularly Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines efficiently is a plus.
  • A professional holding a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).

We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in full-cycle recruitment and advanced level of English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

Role Description

Dropbox’s Virtual First team researches, tests, and scales better ways of working for a distributed organization. We combine organizational research, experimentation, behavioral science, technology, and employee experience to continuously improve how Dropboxers work—wherever they are.

As a Senior Program Manager, Employee Experience, you will own a strategic Virtual First work stream focused on tool optimization and technology-enabled ways of working, identifying opportunities to improve employee effectiveness and translating those opportunities into research, experiments, recommendations, and scalable organizational change.

This role combines program management with research, innovation, and cross-functional stakeholder management. You will manage a portfolio of interconnected programs rather than a single project, with particular focus on knowledge management, AI enablement, and building employee confidence with tools and technology. You will establish research priorities, design and facilitate experiments, synthesize findings, and work with partners across Dropbox to turn evidence into better ways of working.

Success in this role means creating new knowledge, translating that knowledge into clear recommendations, and driving measurable improvements in employee effectiveness, tool confidence, and adoption of AI-enabled and technology-supported ways of working.

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of a Virtual First workstream focused on technology, including tools, workflows, automations, AI enablement, and knowledge management
  • Design and lead organizational research, pilots, and experiments that test new ways of working
  • Translate qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable recommendations, behavioral frameworks, and operating models for downstream adoption
  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent programs and initiatives from initial scoping through research, validation, and enablement planning
  • Establish clear objectives, success measures, milestones, risks, and reporting across the workstream
  • Facilitate cross-functional Steering Committees and initiatives involving stakeholders across People, Technology, Communications, Operations, and other business functions
  • Partner with People Analytics and other measurement experts to establish research methodologies and evaluate outcomes.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, organizational effectiveness, workplace strategy, employee experience, innovation, research, or a related discipline.
  • Expertise in tools and technology enablement, including AI adoption, knowledge management, digital workflows, automation, and the design of technology-enabled ways of working that improve employee effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs from ambiguity through measurable outcomes.
  • Experience designing and managing research, pilots, experiments, or other evidence-based innovation programs.
  • Strong understanding of Virtual First, distributed, hybrid, or modern ways of working.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a distributed or Virtual First organization.
  • Experience with organizational behavior, change management, behavioral science, workplace research, or human-centered design.
  • Demonstrated curiosity about the future of work and emerging technologies.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a growing US-based non-emergency medical transportation provider, helping people with mobility needs get safely to medical appointments and essential destinations. The business is focused on reliable service and efficient operations, and is now looking to strengthen its systems, embrace AI, and support its growing team.

Role Overview: We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Executive Assistant with strong AI and technology skills to support the leadership team of a growing US-based non-emergency medical transportation business.

This is more than a traditional EA role. The right person will be someone who can learn how the business operates, identify bottlenecks, use AI and automation to improve processes, and take things off the founder’s plate without always being asked.

The role will primarily focus on executive and administrative support, with some dispatch and booking backup during busy periods. Most booking activity is expected to be handled through an AI-powered system, with the successful candidate stepping in when human support is required.

Key Responsibilities:

Executive & Administrative Support

  • Manage and triage the founder’s inbox, including HR-related and general inbound emails
  • Organise, prioritise and file emails and information appropriately
  • Follow up on outstanding tasks, requests and issues to keep things moving
  • Take ownership of day-to-day administrative items and proactively identify things that need attention
  • Support the GM and Director of Operations with administrative tasks as required
  • Help reduce bottlenecks by taking ownership of tasks that would otherwise remain on the leadership team’s plate

Insurance & Claims Follow-Up

  • Follow up on outstanding insurance claims and related enquiries
  • Track claim progress and maintain clear records
  • Communicate with relevant parties to obtain updates and resolve outstanding items
  • Escalate issues when required and ensure follow-ups don't fall through the cracks

AI, Automation & Technology

  • Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and other automation platforms to improve day-to-day workflows
  • Help identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative processes
  • Assist with the adoption of AI tools across the business
  • Help build a culture of using technology and automation to work more efficiently
  • Learn and work within the company’s EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) processes and dashboards
  • Help monitor KPI dashboards and flag anything that requires attention
  • Support the implementation and rollout of Salesforce CRM
  • Help organise and improve digital systems and workflows as the business grows

File & Systems Organisation

  • Reorganise and maintain the company’s SharePoint drive and folder structure
  • Improve how documents and information are stored and accessed
  • Help establish practical systems for keeping information organised

Dispatch & Booking Backup

  • Provide backup support for dispatch and booking during peak periods
  • Monitor incoming booking or dispatch requests and assist when human intervention is required
  • Support the existing AI-powered booking process and step in when issues need to be resolved manually
  • Assist with dispatch-related administration and communication as needed
  • Provide additional support during busy periods, staff shortages or other operational bottlenecks

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is proactive rather than purely task-driven.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Operations Assistant, Administrative Assistant or similar
  • Have experience supporting a founder, executive or senior leadership team
  • Be highly organised and comfortable managing multiple priorities
  • Have excellent written and verbal English
  • Be confident using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT
  • Understand how AI and automation can be used to improve business processes
  • Be comfortable learning new software and systems quickly
  • Have strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Be comfortable working independently without needing constant direction
  • Be confident following up with people and keeping tasks moving
  • Have a practical, problem-solving mindset
  • Be willing to learn how the business operates and proactively identify ways to help

Dispatch / Operations Experience

Experience in any of the following would be highly regarded:

  • Dispatch or transportation coordination
  • Booking or scheduling
  • Logistics or fleet coordination
  • Customer service in a transport or healthcare environment
  • Non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT)
  • Working with dispatch, scheduling or booking software
  • Supporting an operations team in a fast-paced environment

You don't need to have experience in every area. We're particularly interested in someone who can combine strong administrative skills with initiative, technology skills and a willingness to learn.

The Right Mindset

This role is intentionally not a tightly defined checklist of tasks.

We're looking for someone who can come in, learn how the business works, understand where the pressure points are and start taking ownership.

For example, rather than waiting to be told that a KPI needs attention, the right person might notice something has changed, investigate it and flag it to the appropriate person.

Likewise, if a repetitive administrative process can be improved with AI or automation, we'd want this person to identify the opportunity and help implement a better way of doing it.

Initiative, ownership and curiosity will be just as important as previous job titles.

Working Hours

  • Must be available to work US Central Time business hours
  • Remote / work-from-home

Compensation

USD 1,500–2,000 per month, depending on experience and capabilities.

There may also be an opportunity for an additional performance-based incentive or bonus structure following an initial 30–60 day performance review. This would be tied to agreed goals and performance outcomes.

Engagement

  • Independent Contractor Agreement (ICA)
  • Long-term opportunity for the right person
  • Direct engagement with the business
  • Clear performance expectations and agreed contract terms

Why This Role Is Different

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be more than an administrative pair of hands.

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with leadership, influence how technology and AI are used within the business, improve systems and processes, and take genuine ownership of areas that make a difference to the day-to-day operation.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.companyName: New Left Accelerator and The Capacity Shop
jobs.description:
About NLA and TCS

New Left Accelerator (NLA) and its 501(c)(3) affiliate, The Capacity Shop (TCS) are leaders in the growing field of operations capacity building. Since 2016, we have developed specialized programs, training, tools, and resources designed to ensure social justice organizations are prepared to execute bold, compliant work and manage risk in today’s high-threat environment.

To achieve systemic change, organizations must use every tool in their toolbox effectively—including multi-entity structures, which use more than one legal entity to execute their work. Our program's tools and resources are specifically designed for multi-entity organizations to bridge the gap between ambitious strategy and operational excellence, ensuring leaders can scale their impact without sacrificing legal compliance.

Through deep collaboration across operations, safety, and security, we support organizations, movements, and ecosystems to build operational resilience.

Overview

NLA and TCS raise a combination of 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) funding to support their programs and operations. The Executive Director leads the organizations’ fundraising efforts in collaboration with staff and external partners. We are seeking an experienced Senior Fundraising Manager to provide temporary, hands-on capacity for fundraising coordination, grant proposals and reports, data tracking, and executive support.

Working closely with the Executive Director and other teams, they will coordinate proposals and reports, maintain accurate fundraising data in Airtable and spreadsheets, and ensure priorities and next steps continue moving forward. This role will also serve as a key partner to the Executive Director by preparing meeting and conference materials, anticipating what information or decisions require their attention, and providing high-level updates.

This is a temporary, non-exempt position and is eligible for overtime with supervisor approval. The schedule offers some flexibility, and we will consider candidates available to work either an average of 30 (part-time) or 40 (full-time) hours per week. Candidates may maintain other professional engagements, provided those commitments do not create a conflict of interest or interfere with the responsibilities and agreed-upon schedule of this role. We will prioritize candidates who can begin as soon as possible.

We will be conducting interviews on a rolling basis. The priority application deadline is September 18, 2026.

Responsibilities

Grant Proposals & Reports

  • Draft, edit, and finalize grant and major-donor proposals, letters of inquiry, and renewal requests for both the c3 and c4 entities
  • Ensure grant proposals and reporting are completed by the required deadlines
  • Coordinate with the Finance & Operations team to ensure grant proposal budgets reflect the grant narrative
  • Maintain the Airtable to track and monitor grant proposals, deadlines, reports, and relevant documentation

Fundraising Strategic Support & Tracking

  • Draft fundraising priorities each quarter for the Executive Director, and adjust priorities as circumstances change
  • Document NLA and TCS fundraising goals, commitments, received funds, and funding gaps across both entities
  • Maintain fundraising data and tracking systems, including accurate and timely updates in Airtable
  • Support the Executive Director with developing plans and proposals to address identified funding gaps
  • Stay updated with the program team to keep up to date on the work and priorities that inform our fundraising strategy
  • Work with Executive Director to design and run the end-of-year campaign
  • Facilitate and lead the weekly Fundraising meetings

Funder Engagement Support

  • Support the Executive Director in planning public appearances, including funder conferences, Philanthropic Service Organizations (PSO) events, and in-house funder invitations
  • Prepare briefing materials, talking points, meeting schedules, and funder-facing materials for priority conferences and funder engagements.
  • Prepare funder-facing messaging materials including fundraising collateral
  • Prepare written prospect research profiles on current and prospective funders.
  • Set agendas and prepare follow-up materials for donor meetings and funder briefings, looping in the team as needed.
  • Maintain the conference calendar, track relevant fundraising and sector events, and recommend attendance based on funder relationships and prospecting opportunities.
  • Manage tracking and donor acknowledgment for individual donors
  • Write the annual impact report and other funder-facing narrative documents.
  • Write thank-you and acknowledgment language and follow through to ensure gifts are acknowledged promptly, coordinating with the team where needed to get them out the door.

Qualifications

  • At least 8 years of relevant fundraising experience, including significant responsibility for foundation fundraising and grant management
  • Strong understanding of and commitment to social justice and movement-building work
  • Experience developing accurate grant proposals, reports, and funder-facing materials using existing organizational language and program information
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, particularly grant proposals, reports, and funder communications
  • Strong project management skills and ability to independently drive work from start to finish
  • Exceptional attention to detail, including comfort working with fundraising data, budgets, and tracking systems
  • Experience partnering closely with executive leadership and coordinating input across program, finance, and operations teams
  • Ability to translate complex programs, strategies, and impact into clear, persuasive narratives for varied audiences
  • Experience with Airtable or similar fundraising/project-management systems preferred
  • Existing relationships with institutional funders are a plus, but not required

Compensation, Benefits, and Position Details

Title: Senior Fundraising Manager

Reports to: Executive Director

Hours: Generally Monday through Friday between the hours of 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m in local U.S. time zone

Classification: Temporary, Non-Exempt, Full-time or Part-time

Location: Remote, U.S.-based (applicants must reside and be able to legally work in the United States); Some domestic travel may be required (2-3 times per year)

Compensation: $44.70-$52.16 per hour, depending on experience

Benefits: NLA offers a competitive benefits package available to all full-time employees, including:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Short-term Disability, and Health FSA
  • Flexible paid time off, including vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, 1-week summer break, and 1-week winter break
  • Professional development stipend
  • Working from home stipend
  • Retirement plan with up to 4% matching

jobs.title: Intake Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: At Carelinks ABA, the Intake Coordinator is often one of the very first people a family interacts with on their journey with us.
jobs.description:
At Carelinks ABA, the Intake Coordinator is often one of the very first people a family interacts with on their journey with us. We take that responsibility seriously. We need someone who can clearly and confidently explain what ABA is, what services can look like, and what families can expect from the process, especially to parents who may be completely new to ABA and already overwhelmed by everything coming their way. You don't need to be a clinician, but you do need to understand ABA well enough to speak about it comfortably, answer common questions, and help families feel informed and confident about taking the next step.

We're looking for someone who genuinely owns the intake process from the first inquiry through enrollment. This isn't a role for someone who waits for a task to land in their inbox. We need someone who sees what needs to happen next, takes initiative, follows up relentlessly, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

You'll be juggling multiple families at different stages of the intake process at any given time. Some will need paperwork. Some will need insurance information sorted out. Some will need a phone call. And sometimes, you'll need to figure out what's holding things up and find a way to get things moving again.

The right person is organized, warm, persistent, and comfortable working independently. You should have a natural sense of urgency and, most importantly, you close the loop.

What You'll Own

  • Manage the intake pipeline from initial inquiry through enrollment.
  • Respond quickly to families, prospective clients, and referral sources interested in ABA services.
  • Clearly explain ABA services and the intake process to prospective families, including those who may have little or no prior understanding of ABA.
  • Proactively follow up by phone, text, and email. We don't let leads sit.
  • Make sure every active intake has a clear next step and follow-up plan.
  • Build relationships with families and help guide them through what can sometimes feel like an overwhelming process.
  • Work closely with our Operations and Care Coordination teams to determine eligibility, service needs, and next steps.
  • Coordinate intake appointments and other required appointments.
  • Keep accurate, up-to-date records of every intake, including communication, referral information, follow-up attempts, documentation, and next steps.
  • Prepare, collect, and track intake forms, consent forms, and other required documentation.
  • Make sure paperwork is completed accurately and on time.
  • Spot stalled intakes, missing information, or other barriers—and take the initiative to figure out how to resolve them.
  • Stay involved until the family is successfully handed off to Care Coordination and moving toward the start of services.
  • Take ownership of every lead until there is an outcome. An intake should never disappear into a black hole.
  • Look for ways to make our intake process faster, smoother, and better for families.
  • Pitch in wherever needed. We're a growing company, and "that's not my job" isn't really our thing.

Who We're Looking For

    We're less concerned about checking every box on a résumé and more interested in finding someone who has the right mindset.

    You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

    • Are naturally organized and can keep track of a lot of moving pieces.
    • Are proactive—you don't need someone reminding you three times to follow up.
    • Have a strong sense of urgency and understand that families are waiting for care.
    • Can learn and understand ABA well enough to explain it confidently and accurately to families.
    • Are persistent without losing the warmth and compassion families deserve.
    • Communicate clearly and professionally by phone, text, and email.
    • Enjoy solving problems rather than simply pointing them out.
    • Can work independently and take genuine ownership of your responsibilities.
    • Are comfortable being held accountable for results, not just activity.
    • Learn new systems and technology quickly.
    • Care about creating a great experience for families.

Experience

    Experience in intake, admissions, recruiting, sales, customer service, healthcare, behavioral health, or another fast-paced, people-facing role is preferred.

    Experience working with insurance payors, including commercial insurance and Medicaid, is a big plus. Previous ABA experience is strongly preferred, particularly if you've worked directly with families and understand how to explain ABA services in a clear, approachable way.

    A bachelor's degree in psychology, social work, counseling, or a related field is preferred, but we're absolutely open to the right person without one.

About Carelinks ABA

    Carelinks was built around a pretty simple idea: families seeking ABA shouldn't feel like they're just another name on a waitlist.

    We provide compassionate, naturalistic ABA therapy and believe the experience surrounding the care matters too. From the first phone call through the start of services, we want families to feel that there are real people on the other side who care, communicate, and get things done.

    That's where this role comes in.

    If you're someone who takes ownership, loves getting things across the finish line, and wants your work to actually matter to the families you're helping, we'd love to hear from you.

Project Name:

JIMS 3.0 (Justice Information Management System)

Scope:

Justice Information Management System (JIMS) 3.0 is a data integration project aimed to amalgamate, re-design and implement several disjointed reporting data marts containing court data into an Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and a set of dependent data mart and views. This project will replace the existing six stand-alone IBM Cognos BI data marts JIMS, Crown File Ownership (CFO), Court Case Management (CCM), Courtroom Utilization, Courtroom Activity, and Case Adjournment) with a well-integrated data warehouse. The existing data marts extract, process, re-structure and aggregate data required for strategic, operational and ad hoc reporting of court data stored in the Justice Online Information Network (JOIN) database. The goal of the project is to evolve availability, governance and reporting of court data by implementing a more efficient, user-friendly, faster and cost-effective reporting architecture. The following benefits will be realized through the project:

Integrated and dynamic architecture
Interactive reporting
Reporting lag
Preservation of historical data
Improved data governance

This Senior Data Architect role will:
review existing data marts,
perform detailed data profiling,
analyze and create design and mapping specifications,
identify Dimensions required for Facts,
complete detailed data profiling of tables included in Facts,
develop and test Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes,
develop Power BI reports for testing for several Dimensions,
testing of Dimensions and Fact for quality assurance
update JOIN as-is data models for new Fact attributes,
stage the required data
address minor fixes in delivered data marts,
provide feedback and lessons learned at project close out.

Duties:
Facilitate the effective definition and management of the data architecture (e.g. principles, strategies, architectures, methods, design principles, models, standards, guidelines, plans, etc.);
Encourage data models and practices that reduce data redundancy by promoting reuse/sharing (in keeping with the IMT strategy);
Identify and document enterprise data requirements;
Encourage practices that improve data quality;
Develop and lead the transition plans that will guide current data to its ideal future state;
Lead or assist in communication activities surrounding the Sectors and Government of Alberta Enterprise Architecture (GAEA) data architecture;
Contribute to the definition and development of the enterprise architecture framework, and associated corporate solution design and delivery methods, thus improving the proactive alignment of data architecture;
Respond to requests for extensions to the scope of the data architecture;
Provide information, advice, guidance, and consultancy to initiatives/projects that are defining or aligning to the data architecture – thus promoting compliance to the data architecture and IMT strategies;
Establish and participate in design reviews, regular or ad-hoc architectural reviews – ensuring correct interpretation of the data architecture, and IMT strategies; and
Provide support to other members of the enterprise architecture team as required

Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Sezzle Bank

Location: Nevada / Remote

Organization: Sezzle Bank (in formation)

Employment Type: Full-time | Remote

Reports To: President of Sezzle Bank and the Board Risk and Compliance Committee

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about breaking new ground in tech and building products that make a real difference for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle.

About Sezzle Bank (in formation):

Sezzle Bank is a planned de novo national bank in formation, headquartered in Nevada and wholly owned by Sezzle Inc. The Bank will serve as the regulated banking entity supporting Sezzle's financial product offerings and ancillary services, with a strategic focus on responsible lending, financial innovation, and exceptional customer experience. We are building a best-in-class team to stand up a safe, sound, and compliant institution from the ground up.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly experienced Chief Risk Officer to develop and maintain an effective, independent second-line risk management program for Sezzle Bank. The CRO will measure and manage credit, market, liquidity, and operational risk — with operational risk encompassing legal, compliance, and technology risk — as well as model-related risk across the Bank. Working with the Board and the Board Risk and Compliance Committee, the CRO will build the enterprise-wide risk governance framework that defines the Bank's risk culture, appetite, and limits, and will own the ongoing monitoring of these risks and of operational performance to ensure alignment with Board-approved policies and tolerances.

The CRO is a Bank-only executive with no concurrent Sezzle Inc. position and reports to the President of Sezzle Bank and to the Board Risk and Compliance Committee.

What You'll Do:

Risk Governance & Framework

  • Define enterprise-wide risk management strategies, policies, and the risk appetite framework; work with the Board and the Board Risk and Compliance Committee to establish the Bank's risk culture, appetite, and limits.
  • Identify, assess, measure, manage, monitor, and report on risk across the Bank, and ensure compliance with Board-approved policies, tolerances, and risk limits.
  • Identify emerging areas of risk, including potential risks associated with proposed new products and services, and ensure business strategies align with regulatory rules, guidance, and supervisory expectations.
  • Develop and maintain a model governance framework that includes independent model validation.
  • Participate in ALCO as the independent second-line risk perspective.

Regulatory & Examination Relationship

  • Serve as the Bank's primary relationship manager for the OCC Examiner-in-Charge, coordinating with the Bank's President.
  • Communicate with regulators and address regulatory inquiries and examination activities.
  • Serve as the Bank's designated CRA Officer: administer the CRA Strategic Plan, monitor the Bank's progress against its CRA performance commitments, and ensure CRA examination readiness.

Second-Line Oversight

  • Oversee the Bank's Chief Compliance Officer and the second-line compliance risk management function, including complaints handling and emerging regulatory and consumer compliance requirements.
  • Oversee the Bank's BSA Officer; ensure BSA/AML/OFAC policies, procedures, risk assessments, and controls are properly designed and operationally effective.
  • Oversee the Bank's Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to ensure information assets, sensitive customer data, and technologies are protected; ensure the CISO reports routinely to the Board or the appropriate Board committee.

Board & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the primary source for all risk program communication and reporting to the Board and the Board Risk and Compliance Committee.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with business line management, effectively communicating emerging and present risk elements and issues.
  • Provide support and insight to the Bank's audit program, including addressing audit findings and remediation efforts.

What We Look For:

Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

The Senior Director, Pricing Operations will lead the transformation of Sophos's SecOps pricing function: building a centralized team, a disciplined operating cadence, and an AI-assisted governance model that let pricing move at the pace of the market. This is a build role. The Director will design the target operating model, stand up the team and the cadence behind it, and give senior leadership a clear, early view of competitive and market shifts, with a strong dotted line into the Network Security group to keep pricing decisions connected across both businesses.

What You Will Do

    • Design and build a centralized Pricing Operations function, bringing pricing work that sits across multiple teams today into one function with clear ownership of strategy, analytics, and deal support.

    • Define and implement a segment-aware pricing cadence, replacing episodic reviews with a disciplined, regular cycle, tuned to how fast each part of the business needs to move.

    • Stand up a pricing council and governance model so every approved change carries clear rationale, ownership, and advance communication to sales, finance, and customer-facing teams.

    • Direct the build-out of AI-assisted digital worker capabilities for competitor pricing analysis, discount analysis, discount depth analysis, and market alerts, so the function operates at pace without growing headcount.

    • Give senior leadership early visibility into market-moving events, including competitor pricing moves and market disruption, ahead of the standard review cycle.

    • Build a strong dotted-line partnership with the Network Security group to keep pricing decisions aligned across SecOps and Network Security.

    • Define and report the metrics that prove the new model is working: cadence adherence, time from decision to communication, and discount discipline.

What You Will Bring

    • Track record of building or transforming a pricing, revenue operations, or deal desk function at a B2B SaaS or technology company, ideally in cybersecurity or another subscription-driven business.

    • Experience leading organizational change: centralizing a distributed function, standing up new governance, and bringing a business along through the transition.

    • Familiarity with discount governance and competitive pricing intelligence, including using data and AI-assisted tools to monitor competitor pricing and discounting patterns.

    • Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to build a new team and establish its operating rhythm from the ground up.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build conviction for a new way of working across sales, finance, and executive stakeholders.

    • Comfortable designing pricing approaches that flex by customer segment and channel, balancing speed and stability where each is needed.

    • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What to Expect as a Residential & Consumer Underwriter:

The Residential & Consumer Underwriter is responsible for analyzing, underwriting, and making credit recommendations on consumer and residential mortgage loan requests in accordance with bank policy, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards. This position evaluates borrowers' creditworthiness, repayment capacity, collateral adequacy, and overall risk profile while ensuring compliance with lending guidelines and applicable regulations.

What You’ll Contribute in This Role:

Consumer Lending

  • Underwrite consumer loan requests, including but not limited to:
    • Personal loans
    • Auto loans
    • HELOCs and PLOCs
    • Cash-secured loans
    • Other consumer credit products
  • Review credit reports, income verification, debt obligations, and repayment capacity.
  • Calculate debt-to-income (DTI) and other underwriting metrics.
  • Structure loans and identify policy exceptions with supporting rationale.

Residential Mortgage Underwriting

  • Underwrite:
    • Portfolio mortgage loans
    • Construction-to-permanent loans
  • Analyze tax returns, W-2s, bank statements, and asset documentation.
  • Review appraisals, title reports, insurance, and collateral documentation.
  • Calculate LTV, DTI, residual income, and other qualifying ratios.
  • Apply portfolio underwriting and manually underwrite large and/or complex residential loans involving multiple collateral properties and borrowers with complex, sophisticated, and/or unique financials

  • Assess borrower willingness and ability to repay.
  • Evaluate collateral adequacy and marketability.
  • Identify fraud indicators, credit weaknesses, and emerging risks.
  • Recommend approval, denial, or approval with conditions.

    • TILA
    • RESPA
    • HMDA
    • Fair Lending
    • ATR/QM requirements
    • Internal credit policy
  • Maintain complete loan files and documentation.
  • Communicate approval conditions and documentation deficiencies.

Collaboration

    • Loan Officers
    • Mortgage Originators
    • Credit Administration
    • Loan Operations
    • Appraisers
    • Closing Agents

• Be willing to pursue and demonstrate an understanding of established Bank policies, procedures, and regulations.

• Question suspicious activity and stay in close collaboration with our Compliance department to ensure proper investigation and processing of potentially fraudulent activity.
• Stay informed on legal context and regulatory requirements and prioritize completing all web-based compliance and IT training.

What You’ll Leverage in this Role:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or related field
  • 3-7 years of consumer and/or residential mortgage underwriting experience
  • Experience with conventional and portfolio mortgage underwriting.
  • Community banking experience preferred.

Entrepreneurial Self-Starter Mentality - You take charge of your work product and take pride in delivering consistently great and measurable results. You are an analytical thinker, possess the ability to complete assignments with little oversight and balance self-sufficiency with the understanding when to ask questions. A high-pace and high-expectation environment excites you and you can’t wait to push yourself to new professional heights in a company that rewards high performance.

Tech-Forward and Analytical Thinking - You learn new tools quickly, are excited by innovation and leverage technology to optimize your work product. You have strong mathematical skills, possess strong proven Microsoft Excel skills, and are familiar or are willing to become familiar with Power BI.

Role Title: Physics Expert (PhD / Postdoc)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

We are engaging Physics Experts (PhD / Postdoc) to contribute deep scientific knowledge and problem-solving skills to a high-impact customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems.

Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Required Skills

  • Physics Mastery

  • Written Technical Communication

  • Technical Problem-Solving Depth

  • Mathematical & Computational Fluency

Scope of Work

  • Solve advanced physics problems from your specialization, delivering rigorous, well-documented derivations and analyses.

  • Produce technically precise, clearly written solutions, detailing all assumptions, approximations, and final results using LaTeX mathematical notation.

  • Utilize SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for symbolic or numerical verification and clear computational workflows where relevant.

  • Identify and articulate subtleties in problem statements, including special cases, boundary conditions, and dimensional consistency.

  • Flag ambiguities in project materials, proposing well-reasoned interpretations and clarifications as needed.

  • Iterate on submitted solutions in response to feedback from project reviewers, ensuring corrections are cleanly integrated.

  • Uphold rigorous standards in documentation and reproducibility consistent with professional research practice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in physics or advanced-stage PhD candidacy, with active research experience in a relevant subfield.

  • Research expertise in one or more of: High Energy Physics, Mathematical Physics, Biophysics, Statistical Physics, Condensed Matter (including moiré systems, magnetism, PXP/Rydberg), AMO/Quantum Optics, Gravitation, Cosmology, Astrophysics, Quantum Information, or Optical Properties of Materials.

  • 2–5 recent representative publications (past ~5 years) in your field, with accessible arXiv or DOI records.

  • Proficiency with LaTeX for presenting mathematics, and with SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for computational work; willingness to indicate areas for further support if needed.

  • Demonstrated excellence in written technical communication, with a track record of producing clear, precise, and well-argued scientific outputs.

  • Strong analytical skills, able to isolate key physical principles and provide nuanced solutions to complex problems.

  • Availability to engage with the project consistently over an 8–10 week period (approx. 10 hours/week).

jobs.excerpt: About Us:The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected.
jobs.description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:

The Credentialing & Payer Operations Manager will own end-to-end provider licensing, payer enrollment, and credentialing operations. This hands-on role requires someone who thrives "in the weeds" building scalable internal processes, maintaining strict regulatory compliance, and driving fast time-to-credentialing metrics. Initially operating as a team of one, this role will establish foundational workflows for our Care Team (including Doulas) while serving as the primary bridge between providers, health plans, billing, and client success teams.

Key Responsibilities

Provider Onboarding, Licensing & Doula Readiness

  • Manage full lifecycle licensing, credentialing, and re-credentialing applications for all Care Team members across multiple states.
  • Build and execute Doula Readiness workflows to onboard non-traditional care providers efficiently into payer networks.
  • Collect, audit, and verify primary source documentation required for payor and state credentialing packages.
  • Directly communicate with providers to gather missing documentation, guide them through state renewal procedures, and clear onboarding bottlenecks.

Licensure Maintenance, Certifications & CEU Tracking

  • Proactively monitor and track all clinical and non-clinical staff credentials, state license expiration dates, BLS/CPR certifications, and mandatory Continuing Education Units (CEUs).
  • Build structured automated workflow reminders in Medallion to advise care team members on upcoming renewal deadlines and mandatory continuing education requirements.
  • Audit and record completion certificates for required clinical trainings, state-mandated CEUs, and specialty accreditations prior to credential expiration.

Process Operations, Systems & Performance

  • Establish, standardize, and optimize internal credentialing and payer enrollment processes from scratch.
  • Own and maintain the credentialing management platform (Medallion) for automated tracking, expiration alerts, and primary source verification reporting.
  • Track and optimize key operational KPIs, specifically driving down Time-to-Credentialing to accelerate provider deployment and revenue generation.
  • Generate regular performance analytics and status reports for leadership regarding provider readiness and enrollment pipelines.

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) & Payer Relations

  • Oversee the credentialing-to-claims bridge, ensuring providers are properly linked to billing systems prior to service delivery to prevent claim denials.
  • Submit credentialing packages directly to commercial insurance plans, Medicaid entities, and managed care organizations.
  • Partner closely with Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), billing, and coding teams to troubleshoot credentialing-related claims issues or enrollment delays.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Monitor state licensure bodies, OIG exclusions, Medicaid/Medicare sanction reports, and the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) to ensure clean provider rosters.
  • Stay up to date on evolving healthcare regulations, state licensing requirements, HIPAA guidelines, and payer-specific enrollment rules.
  • Manage client-facing compliance reporting, delivering accurate documentation to meet health plan and enterprise client audit standards.

Client Communication & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Serve as the functional point of contact for enterprise clients regarding provider panel status and credentialing timelines.
  • Collaborate internally with Implementation and Client Success teams to align provider availability with client go-live targets.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of healthcare credentialing, provider operations, and payer enrollment experience.
  • Proven experience submitting initial state licensure applications across multiple states simultaneously and tracking recurring certification/CEU requirements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (Associates degree accepted with equivalent hands-on experience).
  • Hands-on experience with Medallion (or similar credentialing tracking platforms) is strongly preferred.

Key Skill Sets

  • Strong project management skills to track dozens of active licenses, BLS certifications, CEU deadlines, and payer files simultaneously.
  • Comfortable operating independently, solving complex payer delays, and building processes without a pre-existing playbook.
  • Excellent verbal and written skills for interfacing with providers, health plan representatives, internal billing teams, and enterprise clients.
  • Practical understanding of how credentialing linkages directly impact billing cycles and claims reimbursement.

Compensation range for this position is between $80K-$90K. The exact amount will depend on direct, relevant experience.

Our Interview Process

At Nadia Care, we value transparency and want you to feel prepared at every stage of your candidate journey. Below is our standard interview process for this role:

  1. Recruiter Interview | 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview | 45 minutes
  3. Written Assessment | 2 days to complete

This vacancy is a voluntary-based position with (3-7 Hours/Week) flexible part-time commitment.

The Fédération Internationale de la Jeunesse in English International Youth Federation (IYF), is an international non-profit youth organization network governed by the present Statutes and the Swiss Civil Code. It is politically neutral, and non-denominational, aiming to empower youth worldwide.

Position Summary:

  • The Cybersecurity Expert will be responsible for implementing, maintaining, and auditing the organization’s information security framework, with a strong focus on ISO/IEC 27001 compliance. This role ensures that the company’s data and systems are secure from threats, and operates within the required legal and regulatory guidelines.

    Key Responsibilities:
    • Implement and maintain the ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management System (ISMS).
    • Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for cyber threats and vulnerabilities.
    • Ensure continuous improvement of information security policies, procedures, and controls.
    • Perform internal audits and prepare the organization for external ISO 27001 audits and certifications.
    • Manage and resolve cybersecurity incidents, coordinating response plans and investigations.
    • Provide guidance on secure development practices and secure system architecture.
    • Train employees and departments on information security awareness and best practices.
    • Collaborate with IT, legal, and compliance teams to ensure security is embedded across operations.
    • Monitor security tools, log data, and system alerts to detect and respond to anomalies.

    Penetration Testing
    • Conduct application, API, mobile, network, and cloud penetration tests on internal and client systems.
    • Simulate real-world attack scenarios to uncover exploitable vulnerabilities.
    • Develop custom scripts, payloads, or tools to support advanced testing needs.
    • Document findings with clear proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and technical impact analysis.

    Vulnerability Assessment & Management
    • Perform ongoing vulnerability scanning using industry-standard tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, OpenVAS, Burp Suite).
    • Analyze scan results, validate findings, and prioritize remediation based on risk levels.
    • Track remediation progress and provide guidance to development and DevOps teams.
    • Maintain a continuous vulnerability management lifecycle including discovery, analysis, reporting, and verification.

    Security Review & Advisory
    • Collaborate with software development and DevOps teams to conduct secure code reviews and architecture assessments.
    • Provide recommendations for secure design, configuration, and coding practices.
    • Support clients by explaining vulnerabilities, associated risks, and mitigation strategies in clear, understandable language.

    Monitoring & Threat Intelligence
    • Monitor emerging threats, exploits, and security best practices to keep assessment methodologies up to date.
    • Integrate threat intelligence into testing strategies to mimic current attacker techniques (TTPs).

    Documentation & Reporting
    • Prepare detailed penetration test reports, executive summaries, and risk-based recommendations.
    • Maintain accurate records of assessments, testing plans, methodologies, and remediation efforts.
    • Present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, internal and external.

    Requirements:
    • 5+ years of experience in a cybersecurity role, with hands-on ISO 27001 implementation and auditing.
    • Certified ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor (mandatory).
    • Strong understanding of risk assessment, GRC frameworks, and security operations.
    • Proficient in tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, vulnerability scanners, and endpoint protection.
    • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, IT, or a related field; relevant certifications (CISSP, CISA, etc.) preferred.

jobs.description:
About Us
VT Markets is an award-winning multi-asset brokerage trusted by over 3 million traders in over 160 countries with over 500 employees—and growing. Founded in 2015 with the mission to make trading accessible to everyone, VT Markets offers a robust trading environment, over 1000 tradeable instructions, ultra-low spreads, and lightning-fast execution. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and empowering modern trades to seize market opportunities. Our platform allows traders to trade anytime, anywhere, supporting them in their journey to build a safe financial future.

About Your Role
As a Junior Marketing Data Analyst, you will report to the Senior Marketing Data Analyst within the Growth Team, operating remotely from China. In this role, you will support the evaluation of marketing performance and the generation of user growth insights across global markets, helping maintain the analytical infrastructure - from attribution tracking and automated reporting to fraud monitoring—that powers the Growth Team's decisions. You will work closely with the Marketing, Product, and Operations teams globally, as well as the Global Marketing COE, providing timely and accurate data support under the guidance of the Senior Marketing Data Analyst.

Responsibilities

What Makes You a Great Fit
Job Experience & Education
  • 2-3 years of experience in data analytics, marketing analytics, or a related data function; exposure to Fintech, Gaming, or financial or e-commerce industries is an advantage.
  • Some exposure to Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer or Adjust, and familiarity with data platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), is preferred but not required.
  • A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
Technical & Functional Skills
  • Proficient in SQL for data extraction and analysis; working knowledge ofPythonor R is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of probability and statistics, with some exposure to A/B testing concepts such as sample size and significance testing.
  • Familiarity with BI dashboard tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), with the ability to maintain and update existing dashboards.
Soft Skills
  • Eager learner with strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in turning data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Reliable and well-organised in managing recurring tasks and deadlines.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment, while proactively seeking guidance and feedback from senior team members.
Other Requirements
  • Working proficiency in English, with the ability to navigate English-language technical documentation.
  • Due to the remote nature of the role, you will need to access your personal device & laptop for work.

Requirements

Your Responsibilities
  • Attribution Support: Assist in maintaining cross-channel attribution models (MMM/MTA) under the guidance of the Senior Data Analyst; help identify and flag attribution data gaps or discrepancies across Web and App platforms.
  • Marketing Performance Tracking: Monitor and update CAC and LTV dashboards across global markets; support Cohort Analysis and compile data summaries to inform marketing budget discussions.
  • User Behaviour Analysis: Analyse user data at key conversion nodes - Registration, KYC, First Trade, and Deposit - to surface churn patterns, and support the design and execution of product-side A/B tests.
  • Fraud Monitoring Support: Assist in monitoring and flagging suspicious traffic and “bonus hunter” activity using existing fraud detection tools, escalating findings to the Senior Marketing Data Analyst.
  • Reporting & Dashboard Maintenance: Maintain and update BI dashboards to support data self-service across Marketing, Product, and Operations teams; respond to ad-hoc reporting requests with accuracy and timeliness.
What Success Looks Like
  • You consistently deliver accurate, timely data support that enables the Growth Team and Senior Data Analyst to make confident, data-informed decisions.
  • You develop strong working knowledge of attribution, reporting, and fraud-monitoring systems, becoming a dependable resource for day-to-day data requests across Marketing, Product, and Operations.
  • You demonstrate growing analytical independence, progressively taking ownership of recurring reporting and analysis tasks with reduced need for supervision.

Benefits

What We Offer
As official partners of Newcastle United F. C., VT Markets aspire to break the ancient boundaries of traditional personal finance. Through a culture of transparent and objective performance management, we are in constant pursuit of excellence, individually and collectively. Here, collaboration and intrapreneurship are incentivized, and we aim to empower everyone to understand their contribution to strategic business outcomes through their individualized roles. You can expect personal growth as we aim to lead this fast-growing industry alongside a global team of diverse cultures across over 15 countries.

Your Journey After Applying
  • Screening interview with our Talent Acquisition Partner
  • Interview with your manager—Senior Marketing Data Analyst
  • Second interview with 2nd-level manager - Marketing Analytics Manager

关于我们
VT Markets 是一家屡获殊荣的多资产经纪商，在全球 160 多个国家拥有超过 300 万名交易者的信任，目前拥有 500 多名员工，并持续增长。公司成立于 2015 年，使命是让交易变得更加普及、人人可参与。VT Markets 提供稳健的交易环境、超过 1000 种可交易产品、极低点差以及极速执行。我们致力于提供卓越的客户服务，并赋能现代交易者把握市场机会。我们的平台让交易者能够随时随地进行交易，支持他们在构建安全金融未来的旅程中不断成长。

您的角色
作为初级营销数据分析师，您将向高级数据分析师汇报，隶属于增长团队，并在中国远程办公。
在该职位中，您将协助评估营销表现，并支持在全球市场范围内生成用户增长洞察，协助维护支撑增长团队决策的分析基础设施—包括归因追踪、自动化报告与欺诈监测等工作。您将与全球的营销、产品和运营团队密切合作，并与全球营销团队协作，在高级数据分析师的指导下，提供及时且准确的数据支持。
您的职责
  • 归因分析支持：在高级数据分析师指导下，协助维护跨渠道归因模型（MMM/MTA）；协助识别并标记 Web 与 App 平台间的归因数据缺口或差异。
  • 营销表现追踪：监控并更新全球市场的 CAC 与 LTV 数据看板；支持 Cohort Analysis（用户群组分析），整理数据摘要以支援营销预算讨论。
  • 用户行为分析：分析关键转化节点（注册、KYC、首次交易、入金）的用户数据，识别流失趋势，并协助产品侧 A/B 测试的设计与执行。
  • 反欺诈监测支持：协助使用现有反欺诈工具监测并标记可疑流量及“羊毛党”行为，并将发现上报予高级数据分析师。
  • 报告与看板维护：维护并更新 BI 数据看板，支持营销、产品及运营团队的数据自助分析；准确且及时地回应临时数据需求。
成功的衡量标准
  • 您持续提供准确、及时的数据支持，使增长团队与高级数据分析师能够自信地做出数据驱动的决策。
  • 对归因、报告与反欺诈监测系统建立扎实的工作知识，成为营销、产品及运营团队日常数据需求的可靠支援。
  • 展现出逐步提升的分析独立性，在减少监督需求的情况下，逐步承担更多常规报告与分析任务的责任。
我们期待的理想人选
工作经验与教育背景
  • 拥有2-3 年数据分析、营销分析或相关数据岗位经验；具备金融科技、游戏或电商行业背景者优先。
  • 具备移动归因平台（MMP，如 AppsFlyer 或 Adjust）的接触经验，并熟悉 Google Analytics 4（GA4）等数据平台者优先，非必要条件。
  • 拥有统计学、数学、计算机科学、数据科学或相关量化领域的学位；同等实务经验亦可考虑。
技术与专业技能

  • 熟悉 BI 数据看板工具（如 Tableau、Looker 或同类工具），能够维护并更新现有看板。
软技能

  • 能够在远程环境中独立工作，同时主动向资深同事寻求指导与反馈。
其他要求
