jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

  • Samsara is hiring a Senior Software Engineer II to join our Developer Experience team within the larger Developer Experience organization. We are responsible for the ‘outer-loop’ of the SDLC, with a dotted line to our sister team Dev Agents, who is responsible for the ‘inner-loop’.
  • We are building an AI-enabled software factory that transforms how Samsara moves code from pull request to production. We use AI to eliminate repetitive steps, shorten feedback loops, and help engineers spend more time on ensuring intent. Our systems provide AI-assisted PR auto-approvals, risk-aware reviews, and automated workflows that help changes become merge-ready. We are extending that intelligence through CI and CD with AI-assisted deployment checks, production validation, and automatic rollbacks. Our goal is to enable our engineers to scale out their productivity by making the ‘outer-loop’ autonomous while keeping it safe, observable, and reliable by default.
  • We tackle this ambitious goal from two different angles. First, we ensure our agents have the most context and their own sandbox to reduce the amount of guessing an agent needs to do in order to reach its result. Second, we ensure production is bulletproof, such that the blast radius of any issue is as minimal as possible. Our north star motto is “Merge and forget”.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role, you will:

  • Help scale our in-house CI/CD systems to meet the needs of a rapidly more efficient engineering organization and increasing pull-request throughput.
  • Reduce tech debt using efficient AI workflows that would otherwise be cost prohibitive in a non-AI workflow.
  • Design and build deployment safeguards that protect production at scale, making use of AI to monitor and fix issues.
  • Build the observability, evaluation, and feedback systems used to improve our AI-driven automation.
  • Serve as a thought leader for using AI to increase engineering productivity while maintaining a high bar for safety, quality, and signal over AI-generated slop.
  • Redefine the outer loop of the SDLC by designing AI-native workflows that increase engineering throughput without compromising reliability.
  • Push the threshold of what is possible with AI by turning emerging capabilities into safe, observable, and production-ready engineering systems.
  • Partner with product engineering teams to reduce operational toil, and make safe, AI-enabled delivery practices easy to adopt across the company. Ensuring their specific team needs are met.
  • Help keep Samsara at the cutting edge of AI-assisted software development by experimenting boldly, learning quickly, and converting successful experiments into platforms used across the company.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience designing and building products in a software engineering team
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years of experience working on developer experience, CICD and/or platform engineering-focused teams
  • Experience in building AI workflows, orchestration systems or other harnesses of AI
  • Proven track record in architecting CICD systems, build and deploy platforms, and automated response workflows, Buildkite (or equivalent BYOC software).
  • Proven experience working on large-scale enterprise software applications
  • Experience in building and maintaining a large organization's Software Development Life Cycle (DevEx)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or the like)
  • Experience in implementing AI-driven automation across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to reduce developer friction, automate repetitive technical tasks, and accelerate time-to-delivery. Routinely applies AI tools across your workflow
  • Experienced at writing high-quality code (Go, Python, or equivalent) focused on infrastructure, deployment, and operations challenges
  • Experienced orchestrating multiple AI agents en-mass to tackle complex (non one-off) tasks.
  • Strong leadership and direction setting skills. Visionary as a tech lead. Able to set a high standard for peers, and keep it.

An ideal candidate also is:

  • Forward thinking about the capabilities AI, an advocate for AI usage
  • Experience with building in-house CICD systems
  • Experienced with building for FedRamp, StateRamp or other compliance requirements

You should apply if:

  • You want to be on the cutting edge of AI enabled software development.
  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$154,700—$260,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Manager Data Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: • Collects, validates, and maintains data from internal and external sources to support feasibility and operational activities.
jobs.description:
• Collects, validates, and maintains data from internal and external sources to support feasibility and operational activities.
  • Analyses clinical trial, site, investigator, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develops and maintains standard reports, dashboards, and data visualizations to support stakeholder decision-making.
  • Supports feasibility assessments by providing data summaries, analyses, and insights related to study requirements, site performance, recruitment trends, and therapeutic areas.
  • Collaborates with Operational Strategy, Clinical Operations, Business Development, and other functional stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver timely analyses.
  • Performs data quality reviews and works to resolve data inconsistencies and gaps.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve existing data collection, reporting, and analytical processes.
  • Supports the evaluation and integration of new data sources, tools, and technologies.
  • Maintains documentation related to data sources, methodologies, reporting processes, and best practices.
  • Develops and updates reporting templates and analytical tools to improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Provides ad hoc analyses and reports in support of departmental and organizational priorities.
  • Monitors key operational and feasibility metrics and communicates findings to stakeholders.
  • Supports process improvement initiatives by leveraging data to identify efficiencies and operational enhancements.
  • Ensures compliance with applicable quality standards, policies, and data governance requirements.
  • Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.
  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Data Analytics, Health Sciences, Business, Statistics, Public Health, or a related field required. Master's degree in a relevant discipline preferred.
  • Strong experience in clinical research, feasibility, clinical operations, data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Experience working with clinical trial, investigator, site, operational, or healthcare-related datasets.
  • Demonstrated experience analysing and interpreting complex data from multiple sources.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for business stakeholders.
  • Experience working within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or related environment preferred.
  • Experience supporting feasibility assessments, site selection activities, clinical operations, or operational planning preferred.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a global environment.
  • Knowledge of clinical development processes and clinical trial conduct is desirable.
  • Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, or similar platforms preferred.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

About itin.com

itin.com is an affiliated business of Oguz Law, providing ITIN, U.S. business formation, and EIN application services to international clients.

We help foreign nationals obtain a U.S. Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) from the IRS. itin.com is an IRS Certifying Acceptance Agent and is founded and operated by a California-licensed attorney. We verify passports through video calls, allowing clients to complete the process without mailing their original documents to the IRS.

Our clients include foreign real estate investors, international students, non-resident spouses, foreign owners of U.S. companies, and others with U.S. tax filing needs. Many clients also require assistance with forming a U.S. company and obtaining an Employer Identification Number (EIN).

This position is being recruited through Oguz Law on behalf of itin.com.

The Role

As a Client Intake and Business Formation Specialist, you will be one of the first points of contact for prospective and existing clients.

The role combines client intake and phone-based communication with preparing U.S. company formation documents, EIN applications, and related administrative filings.

Location

Remote — open to applicants worldwide

Engagement

Independent contractor

Expected Availability

Approximately 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, covering U.S. Pacific business hours, approximately 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PT.

Reports To

Founder and Managing Attorney

Responsibilities

Client Intake and Communication

  • Answer inbound calls, web inquiries, and messages from prospective clients and return missed calls within the same business day.
  • Explain our ITIN, company formation, and EIN services, pricing, and processes clearly and accurately.
  • Collect intake information and screen inquiries according to our internal service eligibility guidelines.
  • Help qualified prospective clients move forward with our services and schedule document verification video calls.
  • Follow up regarding missing documents, unsigned forms, outstanding payments, and other required information.
  • Provide clients with timely status updates while their applications are being processed.
  • Maintain professional and reassuring communication with clients throughout the process.
  • Escalate legal and tax-related questions to the attorney. This position does not provide legal or tax advice.

Company Formation

  • Prepare and file LLC and corporation formation documents with U.S. state agencies, primarily in Delaware, Wyoming, and California.
  • Check business name availability, coordinate registered agent services, and track filings through approval.
  • Prepare standard post-formation documents using company templates, including operating agreements and initial resolutions, for attorney review.
  • Track recurring compliance deadlines, including annual reports, franchise tax obligations, and California Statements of Information.

EIN Applications

  • Prepare IRS Form SS-4 for newly formed entities, including foreign-owned companies whose owners do not have an SSN or ITIN.
  • Submit EIN applications through the appropriate available method and follow up with the IRS when necessary.
  • Deliver EIN confirmation documentation to clients and maintain complete records in the client file.

Case Administration

  • Log calls, emails, client communications, and status changes in HubSpot on the same business day.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and organized client files.
  • Ensure records are sufficiently documented so another team member can understand the current status of a matter.
  • Escalate errors, delays, unusual issues, and client concerns to the attorney promptly.

Qualifications

  • Fluent spoken and written English with strong client-facing communication skills.
  • At least 2 years of experience in client intake, inside sales, customer service, call center operations, or a similar client-facing position serving U.S. customers.
  • Experience with U.S. company formation, EIN applications, government filings, or other form-based administrative work is preferred. Candidates with demonstrated ability to learn detailed filing processes quickly and accurately will also be considered.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling names, identification information, forms, and government filings.
  • Comfortable working independently in a CRM environment and maintaining accurate records without frequent reminders.
  • Able to handle confidential documents, including passports and tax-related documentation, professionally and discreetly.
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, a headset, and a reasonable backup plan for internet or power interruptions.
  • Ability to consistently work during U.S. Pacific business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Paralegal, accounting, tax preparation, or legal services background.
  • Experience with IRS Forms W-7 or SS-4.
  • Experience with Delaware, Wyoming, or California business entity filings.
  • HubSpot experience.
  • Fluency in an additional language such as Spanish, Turkish, Mandarin, or Portuguese.

Terms

  • Independent contractor engagement.
  • Contractors are responsible for their own applicable taxes and work equipment.
  • Paid training will be provided during the initial onboarding period on ITIN, company formation, EIN, and internal procedures.
  • This is intended to be a long-term opportunity with potential for increased responsibility as itin.com grows.

Application Process

Please apply through this LinkedIn posting and submit your resume.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to provide:

  1. Confirmation that they are available to work during U.S. Pacific business hours.
  2. An English voice recording of no more than 2 minutes describing a situation in which they helped a confused, concerned, or nervous customer.
  3. A short written summary of any experience with U.S. company formation, EIN applications, IRS forms, or similar government filings.

The voice recording is audio-only. No video or photograph is requested. It will be used solely to assess spoken English and client-facing communication skills that are directly relevant to this position.

Because spoken English is a core requirement of the role, shortlisted candidates who do not complete this step will not be able to proceed in the recruitment process.

itin.com and Oguz Law never charge applicants recruitment fees and will not request identity documents or banking information during the initial application process.

Equal Opportunity

itin.com considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Mission Telecom is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit wireless broadband provider and grantmaking foundation. We partner with nonprofits, schools, and libraries to close the digital divide through reliable, affordable wireless broadband and connected devices, and through Mission Telecom Giving, we fund social impact organizations working to advance equity and justice. Our grantmaking focuses on multiracial democracy, movement infrastructure and innovation, and telecom justice, including broadband affordability policy.

About the Role

Mission Telecom is seeking a Senior .NET Full-Stack Engineer to develop and support software systems, integrations, and automations across the organization. A central focus is Mission Connect, our custom business application supporting sales, customer management, billing, payments, fulfillment, and operational workflows. Mission Connect is nearing its initial production launch with an established architecture, automated testing and deployment controls, and defined engineering standards. After launch, this position will assume primary engineering ownership of the platform.

This is a broad, hands-on role spanning full-stack development, integrations, PostgreSQL, security, Azure operations, and production support. The role reports to the CTO, who remains actively involved in architecture, priorities, release planning, and technical escalation, and works directly with leadership and business stakeholders to turn operational needs into reliable software.

Key Responsibilities

Application Development and Business Automation

  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and support Mission Telecom software applications using C#, .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, Blazor Server, Radzen, and related technologies.
  • Build staff and customer-facing interfaces, application services, business logic, background processing, and data-access functionality.
  • Serve as the primary hands-on engineer for software systems, partnering with the CTO and business stakeholders on priorities, technical decisions, and release planning.
  • Own the technical design and implementation of assigned application features and enhancements within Mission Telecom's established technology direction.
  • Translate business processes and operational requirements into automated workflows supporting grantmaking, marketing, lead management, sales, billing, payments, fulfillment, customer service, reporting, and other organizational functions.
  • Deliver maintainable, incremental enhancements to existing applications and workflows.
  • Develop scripts, utilities, and automation for data exchange, system administration, diagnostics, deployment, integration support, and operational tasks.
  • Own assigned work from requirements and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and support.

APIs and System Integrations

  • Design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot secure integrations between internal and third-party systems.
  • Develop and consume REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, file-based exchanges, and other system-to-system integration methods.
  • Support integrations across CRM, marketing, lead generation, advertising, analytics, accounting, payments, communications, and telecom platforms, including systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Apollo.io, RB2B, Google, Meta, NetSuite, payment processors, and service providers.
  • Implement reliable patterns for authentication, synchronization, error handling, retries, rate limits, duplicate prevention, and reconciliation.
  • Diagnose and resolve integration issues across applications, data, authentication, and third-party platforms.
  • Design integrations that can adapt as Mission Telecom's business systems and processes evolve.

Databases and Financial Systems

  • Design, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize PostgreSQL and other databases supporting Mission Telecom.
  • Work with relational data models, tables, relationships, primary and foreign keys, constraints, indexes, SQL queries, Entity Framework Core, and application data access.
  • Diagnose database performance, concurrency, and data-integrity issues.
  • Plan and execute controlled database schema changes using established migration, validation, and deployment practices.
  • Develop and support financial and operational workflows involving orders, invoices, payments, taxes, adjustments, refunds, provisioning, and customer accounts.
  • Build and maintain NetSuite and payment processor integrations with appropriate transaction integrity, auditability, and reconciliation.
  • Maintain appropriate customer data isolation and financial correctness across billing, tax, payment, and reconciliation workflows.

Security and Identity

  • Develop and maintain authentication, authorization, and role-based access controls.
  • Configure and support Microsoft Entra ID capabilities used by applications, including app registrations, enterprise applications, permissions, managed identities, secrets, and certificates.
  • Work with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and related identity standards.
  • Apply secure development practices to customer information, financial data, APIs, file handling, application access, and cloud resources.

Azure Operations and Software Quality

  • Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications and services within Microsoft Azure.
  • Work with Azure App Service, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Application Insights, managed identities, networking, configuration, logging, and related services.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD processes using GitHub and GitHub Actions or comparable tooling.
  • Own application monitoring, incident investigation, recovery procedures, and root-cause resolution, with the CTO providing technical backup and escalation support.
  • Develop and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end automated testing for business-critical workflows.
  • Use Playwright or comparable tools to validate important staff and customer workflows.
  • Perform code reviews and maintainappropriate technical documentation for applications, integrations, configuration, and support procedures.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Use AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to improve productivity across analysis, development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code review.
  • Work within a structured AI-assisted development process that uses scoped tasks, review checkpoints, independent validation, and documented review before release.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Independently understand the codebase, design solutions, write and modify production code, and troubleshoot issues without reliance on generated output.
  • Use AI tools within approved security and data-handling requirements and independently verify generated work before release.

What Success Looks Like

  • Mission Connect stable and supported in production, with engineering ownership fully transitioned from leadership
  • Business requests delivered as working enhancements and automations on a consistent release schedule
  • Reliable integrations, with errors caught and resolved quickly
  • Accurate, auditable billing, payment, and reconciliation workflows
  • Production issues resolved at the root cause, with decreasing reliance on CTO escalation over time
  • Current automated test coverage and documentation for business-critical workflows

What You'll Need

  • 7 or more years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and supporting complex production business applications.
  • Advanced proficiency with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and modern full-stack web application development.
  • Proven ability to design, build, and support REST APIs and integrations with third-party business systems.
  • Proficiency with SQL, relational database design, data modeling, indexes, keys, query optimization, and database troubleshooting.
  • Experience building and supporting business-critical transactional or operational applications where data accuracy, reliability, and auditability matter.
  • Ability to translate business processes and requirements into reliable software solutions and independently own delivery through release and support.
  • Knowledge of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, and secure development practices.
  • Experience deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting cloud-hosted applications and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Effective communication and problem-solving skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted development tools productively while independently understanding, reviewing, troubleshooting, and writing production code.

Nice to Have

Experience with every listed platform is not required. Candidates should demonstrate the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar applications, APIs, and integration requirements.

  • Blazor Server strongly preferred, with experience in comparable component-based web application frameworks also considered.
  • Telecom provisioning, carrier APIs, device and SIM/eSIM workflows, or comparable service-provider integrations.
  • Scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, C#, SQL, Azure CLI, or comparable tools.
  • PostgreSQL and Entity Framework Core.
  • Microsoft Azure services including App Service, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Application Insights, networking, and managed identities.
  • Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, enterprise applications, permissions, and authentication.
  • Integration experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Apollo.io, RB2B, NetSuite, payment processors, communications platforms, or telecom providers.
  • GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling.
  • Playwright or comparable automated end-to-end testing frameworks.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Annual salary of $120,000 to $140,000 based on experience and qualifications
  • Fully paid medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and life/AD&D insurance
  • 85% of dependent coverage for medical, dental, and vision
  • Partial phone and internet reimbursement
  • 5% Safe Harbor contribution into a 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO plus 14 paid holidays per year

Our Culture

Mission Telecom fosters an environment of innovation, collaboration, and purpose-driven work. We align ourselves with staff, partners, and clients who are passionate about creating measurable impact and expanding access to opportunity.

How to Apply

Apply through this posting by October 21, 2026. Please include a cover letter and resume showcasing your experience relevant to this position.

In turn, we value and respect the differences that comprise each individual, including but not limited to age, citizenship, class, color, culture, ethnicity, family status, gender identity and expression, health status or disability, income, language, national origin, partnership status, pregnancy status, race, religion, sex, and sexual orientation. Want to be part of a team that keeps real-time weather alerts and observations flowing reliably to hundreds of millions of people? We are looking for a Software Developer III who displays a deep interest in and passion for backend architecture, mentorship, and problem solving; someone who likes to own real-time systems end to end and help other engineers grow. Reporting directly to the Manager, Data Engineering, this position will be responsible for leading the design and development of backend software that processes real-time weather data flows — including alerts, observations, and AccuWeather Alerts — powering AccuWeather's consumer and enterprise products. Serving as a software development expert, you will build new processing services and workflows to improve the reliability and scalability of our real-time weather platforms, while owning monitoring and data quality standards for the systems you lead. You will demonstrate expert skill across relational databases, functional programming, and cloud technologies, mentor less experienced developers, and collaborate with peers and stakeholders in an Agile-based environment, to deliver best of breed real-time infrastructure that caters to a global audience.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design, development, testing, and maintenance of complex backend software processors that ingest, validate, transform, and distribute real-time weather data.
  • Own end-to-end backend data flows from source system through validation to production database, including monitoring, operational efficiency, and incident response.
  • Design and implement new processing capabilities and enhance existing processors to support new weather data providers, data formats, business requirements, and product features.
  • Apply advanced backend and software development skills to build data processing software that's easily tested, deployed, and monitored.
  • Own design and implementation of database schemas and supporting SQL objects used by backend processing applications.

  • Mentor less experienced Software Developers in relational schema design and backend data processing practices.
  • Define documentation standards for software components, processing workflows, and operational procedures, ensuring the team's collective knowledge stays current and usable without you in the room.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and development practices for team-wide adoption, making the call on what gets brought into the processing platform and what doesn't.
  • Contribute to technical planning and the continuous improvement of development processes, quality assurance practices, and team workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience designing and developing backend software or distributed systems.

  • Expertise in developing and deploying applications in cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Deep experience with relational database architecture, including schema design, SQL, and performance optimization at scale.
  • Proven experience architecting solutions for structured and semi-structured data formats such as XML and JSON, RESTful APIs, and regular expressions, across multiple external data providers.
  • Experience leading software design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision-making.

· Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing or developing event-driven, distributed, or message-based systems.
  • Experience working with weather, environmental, geospatial, or other Earth science data.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple external providers or APIs.

- Proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server.

  • Proficiency developing applications on Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience providing technical guidance to other software developers.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced development environment.

· Skills & Competencies

  • Communicates at a high level across verbal and written communication with internal and external teams; leading training and informational sessions.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and share knowledge with other team members.

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs..

In compliance with applicable pay transparency requirements, the application window for this position is expected to close on October 9, 2026, subject to change based on business need.

A Day in the Life and the Impact You’ll Make:

You will help save lives, reduce serious injuries, and improve the culture of DEKRA’s clients through organizational change initiatives that drive safety performance improvement through client engagements. Our Consultant positions are critical for the overall success of any client engagement, and are the lynch pin between the front line through the organization to the c-suite.

The overall objective of our Consultants is to utilize organizational change knowledge to deliver the results that our clients are seeking, become a trusted advisor, and expand the scope and breadth of existing client engagements. When leading projects, they are accountable for assuring that their team can effectively delivery our primary Consulting solutions with excellence by coaching and mentoring with sincere, candid feedback.

To be successful in this position our Consultants will need a deep understanding of our centerline solutions, be able to adapt these solutions to meet client objectives and understand how the offering can be integrated into the client organization.

What You’ll Do:

Depending on experience, skills, and client needs DEKRA Consultants spend time in a variety of ways:

  • Delivering workshops and presentations to groups of various size.
  • Conducting one-on-one or small group field coaching with clients.
  • With advancement to Project Lead Consultant, perform client-related project management working on smaller to gradually larger and more complex projects.

Three key performance areas summarize the scope of this position:

Client Facing responsibilities:

  • Understand the client’s objectives and needs and adapt the centerline model for the client engagement giving the greatest probability of success.
  • Understand the role of Governance in Safety
  • Ability to establish effective safety governance that aligns with the client organizational structure and functioning.
  • Guide and facilitate measurable governance.
  • Delivering DEKRA’s suite of solutions with mastery of the concepts combined with industry subject matter expertise.
  • Utilize centerline positions and materials that illustrate DEKRA’s Point of View on leadership, safety, and project execution.
  • Coach client leaders from the frontlines to senior leaders and become their trusted advisor.
  • Track progress in meeting client objectives and adjust when necessary.
  • Develop a communication structure to reliably remain up to date on the client’s situation including safety performance, successes, business challenges, industry trends, etc.
  • Communicate routinely and effectively to the client leadership team.
  • Practice honesty: be truthful with the client, in a manner that preserves the relationship, even when it’s hard to do so.

Team Responsibilities:

  • Create excellent deliverables internally so peers and project leaders can efficiently do their part.
  • Meet deadlines.
  • When leading others on client projects:
    • Enable and manage the success of the project team
    • Assure all solutions are integrated and aligned toward meeting client objectives
    • Communicate routinely and effectively to delivery team, and the overall project team
    • Assure the project team delivers to the client’s adaptation of the centerline, across all parts of the client organization
    • Deliver performance-related feedback to individual consultants, including areas for improvement and recognition for positive contributions
    • Escalate project related consultant success stories and guidance feedback to appropriate management levels

Business Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to a safe and healthy work environment by actively participating, taking responsibility, and following established procedures and policies.
  • Maintain a complete and accurate project plan for the life of the project including consultant scheduling to meet delivery needs
  • Meet goals of personally delivering billable hours as assigned by your manager in addition to working on assigned internal projects
  • Manage projects toward stated realization rate, ensuring effective utilization of consultants
  • Achieve monthly forecast accuracy
  • Expand the scope of client relationships and maintain long term engagements by identifying additional areas of opportunity and surface to the Project/Program Manager
  • Maintain a professional brand of credibility internally at DEKRA and externally within the marketplace
  • Gain acceptance by existing clients to be references for future projects

What You’ll Bring:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in organizational change, or operations with safety responsibility, or in an industrial consulting role, or in a safety role
  • Certifications/Licenses: CSP or equivalent, LEAN Green/Black Belt preferred
  • Presence in front of Leaders – first line though senior manager
  • Demonstrated cognitive flexibility
  • Ability to successfully navigate client ambiguity
  • Ability to develop deep knowledge of DEKRA solutions
  • Ability to interpret the impact of non-safety processes on safety and culture
  • Ability to develop a strategic plan which supports the scope of work and overall safety excellence
  • Ability to manage client excellence and DEKRA business
  • Ability to create a project team culture that supports and aligns with business values
  • Fluency with various Governance structures and how they “fit” and function in various situations
  • Fluency with leading and lagging metrics and the ability to proposes specific metrics for the client
  • Fluency in applying effective change management
  • Fluency in Safety Management System best practices and ability to propose enhancements to close gaps
  • Ability to lead a matrixed team
  • Ability to develop others

Physical Considerations:

  • Must be able to work in a variety of client locations, environments, and conditions. This may include climbing stairs, walking long distances, walking on rough and uneven terrain, walking through client work facilities, working in heat/cold conditions, indoors and outdoors.
  • Must be able to accommodate working various shifts as client activities are scheduled.
  • Must be able to withstand the rigors of extensive travel.
  • May require difficult travel and long periods of driving.
  • Ability to move and conduct work with full range of motion.
  • Ability to lift 25-50lbs (luggage)
  • Extended periods of computer-based work
  • Extended periods of standing

Travel Considerations:

  • Domestic and/or potential for international travel required, estimated up to 75%.

What You’ll Receive for the Value You Bring:

Compensation:

This position allows for hourly professional fees according to confirmed project work; with fees ranging from $50/hour to $130/hour. Actual pay is based on several factors including market location, position-related knowledge, skills, and experience, and placement in a specific consulting level based on experience and work history.

Additional Position Details:

  • Reports to: VP Consulting Leader
  • Work Model:Remote
  • Work Location:US-based Remote
  • Supervises Others:No
  • Status: Part-time, Flexible
  • FLSA Classification:Non-exempt
  • Visa Sponsorship Eligibility:This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Growth in DEKRA:

DEKRA colleagues are welcome to apply for any position that is a potential match with their qualifications if performance in their current role is in good standing. The career path following this specific role is as follows:

  • Senior Consultant
  • Principal Consultant

About Us:

As a global provider of comprehensive services and solutions, we help our customers improve their safety, security, and sustainability outcomes. DEKRA is the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification (TIC) companies offering innovative professional services in the fields of vehicle inspection, expert appraisals, industrial product testing & certification, management system certifications, leadership consulting, and much more. DEKRA is a purpose-driven organization with a deep passion to make the world a safer place on the road, at work, and at home. In DEKRA, you will be part of a continuously growing organization with a near 100-year history involved in more than 50 countries on five continents.

MentorMate, part of Tieto Tech Consulting is looking for a highly skilled and motivated Roaming Business Expert, a professional who will join a project within a Telecom Team for our respectful client BICS.

Join the team of our customer BICS – a global telecommunication enabler with a physical network stretching through the globe! Grow your expertise through interacting with A-level mobile carriers from all over the world. Get your hands on the vast network with on land, underwater, and space points of presence.Join our decade-long partnership with BICS to ensure confidence in your future and long-term growth! Tieto-BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to grow with you!

  • Develop your telecom expertise in diverse portfolio of BICS products, including Voice, Cloud, Signaling, LTE, IoT, etc.
  • Enjoy unmatched growth opportunities with BICS vast network and customers around the world.

Tieto - BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to growing with you!

Role Purpose:

The Roaming business Expert is responsible for representing the commercial interests of a designated customer in all roaming-related negotiations with international mobile network operators (MNOs). The role ensures that Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) agreements are aligned with the customer’s strategic goals and budget expectations, while maintaining strong industry relationships and ensuring compliance with regulatory and contractual frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Representation:
    • Act as the commercial voice of the customer in all IOT negotiations, ensuring their strategic and financial objectives are met.
    • Translate customer P&L targets into negotiation strategies and commercial outcomes.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management:
    • Lead bilateral and multilateral negotiations with roaming partners and groups to secure optimal IOT terms.
    • Ensure contracts reflect agreed commercial conditions and are aligned with GSMA standards and RAEX processes.
    • Monitor contract lifecycle and proactively manage renewals and amendments.
  • Financial Reconciliation & Settlements:
    • Perform regular reconciliations between operational and financial data (e.g., invoices, payments, service delivery, usage reports).
    • Validate and process settlement reports, ensuring accuracy of financial postings and balances.
    • Perform Monthly Accruals for discounted commercial deals.
    • Support monthly and quarterly financial closing activities, ensuring all settlements are captured and accrued correctly.
  • Commercial Strategy & Analysis:
    • Analyse roaming traffic, cost trends, and partner performance to identify negotiation opportunities.
    • Collaborate with finance, pricing, and analytics teams to model commercial scenarios and assess impact on customer P&L.
    • Support the development of roaming pricing strategies and discount frameworks.
  • Stakeholder Engagement:
    • Maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g., finance, legal, operations) and external roaming partners.
    • Provide regular updates and reporting to the customer on negotiation progress, risks, and outcomes.
  • Market Intelligence & Compliance:
    • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive benchmarks.
    • Ensure all agreements comply with GSMA guidelines, roaming regulations, and internal governance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Telecommunications, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in roaming, wholesale, or telecom commercial roles
  • Experience negotiating IOT agreements or managing roaming partnerships
  • Fluency in verbal and spoken English; additional languages are a plus
  • Strong presentation skills

Personal Skills

  • Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, adapt, and continuously improve negotiation strategies and outcomes
  • Can-Do Attitude: Proactive, solution-oriented, and resilient in the face of challenges
  • Accountability: Takes ownership of deliverables and follows through on commitments
  • Collaborative Spirit: Easy to work with, respectful, and able to build trust across cultures and teams
  • Professionalism: Maintains a high standard of integrity, discretion, and customer focus in all interactions

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Federated Registry Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases.
jobs.description:
Company Overview
Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases. We develop medicines for previously untreatable or undertreated diseases. We recognize the courage it takes for patients and their caregivers to begin their journey of advocacy to find the answers they need. Their courage inspires us to challenge convention, ask bold questions and seek answers for them. Every day, we strive for excellence through our willingness to adapt, learn, and our tenacity to overcome barriers, together.

Opportunity Overview
The Federated Registry Data scientist will contribute to the design, development and operation of a multi-country federated registry platform based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model (OMOP CDM), in collaboration with specialized vendors for Extract-Transform-Load (ETL), hosting, and federated analyses.
The role will serve as a primary point of contact between Rhythm, the selected vendors, and participating registries for data-related activities. The Data Scientist will oversee the local registry data collection (mapping, transformation, quality-check) and the federated analyses specifications and outputs within a federated OMOP CDM-based environment provided and maintained by the vendors.

Responsibilities & Duties
  • Federated analyses
  • Oversee and supervise the vendor’s technical and analytical deliverables
  • Oversee data collection, data quality check, ETL logic and data mapping to OMOP CDM
  • Lead preparation and review of the statistical analysis plan, cohort definitions, variable definitions, and federated query specifications supported and executed by the vendors based on research questions proposed by the Scientific Committee, the participating centers or internally
  • Perform external research proposals’ feasibility assessment before review by the Scientific Committee
  • Ensure analytical outputs are clear and consistent with research questions, develop report for review by the scientific committee, and support the drafting of related publications
  • Collaboration with vendors
  • Collaborate with the vendor on source data review, OMOP mapping, ETL logic, and data quality checks, helping to identify, prioritize, and resolve quality issues
  • Help with data-related questions raised by the vendor and coordinate timely responses from centers when local input is required
  • Ensure that data-related discussions remain aligned with Rhythm’s scientific objectives, project scope, timelines, and budget
  • Collaboration with sites/registries owners
  • Support sites in understanding project data requirements, minimum datasets, expected formats, timelines, and quality control processes
  • Coordinate with sites and the vendor to investigate data quality issues such as missing data, inconsistent values, duplicate records, etc.
  • Collaborate with research teams (scientific committees, internal stakeholders, participating sites) to develop insights and drive evidence generation
  • Perform any other relevant tasks as needed to support the team and company objectives.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent scientific or technical discipline
  • Strong experience with healthcare data sources, including clinical registries, electronic health records, claims databases, healthcare databases, and real-world evidence projects
  • Strong proficiency in R and/or Python
  • Knowledge of healthcare standards, including OMOP CDM, Fast Health Interoperability Resources (FHIR), Systemized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), etc.
  • Knowledge of statistical methods in real-world evidence (RWE)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with senior leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Not accepting the status quo, working with a sense of urgency to deliver results
  • Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
  • Cross-functional mindset focused on a seamless collaboration with internal and external partners
  • Fluent in English
This role is home office based.Rhythm operates in a hybrid-work model. Candidates applying must be willing and able travel internationally.

More about Rhythm
We are a dynamic and growing global team spanning more than a dozen countries. At Rhythm we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients living with rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) pathway diseases by rapidly advancing care and precision medicines that address the root cause. Our team is passionate about expanding access to reach more patients and developing novel therapies for other rare neuroendocrine diseases, including congenital hyperinsulinism.

At Rhythm Our Core Values Are
We are committed to advancing scientific understanding to improve patients’ lives
We are inspired to tackle tough challenges and have the courage to ask bold questions
We are eager to learn and adapt
We believe collaboration and ownership are foundational for our success
We value the unique contribution each individual brings to furthering our mission
Inherent in our core values is the commitment to act ethically and with integrity in all we do.

This is a remote position.

Blog Marketing Intern
Fully Remote · 3-Month Contract · Full-Time Internship

Role Overview

As a Blog Marketing Intern, you will take ownership of creating, managing, and optimizing written content that drives engagement, builds brand awareness, and supports each venture's content strategy. Your primary focus will be on producing high-quality, SEO-optimized blog posts aligned with audience insights and brand voice.

You will leverage AI-based writing and analytics platforms to enhance content quality, accelerate production, and measure performance — all while working closely with senior marketing and leadership teams across multiple high-growth ventures.

Key Responsibilities

Blog Content Creation

  • Research, write, and edit engaging blog posts aligned with each brand's voice and tone.
  • Develop topic ideas and content calendars based on audience insights and industry trends.
  • Ensure all content meets quality standards for clarity, structure, and storytelling.
  • Collaborate with senior team members to align posts with broader marketing goals.

SEO Optimization

  • Optimize blog posts with targeted keywords, proper formatting, and internal linking.
  • Apply on-page SEO best practices to improve search visibility and organic reach.
  • Track and analyze blog performance metrics (traffic, time on page, bounce rate) to inform future strategy.
  • Use tools like SurferSEO, Google Search Console, or similar platforms to guide optimization.

AI-Assisted Writing & Workflow

  • Use AI writing tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Jasper, Write sonic) to accelerate content drafting and ideation.
  • Explore automation opportunities to streamline content production and publishing workflows.
  • Maintain consistency in voice, tone, and messaging across all content output.

Content Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor key content metrics and compile regular performance reports.
  • Recommend improvements to content strategy based on data insights.
  • Stay up-to-date with content marketing trends, SEO algorithm updates, and industry news.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 0–1 year of experience in content writing, blogging, or digital marketing (internship or project experience counts).
  • Demonstrated ability to write clearly and compellingly across different topics and formats.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for content creation and optimization is required.
  • Exposure to SEO principles and content analytics platforms is a strong plus.

Skills

  • Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to research complex topics and translate them into accessible, reader-friendly content.
  • Organized and self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a remote environment.
  • Creative thinker with a genuine interest in content marketing and digital strategy.

Education

Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote internship with flexible working hours.
  • Mentorship from experienced marketing and venture-building professionals.
  • Real-world exposure to content strategy, SEO, and AI-powered writing workflows.
  • Opportunity to contribute across multiple high-growth ventures with diverse content needs.
  • Competitive internship stipend aligned with global remote standards.
  • A strong portfolio piece: published blog content with measurable impact.

Why Join Us

This role offers a unique opportunity to build a real content portfolio, sharpen your SEO instincts, and learn directly from senior marketing professionals. Whether you're starting your career or pivoting into content marketing, this internship gives you the tools, mentorship, and hands-on experience to hit the ground running.

jobs.description:
Project Name:

Digital Regulatory Assurance System

Scope:

Modernization initiatives across the Government of Alberta are fundamentally changing how ministry users collect, manage, analyze, and use data as legacy systems are transformed into modern Data Management and Geospatial Platforms. This shift requires dedicated analytical capacity to ensure that the value of modernized data assets is fully realized.

DRAS is a Government of Alberta regulatory transformation initiative led by Environment and Protected Areas (EPA) to modernize, digitize, and streamline environmental and natural resource regulatory processes. DRAS supports the full regulatory lifecycle, from application and authorization to monitoring, compliance, remediation, and closure through a single, consolidated digital platform

As DRAS development continues, the volume, variety, and complexity of structured data continue to grow, creating a sustained need for dedicated data engineering and data product expertise. The Data Product Analyst role is critical to ensuring that modernization delivers tangible business value. This role will design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data into the DMP, apply standardized transformations, enforce data quality and governance controls, and produce trusted, analytics‑ready datasets that support regulatory oversight, compliance monitoring, and evidence‑based decision‑making aligned with DRAS objectives.

This position will primarily support the Digital Regulatory Assurance System (DRAS) program, where high quality, timely analytics are essential to regulatory and compliance functions. As data and analytics maturity increases, the role may be expanded to support additional enterprise data initiatives.

Duties:

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance data architecture on Microsoft Azure, supporting both cloud-native and hybrid environments.
  • Lead the development of data ingestion, transformation, and integration pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
  • Work with the Data Architect and manage data lakes and structured storage solutions using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, ensuring efficient access and governance.
  • Integrate data from diverse source systems including ServiceNow, and geospatial systems, using APIs, connectors, and custom scripts.
  • Develop and maintain robust data models and semantic layers to support operational reporting, analytics, and machine learning use cases.
  • Build and optimize data workflows using Python and SQL for data cleansing, enrichment, and advanced analytics within Azure Databricks.
  • Design and expose secure data services and APIs using Azure API Management for downstream systems.
  • Implement data governance practices, including metadata management, data classification, and lineage tracking.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy and regulatory standards (e.g., FOIP, GDPR) through role-based access controls, encryption, and data masking.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across the platform.
  • Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline data engineering workflows, including pipeline development, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools for code generation, optimization, and review to improve development efficiency and code quality.
  • Design and curate standardized, high‑quality datasets that are suitable for advanced analytics and future AI use cases.
  • Other duties as needed

jobs.description:
Job Title

VP, Strategy & Operations, Advisory Technology

Job Description Summary

Job Description

About the Role

Cushman & Wakefield is evolving how technology supports its Advisory business, moving toward a more product-led model that better connects business priorities, technology delivery, broker enablement and client needs.

The VP, Strategy & Operations will be a senior leader within the Advisory Technology organization, supporting the Head of Technology by synthesizing input from Product, Architecture, Engineering, and the business into one coherent agenda, running the cadences that keep execution aligned, and representing data & technology priorities across the Advisory business, inclusive of Occupier, Investor, Market Leadership, Revenue Operations & Marketing. Part of this synthesis includes ensuring the technology roadmap and delivery plan stay visibly aligned to the commercial objectives set by the Chief Revenue Officer, so that technology investment and go-to-market priorities move in the same direction.

The role will also lead Client Care, Broker Technology Support, Salesforce Platform Support, and Digital Enablement, ensuring brokers, field teams, and the broader Americas Salesforce user base are effectively onboarded, trained, supported, and set up to adopt new technology capabilities.

This position sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and field enablement. It is designed for a leader who can connect teams, establish clear priorities, resolve execution dependencies, and put in place the operating discipline needed to move complex initiatives forward, including cross-tower coordination, intake and readiness governance, and operating cadence.

What Will Do

Strategy & Business Alignment

  • Partner with the Head of Technology, Advisory business leaders, and Product leads to synthesize business priorities, product roadmaps, and field/broker needs into one coherent technology and transformation agenda across Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Investor/Occupier Products.
  • Ensure roadmaps are connected, sequenced, and visible as part of a single integrated plan.
  • Connect broker, client and field needs with technology investment and product priorities.
  • Maintain an integrated view of strategic initiatives, dependencies, risks and resource needs across teams.
  • Ensure technology priorities and delivery remain aligned to CRO-defined commercial objectives, flagging and helping resolve gaps between the technology agenda and sales/commercial priorities as they arise.
  • Help leadership make trade-offs when priorities compete for limited capacity, drawing on input from product and business leads rather than setting direction independently of it.

Client Care, Broker Support & Digital Enablement

  • Lead the team responsible for client care, broker technology support, and Salesforce platform support across the Americas, spanning all Salesforce instances and user populations.
  • Own digital enablement: onboarding, training, and hands-on adoption support for brokers, field teams, and other Salesforce users as new capabilities are introduced.
  • Ensure new products and platform capabilities have clear launch, training, and field-readiness plans.
  • Develop scalable enablement approaches across products, regions, and user populations, brokerage and non-brokerage alike.
  • Use adoption data, support trends, and platform-wide feedback to identify improvement opportunities and inform future product priorities.
  • Support platform governance and data quality for Salesforce; CRM strategy and roadmap decisions for Investor and Occupier products remain owned by the respective Product Owners, who this role partners with as peers.

Product Operations & Rollout Readiness

  • Ensure new products and capabilities are fully ready before rollout, defining and holding teams to clear readiness criteria before launch, rather than launching and fixing issues afterward.
  • Confirm that support model, training materials, documentation, monitoring, and escalation paths are stood up and in place prior to go-live, not built reactively after adoption issues surface.
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering & Delivery to close the gap between proof-of-concept and production-ready, so initiatives don't move to rollout before the operational foundation is in place.
  • Own go/no-go readiness checks for major launches, coordinating across enablement, support, and platform teams to confirm the organization can actually absorb and support what's being released.
  • Build a repeatable intake and readiness-gate framework so rollout preparation becomes a consistent discipline across products, rather than being defined ad hoc for each launch.

Cross-Team Execution & Coordination

  • Work across Product Management, Sales, Architecture and Engineering & Delivery to keep priorities and execution aligned.
  • Coordinate shared resources and dependencies where initiatives span multiple teams.
  • Help resolve day-to-day execution trade-offs and escalate material strategic or funding decisions when needed.
  • Ensure initiatives remain connected from business prioritization through design, delivery, launch and adoption.

Operating Model & Governance

  • Establish planning, prioritization and leadership-review cadences across Advisory Technology.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into portfolio progress, capacity, risks, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Define practical governance and escalation mechanisms that support faster decision-making without adding unnecessary process.
  • Drive follow-through on key decisions and cross-functional commitments, acting as a trusted extension of the Head of Technology in day-to-day coordination and communication across the organization.

How the Role Works with Other Leaders

This role will not replace the accountability of individual technology functions. Product leaders, including the Investor and Occupier Product Owners, will continue to own product strategy, roadmaps, and CRM direction for their domains as peers to this role, not as functions this role directs. Enterprise Architecture will own architecture direction and technology standards; Engineering will own software delivery.

The VP, Strategy & Operations will own Client Care, Broker Support, Digital Enablement, Operations and Salesforce Platform Support while also connecting across Product, Engineering and Architecture when priorities, resources or dependencies span multiple teams, synthesizing their input into one integrated agenda rather than setting strategy independently.

The role operates as a close strategic partner and day-to-day extension of the Head of Technology, helping translate their priorities into coordinated execution, running the cadences and follow-through that keep the organization aligned, and representing those priorities across teams. Engagement with the Chief Revenue Officer's commercial priorities happens through this role's coordination work, not as a direct reporting relationship; the Head of Technology remains the primary interface with senior business leadership, including the CRO.

What Success Looks Like

  • Business and technology priorities are clearly connected.
  • Leadership has better visibility into priorities, capacity and execution.
  • Cross-functional dependencies are resolved faster.
  • Brokers and the broader Americas Salesforce user base are better prepared to adopt new technology.
  • Field and platform-wide feedback consistently informs product and technology decisions.
  • Technology spending and vendor commitments are managed with stronger discipline.
  • Strategic initiatives move from decision to execution with fewer organizational handoffs.
  • Major launches consistently meet readiness criteria before go-live, reducing reactive post-launch fixes.

What We Are Looking For

  • Senior leadership experience spanning strategy, operations, transformation, technology or commercial organizations.
  • Experience operating as a trusted strategic partner and extension of a senior leader, translating their priorities into coordinated execution across teams.
  • Experience working across product, technology, business and field-facing teams in a complex matrixed environment.
  • Strong ability to translate strategy into priorities, operating plans and measurable execution.
  • Experience leading organizational change, technology adoption or enablement at scale.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience with portfolio management, budgeting, vendor management and operational governance.
  • Experience establishing readiness or launch-governance disciplines (e.g., go/no-go processes, stage gates) in a technology or product organization.
  • Ability to make practical trade-offs, resolve ambiguity and drive decisions across teams without relying solely on formal reporting authority.



Cushman & Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Job Summary

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will serve as a high-efficiency technical expert and internal consultant across assigned projects and service lines. Adopting a proactive, solution-oriented mindset, this role leads the design, development, and deployment of advanced machine learning models and statistical solutions to transform healthcare outcomes and optimize operational performance. You will drive complex analyses, document departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and partner closely with cross-functional clinical and technical leaders to translate raw data into scalable, automated, high-impact solutions that align with strategic organizational objectives.

Essential Functions

  • Advanced Analytics & Insights: Independently perform advanced analysis of clinical and operational datasets, translating complex findings into actionable insights for senior clinical and executive leadership.
  • Machine Learning & Modeling: Assess and select appropriate data fit to develop, test, and deploy machine learning algorithms that predict high-value clinical and operational outcomes across multiple service areas.
  • NLP & Text Solutions: Utilize natural language processing (NLP) techniques and frameworks (such as BERT, spaCy, NLTK, and Large Language Models) to develop text-based solutions that optimize documentation-focused workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with healthcare professionals, domain experts, and IT/data engineering teams to source raw data, understand operational needs, and build production-line style data pipelines and visualizations.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Leverage cloud-based technologies, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP), for scalable data storage, processing, deployment, and process automation.
  • Experimentation & Execution: Design and execute experiments, interpret results, and present metrics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Standards: Maintain regular, reliable attendance and adhere strictly to all organizational policies and standard operating procedures. Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related field required.
  • Master's Degree preferred.
  • 5-7 years of experience in healthcare data engineering and analytics in a clinical or biomedical research setting required.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working within a large healthcare system, hospital, or payer environment.
  • Ability to travel on-site 2 to 4 times per year for executive leadership presentations.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Cloud Platforms: Strong proficiency with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for end-to-end data processing, storage, and algorithm deployment.
  • Programming & Libraries: Advanced proficiency in Python and core data science libraries, including PyTorch, Keras, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow.
  • Natural Language Processing: Practical experience building NLP solutions with frameworks like spaCy, BERT, NLTK, or modern LLMs.
  • Data Visualization: Expertise with modern visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and programmatic libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly) to build interactive executive dashboards and operational tracking tools.
  • Professional Mindset: Strong problem-solving capabilities, an internal-consultant drive, and the ability to work independently to establish metrics with high efficiency.
  • Communication: Outstanding presentation skills with a mission-driven approach to translating technical concepts to executive leadership.

This is a fully remote opportunity

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer.

With healthcare delivery systems in 36 distinct markets across 14 states, CHS operates 69 affiliated hospitals with more than 10,000 beds and approximately 1,000 other sites of care, including physician practices, urgent care centers, freestanding emergency departments, imaging centers, cancer centers, and ambulatory surgery centers.

  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF).
