Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies.   • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required.

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Fluency in both German and English

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.

  • Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.

What we’re looking for:

We’re seeking a strategic, technically fluent Data Product Manager to join the Utility Data Platform team. This person will own the requirements and roadmap for Arcadia’s unified data model: the extensible data architecture that powers Expense Management, Energy Intelligence, Bill Acquisition, and every other data product built on the Arcadia platform. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable in a data model diagram, a stakeholder alignment meeting, and a roadmap review, and can turn many teams’ competing data needs into one coherent, extensible model that serves the needs of itsdata consumers.

Arcadia is open to fully remote candidates and employees have access to co-working spaces.

•Experience with agile delivery, including backlog management, sprint planning, and road-mapping.

•Familiarity with utility billing, tariff, or usage data structures.

You will embed with customer engineering and operations teams, use modern AI development tools to build production software rapidly, integrate it into existing technology stacks, and lead complex technical deployments to measurable outcomes. Engagements favor supported, generally available Sinch APIs and repeatable implementation patterns. The goal is to accelerate the customer into production and leave its engineering team able to operate and extend the implementation, not to create a permanent dependency on the FDE team.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Help qualify the engagement. Evaluate technical readiness, feasibility, customer ownership, likely adoption, product gaps, and repeatability. Provide evidence and recommendations to the FDE lead and commercial owner, who make engagement and continued-investment decisions.

  • Lead technical delivery end to end. Run discovery, map workflows and dependencies, define measurable success and sign-off criteria, create the delivery plan, and own execution from prototype through production stabilization and handoff.

  • Design the solution. Translate business workflows into architectures that combine Sinch messaging, voice, or email APIs with customer applications, identity, data, events, AI systems, cloud platforms, and third-party services.

  • Build with AI and remain accountable. Use coding agents and AI-enabled development tools for codebase discovery, implementation, refactoring, tests, troubleshooting, and documentation. Validate generated output for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and customer fit.

  • Prove quality. Create unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, load, resilience, and failover tests. Validate business workflows, API and event behavior, recovery, migration, and rollback.

  • Make the system observable. Instrument structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, and cross-system correlation using Sinch identifiers, callbacks, delivery events, product telemetry, and protocol evidence where relevant.

  • Navigate security and compliance. Partner with customer security, privacy, legal, and communications teams on authentication, data handling, consent, regional requirements, channel regulations, and architecture review.

  • Drive adoption and handoff. Train customer engineers, document architecture and runbooks, establish ownership, and leave the customer able to operate and extend its implementation.

  • Use named SMEs deliberately. Rely heavily on assigned SMEs during ramp-up and early engagements. Bring evidence, absorb their guidance, and document what was learned. Become self-sufficient in routine delivery, using SMEs thereafter to stay current with product, technology, market, and use-case changes and for exceptional deep-domain issues.

THE TECHNICAL SURFACE

Your primary depth should be in production software delivery, enterprise integration, and operations. You are not expected to arrive as a deep expert in Voice, Messaging, and Email. You must bring meaningful exposure to at least one communications domain, learn adjacent products rapidly with named SME support during ramp-up, become self-sufficient in routine delivery, and know when material changes or unusual complexity require specialist input.

  • AI-assisted software delivery: coding agents and AI-enabled development environments used for discovery, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, review, and documentation, with human verification and engineering accountability throughout

  • Enterprise integration: REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous events, identity and access, data mapping, queues, event buses, CRMs, contact centers, data stores, legacy services, and customer-specific operating standards

  • Production engineering: automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers or serverless, scalability, resilience, performance, secrets, logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident response, and operational handoff

  • Voice: Voice APIs and callbacks, call flows, PSTN, SIP and WebRTC concepts, numbers, routing, recording, streaming, and common signaling, media, or network dependencies

  • Messaging: SMS, MMS, RCS, WhatsApp and Conversation API patterns; senders, templates, provisioning, delivery events, opt-in, country requirements, routing, and channel limitations

  • Email: API and SMTP sending, domains and DNS authentication, templates, webhooks, deliverability, bounces, complaints, suppressions, reputation, and regional processing

  • Customer deployment platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containers, serverless, or on-premises environments, including regional placement, data residency, secrets, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code

REQUIREMENTS

  • Typically 7+ years of professional experience across software engineering, enterprise integration, solution delivery, or technical consulting, including substantial direct work with enterprise customers. Equivalent depth matters more than a specific degree or title.

  • A record of personally architecting, building, deploying, operating, and supporting API-driven production systems, not only presenting demos or handing designs to another team.

  • Strong production software skills in at least one relevant stack such as TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, or C#/.NET, with sound API, event-driven, authentication, security, testing, code-review, and maintainability practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to use coding agents or other AI development tools to accelerate working software, tests, troubleshooting, and documentation while independently validating the results.

  • Experience integrating new software into existing enterprise technology stacks, including APIs, webhooks, data stores, identity systems, cloud services, events, and operational processes.

  • Strong command of testing, scalability, and observability, including automated test strategy, capacity and failure-mode design, structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, and cross-system correlation.

  • Experience deploying services on at least one major cloud platform using modern delivery practices such as Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers or serverless, secrets management, and regional design.

  • Meaningful exposure to at least one communications domain such as programmable voice, messaging, or email. Experience across multiple domains is valuable but is not required.

  • Ability to learn adjacent CPaaS products rapidly with heavy initial support from named SMEs, then apply that guidance independently in normal delivery work.

  • Clear written and verbal communication across engineers, product specialists, security reviewers, business owners, and executives, including the ability to teach and create shared clarity under pressure.

  • Delivery judgment under ambiguity: scope an MVP, make tradeoffs, surface risks early, protect the critical path, and remain calm during planned cutovers and production stabilization.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 10-15% and support planned customer workshops and cutovers. This is not a standing customer-support or on-call assignment.

Preferred

  • Depth in one or more of programmable Voice, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, Email, Numbers, Verification, SIP trunking, or related communications technologies.

  • Experience with AI-native companies, conversational AI, agentic systems, speech technologies, or real-time AI integrations.

OVERVIEW

Our client is an established New Zealand-based provider of temporary traffic management solutions, supporting construction, infrastructure, maintenance, and other projects that require safe and compliant traffic management. The company delivers traffic management planning, onsite support, professional consulting, and related services, working closely with contractors, project teams, road authorities, and traffic management personnel to develop practical solutions that protect workers, road users, pedestrians, and the public. We are looking for an experienced Temporary Traffic Management Plan (TMP) Designer to join the team remotely and take responsibility for preparing accurate and practical Traffic Management Plans, traffic management diagrams, Corridor Access Requests (CARs), permits, and supporting documentation for New Zealand projects. The role will involve collaborating with Operations teams, clients, STMS personnel, contractors, councils, and Road Controlling Authorities (RCAs) to ensure plans meet project requirements, safety standards, and approval requirements, while also reviewing project information, identifying risks or missing details, and coordinating amendments when necessary. This opportunity is well suited to a technically strong TMP professional with solid New Zealand traffic management planning experience who can work independently, manage multiple projects and deadlines, and consistently deliver clear, practical, and accurate plans for onsite implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and update Traffic Management Plans in line with NZGTTM principles, RCA requirements, and project specifications.
  • Develop clear and accurate traffic management diagrams and supporting documentation.
  • Review project drawings, work methodologies, site information, and client requirements before preparing plans.
  • Develop practical and risk-based temporary traffic management solutions.
  • Prepare and coordinate Corridor Access Requests, permits, and related documentation.
  • Submit plans and applications to relevant Road Controlling Authorities.
  • Monitor approval progress and coordinate responses to RCA feedback, amendments, and requests for additional information.
  • Work closely with Operations and STMS personnel to understand project requirements and provide planning support.
  • Liaise with clients, councils, RCAs, contractors, and other stakeholders regarding planning requirements.
  • Identify missing, unclear, or conflicting information and obtain clarification where required.
  • Update plans when project requirements, methodology, dates, or site conditions change.
  • Maintain accurate records of plan versions, submissions, amendments, approvals, and supporting documents.
  • Ensure approved plans are clear, practical, and easy for onsite teams to interpret and implement.
  • Escalate complex, unusual, or high-risk planning matters when additional technical input is required.
  • Manage multiple plans, applications, revisions, and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of planning processes, templates, and documentation.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in traffic management planning, TMP design, or a closely related field.
  • Proven experience preparing Traffic Management Plans for New Zealand projects.
  • Strong working knowledge of NZGTTM principles and New Zealand RCA requirements.
  • Experience preparing Corridor Access Requests (CARs), permits, and associated documentation.
  • Experience using RapidPlan or comparable traffic management planning software.
  • Ability to interpret project drawings, work methodologies, site information, and operational requirements.
  • Understanding of risk-based temporary traffic management design.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate documentation.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, amendments, submissions, and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong communication skills when working with clients, operational teams, councils, and approval authorities.
  • Ability to work independently and escalate complex technical matters appropriately.
  • Comfortable working remotely with a New Zealand-based team.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office environment.
  • Availability to work New Zealand business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Current or previous New Zealand TTM Planner qualification.
  • Current or previous STMS qualification.
  • Previous operational traffic management experience.
  • Experience working with multiple New Zealand RCAs.
  • Experience preparing plans involving lane closures, pedestrian management, contraflow, Stop/Go operations, road closures, and other TTM methods.
  • Experience managing RCA amendments through to approval.
  • Previous experience working remotely with a New Zealand traffic management company.

Tools & Software

  • RapidPlan or comparable TMP planning software
  • RCA submission platforms
  • Corridor Access Request platforms
  • Digital mapping tools
  • Traffic management plan-design/drafting software
  • Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace
  • PDF editing software
  • Document management systems
  • Project/task management platforms

  • Experience identifying financial trends, recurring billing or lease expense issues, and cost-reduction opportunities.

jobs.excerpt: Product Designer – UX/UI, Design Systems & SaaSLocation: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Product Designer – UX/UI, Design Systems & SaaS

Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end product design experience across web and mobile applications.

This is not a purely visual design role. We’re looking for someone who combines UX research, product thinking, UI design, prototyping, and design systems to solve real user problems and create intuitive, scalable digital products.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle — from understanding user needs and mapping workflows to designing polished interfaces, maintaining design systems, and supporting implementation.

If you think in user journeys, flows, systems, and outcomes — not just individual screens — this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

UX Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and product research.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify friction across the product experience.
  • Translate research into:
    • User flows
    • Journey maps
    • Personas
    • Wireframes
    • Interaction models
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to recommend product improvements.
  • Work with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar platforms to support design decisions.

UX/UI & Product Design

  • Own design from early concepts through production-ready interfaces.
  • Create:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • High-fidelity UI
  • Design intuitive experiences across web and mobile applications.
  • Simplify complex workflows into clear, user-friendly experiences.
  • Create responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Iterate quickly based on user feedback, product requirements, and analytics.

Figma & Design Systems

  • Work extensively in Figma to create and maintain production-ready designs.
  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Establish and document standards for:
    • Typography
    • Color
    • Spacing
    • Components
    • Interaction patterns
    • UI behavior
  • Maintain consistency across products, features, and platforms.
  • Improve collaboration and efficiency between Product, Design, and Engineering.

Accessibility & Usability

  • Design accessible experiences aligned with WCAG 2.1 principles.
  • Consider accessibility throughout the design process rather than as a final-stage requirement.
  • Ensure interfaces work effectively across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
  • Identify usability issues and continuously reduce friction across key workflows.

Testing, Analytics & Optimization

  • Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions.
  • Support A/B testing across:
    • Layouts
    • User flows
    • Features
    • Interaction patterns
  • Analyze user behavior and product feedback.
  • Use findings to improve:
    • Usability
    • Conversion
    • Engagement
    • Retention
    • Task completion
  • Continuously iterate on launched experiences rather than treating design as complete after handoff.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Product Managers
  • Engineers
  • Developers
  • Other product and business stakeholders

You will:

  • Translate product requirements into clear design solutions.
  • Participate in product discussions and feature planning.
  • Communicate design decisions and rationale clearly.
  • Prepare developer-ready designs, assets, and specifications.
  • Use Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools for handoff.
  • Review implementations and help resolve UX/UI inconsistencies before release.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional Product Design or UX/UI Design experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating real product design work.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma.
  • Experience designing responsive web and/or mobile applications.
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Interaction design
    • Information architecture
    • Responsive design
    • Usability testing
    • Accessibility
  • Experience collaborating directly with Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.

Portfolio Requirements

Your portfolio should demonstrate more than polished final screens.

We want to see evidence of:

  • The problem you were solving.
  • Your role in the project.
  • User or business requirements.
  • Research and discovery.
  • User flows and UX decisions.
  • Wireframes and prototypes.
  • Final UI execution.
  • Design system or component thinking.
  • How feedback, testing, or data influenced your decisions.
  • The outcome or impact of your work.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Experience designing SaaS products.
  • B2B or enterprise software design experience.
  • Consumer application experience.
  • Experience building or scaling mature design systems.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Hotjar
    • Product analytics platforms
  • Experience with experimentation and A/B testing.
  • Basic understanding of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Experience working in Agile or sprint-based product teams.
  • Familiarity with developer handoff through Figma Dev Mode or Zeplin.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Think about the entire user journey rather than isolated screens.
  • Can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions.
  • Balance user needs with product and business objectives.
  • Enjoy simplifying complicated workflows.
  • Use research, feedback, and data rather than designing entirely from intuition.
  • Think systematically about reusable components and patterns.
  • Care about accessibility and usability.
  • Collaborate effectively with engineers.
  • Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.
  • Can independently take a product problem from discovery through final design.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing product requirements with a Product Manager.
  • Analyzing user behavior or customer feedback.
  • Mapping a new user journey or workflow.
  • Creating wireframes for a new feature.
  • Building an interactive prototype in Figma.
  • Designing polished responsive interfaces.
  • Conducting or reviewing usability tests.
  • Updating components within the design system.
  • Working with engineers on implementation questions.
  • Reviewing a developed feature against the approved design.
  • Analyzing post-launch feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement.

In short: you turn user problems and product requirements into intuitive, scalable, accessible, and visually polished digital experiences.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved usability and task completion rates.
  • Increased product engagement and retention.
  • Reduced friction across critical user journeys.
  • Quality and consistency of UX/UI execution.
  • Design system adoption and consistency.
  • On-time delivery of design assets and prototypes.
  • Reduced design-related implementation rework.
  • Effective collaboration with Product and Engineering.
  • Positive user and stakeholder feedback.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • End-to-end ownership of meaningful product design work.
  • Direct influence on product experience and customer satisfaction.
  • Opportunity to work closely with Product and Engineering.
  • Ability to shape and scale the product’s design system.
  • Exposure to research, UX, UI, analytics, and experimentation.
  • Fully remote environment.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead Product Designer
    • Design Lead
    • Head of Design

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

  • Your experience as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer.
  • The types of SaaS, web, or mobile products you’ve designed.
  • A product or feature you designed end-to-end and the problem you were solving.
  • How you approach UX research before beginning the visual design process.
  • Your experience building or maintaining design systems in Figma.
  • An example of a complex workflow you simplified for users.
  • How you collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers during development.
  • How user feedback, usability testing, or analytics influenced one of your design decisions.

Please keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We’re interested in understanding your product thinking, communication ability, UX process, and the reasoning behind your design decisions.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Spark Hire Intro Video
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review
  • Practical Product Design Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution, understand how to build scalable design systems, and enjoy solving real product problems, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

The Adobe Business Group (ABG) Business Development Director (BDD) serves as Accenture's primary Adobe ecosystem growth leader, responsible for driving joint market development, origination, pipeline creation, and strategic partnership expansion with Adobe. Working across an industry, account teams, and Adobe leadership, the BDD identifies and develops joint opportunities, shapes market-relevant relationships and accelerates growth through deep Adobe specialization and ecosystem-led sales motions.

Strategic Focus Areas

This role sits at the intersection of sales, alliances, industry strategy, and innovation, helping clients unlock value through Adobe Experience Cloud, Content Supply Chain, Data & Personalization, and Generative AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute joint Accenture-Adobe growth strategies and co-sell motions for assigned accounts and clients.

  • Build relationships with Adobe Partner Development Managers, Sales and Industry Leaders, and Account Teams.

  • Originate opportunities involving Adobe Technologies.

  • Work closely with Accenture and Adobe leadership team to drive pipeline growth.

  • Lead executive workshops, innovation sessions, and value realization discussions.

  • Develop business cases and ROI narratives that align technology investments to measurable business outcomes.

  • Create differentiated industry solutions, thought leadership, and joint offerings aligned to Adobe priorities.

  • Enable Accenture and Adobe field teams on joint value propositions and strategic growth plays.

Travel is required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 50% depending on business need and client requirements.

What You'll Need:

  • Minimum 8 years of business development, sales, alliance, or consulting experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of complex pursuit management and opportunity development experience.
  • Minimum 2 years experience of Adobe technologies and offerings.
  • Experience building and maintaining a pipeline of $15M+
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with selling Adobe technologies and offerings.
  • Strong understanding of the Adobe Sales culture and preexisting relationship with the Adobe Sales Team (VP, RVP, AD etc.)
  • Comfortable with leveraging AI in day to day work and an understanding of the roles, benefits, and limitations of applying Generative and Agentic AI in a client environment.
  • Experience working with Global 2000 organizations.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to engage CIOs, CDAOs, CTOs, CISOs, COOs, and Line-of-Business leaders.
  • Experience selling or shaping enterprise technology transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of marketing transformation programs, data-driven customer engagement, and intelligent content supply chain.
  • Proven executive relationship management skills.

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

jobs.description:
Remote | Full-time | English B2+ | Base + Commission

This is not a classic sourcing role.

As a Talent Sourcer at A-Players, you’re not “supporting recruiters” or sending generic outreach. You are a strategic researcher and signal-finder who operates in an AI-native way, using modern tools to research, map markets, and identify real A-Players who are rarely actively looking and hard to spot.

You’ll work closely with Talent Partners and clients, dive deep into each role and company context, and own sourcing strategy end-to-end.

What You’ll Own

🔹 Sourcing strategy

  • Deeply understand the client’s product, culture, and hiring goals

  • Build sourcing hypotheses: where A-Players are likely to be, and why

  • Identify non-obvious talent pools, companies, and career patterns

🔹 High-signal candidate identification

  • Use LinkedIn, Boolean search, GitHub, referrals, and creative sourcing methods

  • Apply the A-Players sourcing framework to assess signal vs noise

  • Prioritize quality over volume

🔹 Personalized outreach

  • Craft thoughtful, human, highly personalized messages

  • Tailor outreach based on a candidate’s background, motivations, and career trajectory

  • Continuously iterate messaging based on response quality, not just response rate

🔹 Collaboration with Talent Partners and clients

  • Work as a true partner to Talent Partners on each search

  • Share insights on candidate motivations, market signals, and role positioning

  • Join interviews or client calls when helpful (optional, but encouraged)

🔹 Process & craft improvement

  • Contribute to improving our sourcing playbooks, scripts, and tooling

  • Share learnings about market shifts, hiring bars, and emerging talent hubs

  • Bring ideas on how sourcing can create more leverage for the business

Who This Role Is For

You’ll feel at home here if you:

  • Have strong sourcing experience in tech (1+ years preferred)

  • Enjoy deep research and pattern recognition

  • Can spot A-Player signals beyond job titles and keywords

  • Write excellent, concise, human outreach in English

  • Are self-directed, curious, and allergic to micromanagement

  • Care about craft and long-term reputation, not shortcuts

  • Work in an AI-native way: you already use AI tools in your daily workflow (research, market mapping, candidate analysis, communication) or actively experiment with them to think faster, go deeper, and make better hiring decisions

Requirements

  • Strong written English (Upper-Intermediate or higher)

  • Experience with LinkedIn, Boolean search, and modern sourcing tools

  • Full-time availability (not a freelance or side role)

Markets & Searches

  • Clients:

    • ~60% US

    • ~35% Europe

    • ~5% Ukraine (impact-driven companies)

  • Search focus:

    • Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Leadership roles

    • Senior and hard-to-hire profiles

    • US and EU markets primarily

Recent closed/active searches include:

  • VP of Marketing (Growth & AI) (US)

  • AI Engineer (US & EU)

  • Founding Design Engineer (EU)

  • Product Designer(EU)

  • Director of Lead Generation (US)

  • VP of Marketing (Growth & AI) (US)

  • Customer Success Manager (CSM) (US)

  • VC Analyst (US & EU)

  • CX Director (UA)

  • Senior Full-Stack Engineer (US & EU)

  • Lead Backend Engineer (UA)

About A-Players

A-Players is a US-based recruiting company with aUkrainian core team. We work exclusively with impact-driven tech startups and VCs in the US and Europe — from early-stage, YC-backed teams to post-Series A companies scaling their leadership and core functions.

We don’t operate as a traditional agency.
We embed deeply into our clients’ teams, work on full exclusivity, join weekly syncs, help founders shape hiring strategy, and own searches end-to-end.

What Makes A-Players Different

  • Sourcing is treated as a strategic function, not a support task

  • High hiring bar — both for candidates and for ourselves

  • Real collaboration with Talent Partners and founders

  • Transparency around business numbers and decision-making

  • A culture built on Excellence and Empathy

Hiring Process

  1. Intro / pre-screen call

  2. Deep-dive interview

  3. Call with our Founder

  4. Call with our Co-Founder

  5. Final culture-fit conversation

Ready to Join?

If you’re excited by ownership, complexity, and building something meaningful — we’d love to meet you.

Apply or reach out, and let’s start with a conversation.

jobs.excerpt: We exist to create positive change for people and the planet.
jobs.description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!

Job Title: Professional Development Programme Manager, Regulatory Services

Reports to: Head of Professional Development

Location: UK or Europe – Home-based

We have an exciting opportunity for a Professional Development Programme Manager to join our Regulatory Services (RS) stream. You will lead portfolio and programme management for the Professional Development (PD) team. You will establish and operate the governance, cadence and decision‑making needed to prioritise PD initiatives effectively and deliver measurable benefits aligned to RS strategy. You will act as PD’s primary interface to the RS Business Improvement (BI) function, coach PD project leads to apply agreed standards, and directly manage delivery of a small number of high‑priority initiatives where required.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously improve PD’s portfolio governance framework (e.g., stage gates, change control, RAID, benefits tracking, decision logs), aligned where appropriate with BSI project management practices.

  • Maintain a single, transparent PD portfolio with clear scope baselines, priorities, dependencies and resource plans; drive trade‑off discussions and escalate unblockers.

  • Raise the standard of programme/project management across PD by setting expectations, curating templates and guidance, coaching project leads, and running peer reviews/health checks.

  • Directly manage delivery of selected high‑priority PD initiatives end‑to‑end where agreed, including delivery planning, RAID, stakeholder management, change control, reporting and benefits tracking, aligned to BI governance requirements where applicable.

  • Produce concise, executive‑ready portfolio reporting for PD/RS leadership (status, risks, mitigations, decisions required, benefits realisation) and maintain consistency of reporting standards across initiatives.

  • Map and proactively engage stakeholders across RS and adjacent teams; manage change impacts and communications for key portfolio milestones.

Travel requirements:

  • The position is home-based but may involve light travel to BSI and third-party locations (indicative ~10%)

To be successful in the role you will have:

  • Proven success leading programme and/or portfolio management in a complex, matrix environment, managing multiple concurrent initiatives, dependencies and trade‑offs.

  • Demonstrable experience establishing and operating governance rhythms (e.g., stage gates, RAID, benefits tracking) and improving PM practice through coaching, standards and quality assurance.

  • Formal project/programme management certification (e.g., PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, or IPMA-D).

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development. The salary for this position for the UK can range from £58,500- £78,000 annually; actual compensation is based on various factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s competencies, level of experience, education, location, divisional budget and internal peer compensation comparisons. If you are based in the EU, your recruiter can inform you of the local salary banding which differs per country based on various factors.

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team, apply now and become part of the BSI family!

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Responsabilità principali:

Ambito Backup & Operations:

  • Analisi e risoluzione dei backup falliti
  • Scheduling delle attività di backup secondo policy aziendali (Maestro, $Universe)
  • Esecuzione di procedure di restore e archiviazione
  • Gestione di processi di Electronic Remote Vaulting (ERV) e Fast Recovery
  • Monitoraggio proattivo delle infrastrutture di backup (server, tape/disk library, VTL, switch FC, appliance di deduplicazione)
  • Manutenzione, tuning delle performance e attività di change management
  • Supporto ad audit infrastrutturali e lavorazione di attività assegnate dal Service Manager

Ambito Delivery & Storage Management:

  • Configurazione e assegnazione di storage esterno (SAN centralizzata)
  • Installazione e configurazione di box storage, switch e appliance
  • Installazione di agent per il management SAN
  • Implementazione di repliche storage locali e geografiche (DC, MAN, WAN)
  • Creazione/estensione di LUN, incluse SAN di boot
  • Installazione client di backup e implementazione delle politiche (file system / DB)
  • Attivazione servizi di e-vaulting su indicazioni applicative

Requisiti tecnici richiesti:

  • Esperienza consolidata nella gestione backup in ambienti Open e Mainframe
  • Conoscenza dei principali strumenti:
    Networker, NetBackup (NBU), Commvault, Delphix, QSTAR, DataDomain, Tape Library
  • Utilizzo di strumenti di schedulazione e automazione: Maestro, $Universe
  • Familiarità con architetture SAN, switch FC e appliance di deduplicazione
  • Capacità di tuning, troubleshooting e ottimizzazione di infrastrutture di backup
  • Esperienza nella gestione di procedure di backup e restore in contesti ad alta criticità

Soft Skills:

  • Autonomia operativa e attenzione al dettaglio
  • Capacità di gestione delle priorità e problem-solving
  • Team working e collaborazione interfunzionale
  • Proattività nella prevenzione dei fault e nella documentazione delle attività

Offerta:

  • 100% lavoro da remoto
  • Inserimento in progetti tecnologicamente avanzati in ambito enterprise

Chi siamo:

Clariter, nata nel 2010, ha svelato le diverse sfaccettature dell'era digitale ben prima degli altri. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di guidare i Clienti nel tumultuoso ambiente competitivo odierno. Con la nostra suite unica di servizi, denominata QALYA®, promettiamo non solo soluzioni, ma anche risultati di business tangibili e misurabili. I nostri Centri di Eccellenza QALYA® danno concretezza al ciclo di vita completo di un prodotto digitale, dalla comprensione del cliente alla realizzazione di soluzioni tecnologiche innovative, passando per test rigorosi di qualità e sicurezza. L'intelligenza di un team transdisciplinare, l'energia di una community di crowdsourcing europea senza rivali e un ecosistema tecnologico all'avanguardia sono i nostri ingredienti segreti. Presenti in Italia, Regno Unito, Spagna e Portogallo, Clariter è il motore dell'innovazione continua. Attraverso l'engagement operativo e l'apporto formativo della Clariter Academy, puntiamo a forgiare la leadership dei nostri clienti nella trasformazione digitale e nella sicurezza informatica. Scegliere Clariter vuol dire abbracciare il futuro digitale, oggi stesso.

jobs.excerpt: Project OverviewThe Province requires upto three (3) Digital Architects to work with 3D on service innovation, program review and digital transformation projects across the GoA.
jobs.description:
Project Overview

The Province requires upto three (3) Digital Architects to work with 3D on service innovation, program review and digital transformation projects across the GoA. The Digital Architect will work as part of cross-functional program review or product delivery teams.

These teams, led by GoA product owners and 3D work collaboratively and collectively participate in a full range of activities including: field research, backlog definition and refinement, and sprint planning and execution. Digital transformation projects review the current state of services, identify future opportunities, and then deliver new services that are efficient, effective and affordable. A Digital Architect provides architectural expertise and strategic guidance and is responsible for overseeing the software architecture of digital services, the alignment of services to a common architecture vision, and the iterative delivery of solutions to create a complete digital service.

The Digital Architects will guide the team in the rapid, iterative delivery of user-centric services with solution designs that align to the overall architectural vision and are in support of technical standards, coding standards, common tools and platforms. The Digital Architect will also guide the product owner and team in balancing the allocation of team capacity between user stories and technical tasks. The Digital Architects may perform some development work if needed. Therefore, a Digital Architect must have a strong technical understanding of current and emerging technologies, balanced with strong business acumen and project leadership skills.

Scope of Services

It is anticipated that the Digital Architects will be required for three (3) months; however, the Province may extend the contract for up to twenty-four (24) months on the same terms and conditions. The Digital Architect may be required on a full time basis (7.25 hour work day), working across one (1) to two (2) projects. Time, location and frequency of work will vary depending on the needs of the particular project. At the end of each term, it is expected that the Digital Architects may work a maximum of 1,960 hours, unless otherwise agreed upon with the Province. However, a Digital Architect may be required to work fewer or more hours depending on the nature and needs of their work, as directed by the Province. Services and project deliverables should evolve as the work progresses, in response to emerging user and business needs, as well as design and technical opportunities.

However, the following must be delivered (iteratively) over the course of the project:
Lead the solution architecture of digital services by:
o Developing the overall architectural plan, ensuring a citizen-centered design and agile software approach; o Uncovering existing system context;
o Providing recommendations and prototypes for technical discovery and feasibility;
o Providing and being accountable for the solution designs that account for iterative implementation; and o Analyzing impacts, exposure, and risk as it pertains to the solution design.
Guide the team in the implementation of digital services by: o Facilitating frequent delivery of products to ensure that the target architecture is successfully created;
o Determining the tactical approach on each integration and the target state of system boundaries and interactions;
o Identifying opportunities to leverage common components and capabilities of other digital services; o Encouraging team contribution towards developing opportunities to leverage other digital services;
o Providing guidance on the creation of detailed designs for solution implementation; o Reviewing code changes;
o Contributing to code changes in order to implement user stories and to complete technical tasks; and o Providing coaching and mentorship to the product team.
Contribute to the architectural vision for a platform of user-centric services, particularly as it relates to the use of common components and capabilities to accelerate service delivery.
Contribute to the development of principles, metrics, and standards for service quality and delivery.
Provide software architecture information to technical and non-technical audiences by creating materials (documents, diagrams, presentations, etc.) appropriate to the audience.
Actively participate in the development and continuous improvement of the architecture practice. The Province and the Contractor shall determine changes to Services and Materials as required. The Province and the Contractor will determine changes to Services and Materials through the Artifacts.

  • changes in the activities of the cyber adversaries.

  • Establishes and maintains communications with counterparts in the Intelligence Community, the USCYBERCOM service components, other combatant commands, Cyber National Mission Force, Department of Homeland Security/NCSD, CERTS and Information Assurance Centers to collaborate on analysis and identify changes in the environment (This is done only at the direction of USCYBERCOM leadership and in accordance with the guidance of government sponsors within assigned division).

These shall include specific changes in tactics, techniques and procedures (TTP) and technical trends in cyber threats directed at the DoDIN and U.S. critical infrastructure/key resources (Cl/KR), as required. The Contractor shall also monitor threat activities to develop specific cyber indicators to support the USCYBERCOM role in the Defense Warning Program.

  • Promptly respond to J2 or other USCYBERCOM staff requests for information, as required.
  • Assist in the production, editing, publishing and dissemination of clear, concise, timely and relevant cyber analytic
  • products, as required.

  • Provide support to meetings related to assigned area of responsibility. This shall include meetings within the Command or held at other government or cleared defense contractor facilities. Travel may be required for long distance meetings, but virtual participation is preferred.

  • Demonstrates understanding of interpreting analysis to include, but not limited to, its meaning, importance, and implications.
  • Demonstrates ability to defend analytic judgements with sound, logical conclusions and adapt analytic judgments when presented with new information, evolving conditions, or unexpected developments.
  • Demonstrates ability to produce timely, logical, and concise analytic reports, documents, assessments, studies, and briefing materials in formats including Microsoft Office tools (e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.), electronic / soft copy matrices and / or web-enabled formats.
  • Demonstrates ability to communicate complex issues clearly in a concise and organized manner both verbally and non-verbally; with strong grammar skills.

Structured analytic techniques include, but not limited to, Analysis of Compet -Impact / Low-Impact Analysis, Red Team Analysis and Alternative Futures Analysis.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: TKO Group Holdings, Inc.  (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Senior Data Engineer, Data Platform is a hands-on engineering role at the center of TKO's data estate. Day to day, the role owns pipelines, data models, and Snowflake infrastructure, and resolves the issues that surface across TKO's data workflows. Over the next two years, the role also helps build the platform those workflows will move onto.

TKO today runs several data platforms side by side — separate Snowflake accounts, two clouds, three orchestrators, and four reporting tools — a product of bringing UFC, WWE, PBR, IMG, and On Location together under one company. The Platform Unification program consolidates that estate onto a single reference architecture: one Snowflake account, dbt for transformation, Prefect on Kubernetes for orchestration, Terraform for infrastructure, GitHub Actions with OIDC for delivery, and governance applied as code rather than by convention. This role is one of the engineers who builds it. The emphasis is deliberately on platform depth rather than depth in any one business unit. We are looking for an engineer who has operated a shared data platform used by many teams — someone who thinks in terms of reusable frameworks, access models, warehouse cost, blast radius, and the paved path that keeps other teams from inventing their own — and who can take a standard built in one corner of the estate and make it hold across UFC, WWE, PBR, IMG, and On Location. Business-unit domain knowledge will be built on the job. The platform engineering judgment needs to arrive with the person.

The role sits within TKO's Enterprise Data organization, reports to the Manager, Data Engineering, and works closely with DevOps, Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Cybersecurity, IT, and the global delivery partners supporting the brand.


Roles and Responsibilities

Platform Ownership and Reliability

  • Own pipelines, data models, and platform reliability end to end, covering all ingress and egress paths into and out of Snowflake.
  • Act as an escalation point for platform incidents — triage orchestration, transformation, and monitoring alerts, run root cause analysis, and close issues out with permanent fixes rather than recurring manual intervention.
  • Define and hold service levels for the pipelines the business depends on: freshness, job success rate, and time to recover. Report honestly against them.
  • Provide debug, triage, support, and design guidance to engineers and analysts working anywhere in the platform.
  • Share in the team's on-call and event-support rotation, including heightened coverage around major live events.

Platform Unification and the North Star Architecture

  • Design and build the shared components of TKO's unified platform: the canonical medallion layering, the role and access taxonomy, the shared ingestion library, and the orchestration framework every business unit will run on.
  • Lead Snowflake consolidation work as the separate accounts converge — cross-region replication, account merges, re-pointing secure shares, parity validation, and cutover.
  • Retire duplicated tooling across the estate rather than relocating it: self-managed Airflow, notebook-driven ingestion, SSIS, and legacy CI/CD.
  • Build golden paths — templates, reference implementations, and documentation — so business unit teams and delivery partners can onboard a source or ship a model without a ticket to this team for every change.

Ingestion and Orchestration

  • Extend and maintain a shared Python ingestion library: reusable connectors for SFTP, database, API and file sources; S3 landing with Snowflake COPY and Snowpipe sinks; watermarking and incremental logic; registry and observability hooks.
  • Run managed ingestion (Fivetran) as the default for supported SaaS sources, and make the build-versus-buy call where no connector exists.
  • Own Prefect on EKS — deployments, work pools, worker health, containerized flows — and the standard flow taxonomy the whole organization writes against.
  • Consolidate connector logic that exists today into a shared collect/ingest library, instead of maintaining three versions of the same capability.

Snowflake Engineering and Cost

  • Administer Snowflake as a shared, multi-tenant platform: warehouse sizing and workload isolation, resource monitors, query and clustering optimization, replication, and secure sharing with external partners.
  • Manage Snowflake objects declaratively in Terraform so that structure and access are reviewable, reproducible, and auditable rather than accumulated through ad hoc SQL.
  • Own warehouse cost. Find the queries, models, and schedules driving consumption, fix them, and give leadership a defensible view of where credits are going.

Infrastructure as Code and Delivery

  • Build and maintain AWS infrastructure with Terraform across the TKO accounts — EKS, networking, IAM, S3, Lambda, and secrets management — operating at the workload layer inside central IT's guardrails rather than standing up a parallel estate.
  • Maintain CI/CD on GitHub Actions with AWS OIDC and no static credentials, including the dev, UAT, and production promotion path, required-reviewer gates, and the dbt tests and data quality checks that block a bad change before it lands.
  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, testing standards, and documentation that holds up after the author moves on.

Transformation and Data Modeling

  • Build and review dbt models against the canonical medallion, and merge the organization's separate macro libraries into one shared set — identity resolution and feature engineering from the consumer side, policy generation from the brand side.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering and Data Science so semantic models, feature pipelines, and reporting sit on governed, versioned datasets rather than one-off extracts.

Governance and Security, Applied as Code

  • Implement masking, tokenization, and row-access policies as code across the estate — encrypted at landing, decrypted at the marts — so PII is handled the same way everywhere it lands.
  • Maintain network policies, secrets and key rotation, and SSO-driven role provisioning; support access reviews, audit requests, and remediation of security findings.
  • Support cataloging and lineage tooling, and build to the standards set by TKO's Master Data Management and Governance function.

Enabling Analytics, ML, and AI

  • Keep the platform ready for the workloads built on top of it: in-platform model training and serving, feature pipelines, and the curated, retrieval-ready datasets that AI applications depend on.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tooling in daily development and help establish sensible team practice around it.

Collaboration and Technical Influence

  • Work directly with the global delivery partners — mentoring them onto the target stack through their migration waves and reviewing their work against platform standards.
  • Mentor engineers on the team and serve as a technical reference point on design decisions, without formal management responsibility.
  • Explain technical trade-offs plainly to stakeholders who are not engineers, and to leadership.

Required Experience

  • 7+ years building and operating production data platforms, including at least 3 years weighted toward shared platform and infrastructure work rather than single-team pipeline delivery.
  • Deep hands-on Snowflake experience at an administrator level: RBAC design, warehouse sizing and cost management, masking and row-access policies, replication, secure data sharing, and performance tuning.
  • Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to write and maintain a shared library other engineers build against — not only scripts and DAGs.
  • Production experience with a modern orchestrator (Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster), including running and upgrading it on Kubernetes or comparable infrastructure rather than only consuming a managed service.
  • Hands-on infrastructure as code with Terraform on AWS: EKS or ECS, IAM, VPC networking, S3, Lambda, and secrets management.
  • dbt at scale — project structure, macros, testing, and the judgment to consolidate overlapping projects rather than accumulate them.
  • Ownership of CI/CD for data systems, GitHub Actions preferred, including keyless OIDC authentication, multi-environment promotion, and automated quality gates.
  • Experience with managed ingestion (Fivetran or comparable), CDC, Snowpipe, and event or behavioral data platforms such as Amplitude or Segment.
  • Operational discipline: observability tooling such as Datadog, alerting design, incident response, and post-incident follow-through.
  • Demonstrated work on a platform migration or consolidation of real scope — merging warehouse accounts, replacing an orchestrator, or retiring a legacy stack — including the parity validation and cutover planning that determines whether one succeeds.
  • A record of setting standards other engineers actually adopt: reusable frameworks, reference implementations, documentation, and code review.
  • Comfortable working alongside offshore and partner delivery teams and raising their output to the platform's standards.
  • Clear written communication, particularly design documents, runbooks, and incident write-ups.
  • Practical experience meeting data governance requirements — PII classification, access controls, retention, and lineage — preferred.
  • Exposure to ML or AI workloads running on the data platform, such as in-warehouse training and serving, feature stores, or retrieval pipelines, preferred.
  • Experience in media, sports, entertainment, live events, ticketing, or consumer and fan data environments preferred.

Buscamos Analista MDR (Managed Detection and Response) para fortalecer las capacidades de monitoreo, detección y respuesta ante amenazas en entornos empresariales.   • Experiencia en consolas de seguridad y plataformas SIEM/XDR
  • Capacidad de análisis crítico y contextualización de eventos
  • Conocimientos básicos de automatización con Python o PowerShell
  • Habilidad para documentar de forma clara y estructurada
  • Trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva

Certificaciones deseables

  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder

jobs.title: 12645599 - Analista de Performance Sênior
jobs.excerpt: A MTP – Métodos e Tecnologia é uma multinacional espanhola com 28 anos de atuação, presente em mais de 21 países, com sedes no Brasil, Espanha e México.
jobs.description:
A MTP – Métodos e Tecnologia é uma multinacional espanhola com 28 anos de atuação, presente em mais de 21 países, com sedes no Brasil, Espanha e México.

Somos especialistas em Digital Business Assurance, unindo estratégia, tecnologia e inovação para apoiar grandes empresas em sua jornada de transformação digital.

Com mais de 80 clientes ativos nos setores de Finanças, Seguros, Telecom, Indústria, Varejo, Tecnologia e Energia, entregamos soluções que garantem qualidade, segurança e performance em todo o ciclo digital.

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Performance Sênior para atuar com engenharia de performance, testes de carga e monitoramento em projeto com alocação em cliente na Espanha.

A posição será responsável por todo o ciclo de engenharia de performance das aplicações do cliente: definição da estratégia de testes, modelagem de carga com base no comportamento real de produção, execução controlada e reproduzível dos testes e análise dos resultados até a identificação da causa raiz de eventuais problemas de desempenho.

A atuação vai além da execução de scripts e geração de relatórios. Esperamos uma pessoa capaz de acompanhar ativamente o ambiente durante os testes por meio de ferramentas de APM, métricas de infraestrutura, logs e traces, correlacionando sintomas com suas possíveis origens e construindo diagnósticos fundamentados em evidências.

O profissional terá interação direta com times de Desenvolvimento, Banco de Dados, Infraestrutura, Arquitetura e SRE, atuando como referência técnica da MTP junto ao cliente.

Apache JMeter e experiência prática com monitoramento/APM são conhecimentos essenciais para a posição.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Modelar cargas de teste com base em dados reais de utilização, considerando perfis de usuários, volumetria, picos e períodos críticos para o negócio.
  • Definir estratégias de testes de performance, incluindo carga, estresse, resistência, pico, escalabilidade e degradação controlada.
  • Estabelecer critérios de aceitação de performance em conjunto com as áreas envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir scripts em Apache JMeter, utilizando parametrização, correlação dinâmica, controladores, asserções e massas de dados adequadas.
  • Preparar e validar ambientes de testes, avaliando sua representatividade em relação ao ambiente produtivo.
  • Executar testes de forma controlada e reproduzível, incluindo cenários de execução distribuída.
  • Acompanhar ativamente o ambiente durante os testes utilizando APM, métricas de infraestrutura, logs e traces.
  • Analisar tempos de resposta, throughput, erros, CPU, memória, garbage collection, pools de conexão, filas, cache, banco de dados e demais componentes relacionados à performance.
  • Identificar gargalos e realizar análise de causa raiz com base em evidências técnicas.
  • Recomendar ações corretivas e validar os ganhos de performance após as intervenções realizadas pelos times responsáveis.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos, apresentando os testes realizados, capacidade do sistema, gargalos identificados, riscos e recomendações.
  • Estabelecer baselines e acompanhar a evolução da performance entre releases, identificando possíveis regressões.
  • Automatizar a execução dos testes e apoiar sua integração aos pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Manter e evoluir a suíte de performance conforme as aplicações e arquiteturas forem modificadas.
  • Apoiar a investigação de incidentes de performance em produção quando necessário.
  • Interagir tecnicamente com equipes de Desenvolvimento, Banco de Dados, Infraestrutura, Arquitetura e SRE.
  • Experiência consistente como Analista ou Engenheiro(a) de Performance, atuando de forma recorrente em projetos reais de testes e engenharia de performance.
  • Domínio prático de Apache JMeter, incluindo desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de suítes de testes.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de monitoramento e APM, utilizando-as ativamente durante a execução e análise de testes.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, Datadog, Grafana/Prometheus ou Elastic, ou soluções equivalentes.
  • Experiência com modelagem de carga e definição de critérios de aceitação de performance.
  • Capacidade de analisar resultados e identificar gargalos e causas raiz com base em evidências.
  • Conhecimento de métricas e indicadores de performance, incluindo tempos de resposta, throughput, erros e percentis.
  • Conhecimento de comportamento de aplicações e infraestrutura, incluindo CPU, memória, garbage collection, threads, pools de conexão, cache, I/O e rede.
  • Conhecimento de protocolos e integrações como HTTP/HTTPS, REST, SOAP, WebSocket, gRPC e/ou mensageria.
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços.
  • Conhecimentos de banco de dados suficientes para analisar planos de execução, índices, bloqueios, contenção e impacto de consultas na performance das aplicações.
  • Conhecimento de scripting utilizando Java, Groovy, Python ou JavaScript para extensão de scripts, geração de massas de dados ou automação.
  • Experiência em ambientes distribuídos e interação direta com equipes de Desenvolvimento e Infraestrutura.
  • Inglês avançado, incluindo leitura, escrita e conversação técnica.
  • Espanhol em nível operacional, suficiente para interação cotidiana com o cliente.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com automação de testes funcionais utilizando Selenium/WebDriver, ferramenta atualmente utilizada pelo cliente.
  • Experiência com Playwright, Cypress ou RestAssured.
  • Experiência na construção ou manutenção de frameworks de automação de testes.
  • Experiência com Performance as Code, mantendo suítes versionadas, parametrizadas e executadas automaticamente.
  • Integração de testes de performance em pipelines de CI/CD, utilizando ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou Azure DevOps.
  • Experiência com quality gates de performance e práticas de shift-left.
  • Conhecimento de outras ferramentas de carga, como k6, Gatling, LoadRunner, NeoLoad ou BlazeMeter.
  • Experiência com ambientes AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento de Kubernetes, incluindo impacto de limites de recursos, configurações e autoescalabilidade na performance.
  • Conhecimentos de SRE, incluindo SLI, SLO, error budget e engenharia de confiabilidade.
  • Certificações ISTQB, incluindo Performance Testing, ou certificações relacionadas a plataformas de APM.
  • Experiência anterior em consultoria ou prestação de serviços para diferentes clientes.
  • Experiência em setores regulados, como bancos, seguros, saúde ou utilities.
  • Conhecimentos de Chaos Engineering e testes de resiliência.

Overview

As a Connectivity Delivery Engineer, Cloud Interconnection +Wireless (CI+W) you will contribute to building a world-class network infrastructure by working with Telecommunication, Network Operators, Satellite and Data Centers across the globe in sourcing Metro Fiber, Long-Haul Fiber, Internet Exchanges, ISP uplinks, subsea, satellite, 5G, and Lit Wave circuits. Additionally, you'll be acquiring IP blocks both IPv6 and Ipv4, challenging cross connectivity and a variety of network appliances and equipment including ISP routers, NTU, and CPE devices.

Mibura's Edge Cloud Operations & Innovation (ECO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services paving the way for a lower latency in an AI accelerated computing era. As a Connectivity Delivery Engineer, Cloud Interconnection + Wireless, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Mibura's online services including Global Silicon Services, Micro Services, Edge Gaming, Storage, and the edge network platform. As a group, Mibura's Cloud Operations & Innovation (ECO+I) is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 75+ countries and hundreds of thousands of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 50+ key customers and 200+businesses including government agencies and some of the largest technology companies.

Our focus is a network focused cloud infrastructure company, operating in 75+ countries across the globe and providing customization and flexibility to all the key clouds and TelCo networks. Businesses need to simplify and bring together fragmented, complex infrastructure that spans cloud environments. With Mibura NetMetal, customers can rapidly deploy their preferred silicon with dedicated network infrastructure and interact with every available TelCo at datacenters, ground stations, and wireless cellular. Our global platform allows customers to place infrastructure wherever they need it and connect it to everything they need to succeed - fully customizable (i.e. tailor made content delivery networks or global telemetry platforms)

Our mission is to cut the cord, drop the cubicle, bring down walls, break through barriers, and build bridges empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Qualifications

‍

‍Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 4+ years’ experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    OR equivalent experience.

  • 2+ years’ experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years' experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development some

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 6+ years experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

  • 1+ year(s) experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos)

Responsibilities

  • Drive alignment to the goals and strategy of Mibura with external customers, vendors, and suppliers and maintain good working relationships and strong communication channels.

  • Perform market research, conduct analyses, and examine customer and technology-related industry trends, as well as industry-specific requirements or regulations to solve complex Network Capacity Delivery matters, identify areas of opportunity, and lead process improvements.

  • Engage with network operators and data centers worldwide to procure metro fiber, long-haul fiber, DIA & IP transit services, IP addresses, cross connects, IX connections, ISP uplinks, subsea cables, satellite links, 5G infrastructure, and lit wave circuits.

  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to propose and design architecture and integrated customer solutions for product and service support.

  • Develop robust, scalable, and diversified operating procedures and strategies for Fiber Sourcing and Delivery segments.

  • Manage frontline technical projects with external suppliers by pulling and tracking construction schedules, including civils, permitting, cable overpulls, overlaying with end-to-end schedule and producing reports.

  • Manage governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Manage and lead sourcing initiatives for critical network infrastructure that enable the world’s largest online services.

  • To provide leadership and direction to team of sourcing engineers on a large portfolio of Network and colocation projects.

  • Lead and manage Cloud project initiatives for platform enablement and delivering capabilities that exceed customer expectations to enable rapid pace delivery.

  • Manage and support our colocation sourcing efforts within to ensure resiliency, diversity and quality uptime of our network services portfolio.

  • Responsible for Data analytics for the team to parse data, build meaningful metrics and reports enabling workflow analysis driving for workflow efficiency gains.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to identify and define strategic initiatives to meet expansion and cost reduction needs.

  • Build strategic relationships with vendors and industry experts Communicate progress internally and collaborate with network deployment teams.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to identify and define strategic initiatives and leverage technology to drive up speed to implementation.

  • Communicate progress internally and collaborate with internal customers.

  • Partner and ensure contracting compliance with service suppliers, legal and finance teams for continuous and consistent rigor with regard to ensuring appropriate terms and conditions based on service type.
