jobs.title: Customer Launch Manager
jobs.excerpt: Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that.
jobs.description:
Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that. We're building an app that improves employees' finances automatically every pay day - giving them financial tools that directly improve their financial health with less effort.

Every pay day is an opportunity to build better money habits. We make it easy. Employees can accelerate retirement savings with tax-efficient pension top-ups, build a safety net effortlessly with auto savings, or access their already-earned salary ahead of pay day for emergencies.

For employers, fewer employees with money worries means more focus on work. We're trusted by major organisations including the NHS, and we're growing fast.

Role Overview

As a Customer Launch Manager in our Launch team, you lead customer onboarding from contract signature to go-live. You take over from Sales and get each new customer live in under 30 days, with as many employees signed up as possible from day one.

You own the journey from signature to launch: set-up, payroll and data readiness, employer communications and the pre-launch sign-up drive. Speed and take-up are what matter. A fast launch means our customers see value sooner, and every employee signed up at launch is revenue from day one.

Once the customer is live, you hand over to the Account Manager, so they pick up a live, well-understood account that is ready to grow.

The role is hybrid, with 1-2 days in the London office per week.

Key Responsibilities

Handover from Sales

  • Take a structured handover from Sales at contract signature, confirming scope, products, key contacts and launch date

  • Support Sales on late-stage deals where needed, so what is sold can be launched quickly

  • Run a kick-off with the employer within the first week and agree a launch plan with clear owners and dates

Launch in Under 30 Days

  • Own each launch end to end, from kick-off to go-live, for a portfolio of new customers

  • Build out a mutually agreed launch plan with the customer

  • Get payroll, data and integrations ready, working through requirements, testing and sign-off with the employer

  • Spot risks, dependencies and blockers early and remove them before they slip the date

  • Keep launches consistent and repeatable, using standard playbooks and adapting only where the customer needs it

Sign-ups Ready for Launch

  • Own a pre-launch sign-up target for every launch

  • Plan employee communications with the employer and Marketing: announcements, webinars, pay-slip messages and on-site sessions

  • Equip HR, Payroll and line managers to promote the service

  • Track sign-ups against target in the run-up to launch and act quickly where take-up is low

Handover to Account Management

  • Hand each live customer to the Account Manager with a clear record of scope, stakeholders, sign-ups and next opportunities

  • Run launches of new products for existing customers when the Account Manager closes an expansion

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Sales: feedback on what speeds up or slows down launch, so deals are shaped to launch well

  • Marketing: launch campaigns and sign-up materials

  • Product and Engineering: raise blockers early and feedback on set-up friction

  • Improve the launch playbook, documentation and ways of working over time

How Success Is Measured

Speed and take-up come first; quality of handover protects both.

Measure

What it shows

Time to launch

Days from contract signature to go-live, against a 30-day target

Sign-ups at launch

Employees signed up by go-live, against target

Launch take-up rate

Share of eligible employees signed up by go-live

Launches on time

Share of launches delivered on the agreed date

Handover quality

Account Manager and customer feedback on the handover

Skills & Competencies

Core Skills

  • Strong delivery and coordination: runs several launches in parallel and hits dates (formal project management background not required)

  • Pace and urgency: removes blockers rather than waiting for them to clear

  • Confident with payroll, data and integration requirements, and able to lead those conversations with customers

  • Campaign mindset: knows how to drive employee take-up through clear, well-timed communications

  • Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, from payroll teams to HR directors

  • Takes ownership of outcomes, not just activity, with minimal day-to-day direction

Experience & Background

  • Proven track record delivering customer onboarding, implementation or launches in a SaaS or platform business

  • Experience driving user or employee adoption, ideally in employee benefits, payroll, HR or financial wellbeing

  • Experience managing several customer projects at once against tight timelines

  • Experience with payroll data, integrations or HR systems is advantageous

  • Experience with public sector or other complex organisations is advantageous but not essential

What the Role Is Not

  • A reactive technical support role

  • A back-office set-up role: launch success is measured by sign-ups, not just go-live

  • A long-term account role: once a customer is live, the Account Manager takes over

  • A role requiring task-level direction

This role suits someone who loves pace and ownership and wants to see every launch go live quickly with employees signed up and ready to benefit.

Our Recruitment Process

Stage 1 | People & Culture Call – An initial conversation about your experience, motivations and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 | Hiring Manager Interview – A 60-minute interview with the Hiring Manager to explore your experience in more detail, your approach to the role and give you the opportunity to learn more about the team and what we’re building.

Stage 3 | Practical Exercise – A final-stage practical exercise designed to give you the opportunity to demonstrate how you would approach some of the key areas of the role. You’ll be provided with a briefing and any relevant context in advance so you have time to prepare.

Benefits

🇬🇧 Remote working within the UK
Work remotely from anywhere in the UK, giving you flexibility to work where you perform at your best.

🖥️ Home office budget
Receive a £200 annual budget to help you set up and improve your home working space.

🌴 Annual leave
25 days’ annual leave, increasing with tenure, plus the option to purchase up to 5 additional days each year.

🎂 Birthday off
Take your birthday off, because everyone deserves time to celebrate properly.

🤝 Collaborative team bonus
For non-commission roles, you’ll be part of our collaborative team bonus scheme, recognising shared success across the business.

💰 Pension scheme

Access to our pension scheme.

✨ Perkbox salary sacrifice schemes
Access salary sacrifice schemes through Perkbox, including car leasing, gym memberships and tech purchases.

🩺 Medical cashback scheme

Helping with everyday healthcare costs.

👶 Enhanced parental leave

Support during important life moments.

About Dropzone AI

Dropzone’s mission is to scale cybersecurity beyond human limits, and augment every single human security engineer/analyst with an army of AI security specialists. Humans alone cannot sufficiently protect our digital future, and AI augmentation is the only way for defenders to reclaim the high ground. We are an award winning company disrupting the $200B+ cybersecurity market.

Powered by Gen AI advancements, our technology offloads repetitive day-to-day work and frees human analysts to focus on real threats and higher-value projects. We are venture-backed, and our team has a rare blend of deep experience across cybersecurity, AI/ML, and SaaS product development. Join us if you want to be on the ground floor of using Gen AI to transform cyber defense. Learn more at.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Writer to own how Dropzone explains itself to the people who run it.

Dropzone's customers are security teams connecting dozens of signal sources, configuring investigation and hunting strategies, administering multi-tenant deployments, and deciding which response actions the AI SOC Team is authorized to take. Every one of those steps needs documentation a SOC analyst or platform admin can follow without opening a ticket. Your job is to move it into product documentation that customers trust and use.

You'll own the documentation system end to end: integration guides, admin and configuration docs, API reference, release notes, and the reference material that explains how Dropzone reasons, what evidence it presents, and where its limits are. You'll work directly with product, engineering, customer success, and sales engineering, and you'll report to the Head of Product.

This is not a role where you receive finished specs and format them. You'll sit with the trios as features are being built, pull the details out of engineers before they forget them, and be accountable for whether a customer can succeed on their own.

What you'll do

  • Own the customer documentation platform: information architecture, authoring workflow, review process, publishing, and search. Make it easy to find, easy to maintain, and accurate on the day a release ships.
  • Write and maintain integration guides for every supported data source and alert source, in a repeatable template that a new integration can fill in a day.
  • Write admin and governance documentation for enterprise and MSSP customers: tenant management, access control, API keys, audit trail, and response action authorization.
  • Own the API reference and developer-facing docs, working with engineering to keep them generated from source where possible and hand-written where it matters.
  • Write release notes that tell customers what changed, why, who benefits, and what the known limitations are. Every customer-visible release ships with documentation, not after it.
  • Write the explanatory material that helps customers understand and govern AI-completed work: how investigations are structured, how evidence and uncertainty are presented, what the system does and does not do.
  • Partner with customer success and support to find where documentation gaps generate tickets, and close them.
  • Establish a style guide and docs-as-code workflow that engineers and PMs can contribute to without you as a bottleneck.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of technical writing experience for software products with a technical buyer, with at least 2 years documenting APIs, integrations, or infrastructure-adjacent products.
  • Docs-as-code fluency: Git, Markdown, and at least one static documentation framework such as Docusaurus, MkDocs, Mintlify, or equivalent.
  • Ability to read code and API specifications well enough to document them accurately and to notice when the implementation disagrees with the spec.
  • A portfolio that shows you can explain a complex system to a practitioner under time pressure, with structure and precision rather than volume.
  • Comfort interviewing engineers and product managers to extract what actually happened, and the persistence to keep asking until the answer is complete.
  • Strong editorial judgment: you know what to leave out, and you can defend it.
  • Experience owning a documentation set end to end, including information architecture and maintenance, not just individual articles.
  • A preference for focused ownership over distributed coordination. You do your best work deeply embedded in a product with a small, accountable team.
  • Early-stage startup mindset. You thrive on ambiguity and move with lightspeed execution
  • Being data-driven is part of your DNA.

Preferred

  • Cybersecurity or security operations domain experience. Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, identity, and cloud security data sources is a strong plus.
  • Experience documenting AI or ML products, especially explaining model behavior, evidence, and limitations to non-specialist users.
  • Experience at Series A–C stage companies where you were the first or only documentation hire.
  • Experience with documentation analytics and using support ticket data to prioritize what to write.
  • Familiarity with structured authoring or content reuse systems.

Work Environment/Travel

We are a 100% remote company where you will work from your home with company-provided equipment to set you up for success. Semi-frequent travel to professional office settings and other events locally and nationally; some overnight travel expected.

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range below, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at Dropzone your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. In addition, all compensation packages include significant above market new hire equity grants because we believe in rewarding long term value creation. If you are hired at Dropzone your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical to allow for future and continued salary growth. We also offer a generous benefits package, including company paid health insurance, 401K Plan with employer match, Self-Managed PTO, parental leave, and more.

Impact of a Billing Systems Architect

As an Enterprise Billing Systems Architect at Upsun, you are the technical anchor of our billing infrastructure, playing a vital role in ensuring our revenue operations, pricing structures, and financial integrations run seamlessly as our business scales. Picking up primary ownership from our implementation partner, you serve as the dedicated technical lead bridging Finance, Product, and Engineering.

Working downstream from our core engineering and data mediation teams, you ensure the integrity of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) platform while continuously optimizing platform performance and automation.

Beyond day-to-day platform administration, you contribute to the long-term evolution of our billing architecture—supporting new pricing model launches, complex usage rating schemes, and financial system integrations. Your attention to detail, technical versatility, and cross-functional mindset ensure our revenue pipeline remains scalable, compliant, and friction-free.

What to expect

What you bring

  • Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to bridge technical language and financial business logic, effectively collaborating with engineering teams and accounting stakeholders alike.

  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: A methodical approach to diagnosing system sync errors, rating anomalies, and integration edge cases to ensure operational continuity.

Bonus points

Where we hire

Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

OUR COMMUNITY

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy is looking for a major gifts professional to join our Philanthropy team in an interim capacity from October through February. This role provides behind-the-scenes portfolio management and solicitation support for major individual giving, serves as a core writer for individual giving proposals and reports, and leads a focused research project to identify new major-gift and mid-level prospects from AI-sector liquidity events. You will be key in supporting the "wealth-wave" plan to expand the individual pipeline and ensuring philanthropic leadership is well prepared for donor engagements through end of year.

This role reports directly to the Director of Philanthropy for overall direction, prioritization, and approvals, and works closely with the Chief of External Relations on individual major donor outreach and end-of-year solicitations. Weekly hours are managed against a blended cap of 40 hours/week, with emphasis shifting across work streams as deadlines and priorities evolve.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio & Donor Strategy (~10 hrs/wk, through EOY): Provide behind-the-scenes portfolio management for major individual giving, driving strategy to move relationships forward and secure gifts, including recommending and confirming appropriate next steps.
    • Leadership Preparation: Prepare C-suite executives and other philanthropic leadership for individual major donor meetings with briefings, pre-read decks, suggested strategies, and follow-up on next steps.
    • End-of-Year Outreach Management: Track and manage Chief of External Relation end-of-year donor outreach, including who has been contacted, follow-up status, and next steps.
    • Outreach Coordination: Coordinate donor outreach email by triaging messages, drafting responses for her review, and flagging donor replies that need attention.
    • CRM Management: Maintain accurate donor activities and updates in Salesforce (SFDC).
  • Philanthropic Writing & Reporting (~10–15 hrs/wk, ongoing): Adapt compelling concept notes, proposals, and donor reports for individual giving opportunities, drawing on existing materials, templates, and stated program priorities. Convey key strategic priorities and narrative consistent with Khan Academy’s voice, mission framing, and prior donor communications, and incorporate feedback from the Philanthropy team and leadership.
    • Impact Metrics: Coordinate with key team members to pull, analyze, and present key performance metrics as part of preparing donor reports.
    • Review & Approvals: Submit donor reports, proposals, and related materials to Director of Philanthropy for initial review ahead of final approval by Chief of External Relations.
  • Prospect Research & Pipeline Expansion (~5–10 hrs/wk, until complete): Use prospecting tools and public information to research and identify likely major-gift and mid-level prospects, including from IPOs and liquidity events at OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI companies (Google, Meta, etc.).
    • Prospect List Development: Work with internal teams to cross-reference generated lists against Khan Academy’s existing donor, prospect, and email records to flag existing connections, and deliver a prioritized prospect list with supporting rationale that feeds directly into the wealth-wave strategy.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 7+ years demonstrated years in philanthropy, major gifts fundraising and individual giving responsibility.
  • Strategic Thinker & Execution Focus: Proven ability to manage behind-the-scenes fundraising operations, moves management systems, and donor pipeline development strategies.
  • Exceptional Writing Skills: Exceptional written communication skills with experience crafting compelling donor communications, briefings, and philanthropic proposals and reports.
  • Leadership Enablement: Demonstrated experience preparing, briefing, and supporting executive leaders and board members for high-level donor engagements.
  • Prospect Research: Experience using prospecting and wealth screening tools and public information to identify and prioritize major-gift prospects.
  • Relationship & Cross-Functional Ability: Strong interpersonal skills to work seamlessly across functions and leadership dynamics.
  • Fundraising Expertise: Demonstrated success raising six figure+ gifts and solid understanding of major gifts, donor pipelines, wealth screening/wealth-wave strategies, and moves management processes.
  • Rapid Ramp-Up: Proven ability to quickly absorb an organization's strategy, priorities, and narrative, and to deliver meaningful results from the first weeks of an engagement.
  • Organization & Flexibility: Ability to manage multiple concurrent work streams against a blended hour cap and shift emphasis as deadlines and priorities change.
  • Mission Alignment: Deep passion for Khan Academy’s mission "to provide a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere".
  • Cross-Cultural Competency: Proven ability to adopt inclusive perspectives and demonstrate self-awareness to support inclusion and belonging across the organization.

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

As an Identity Infrastructure Operations Engineer at CrowdStrike, you will play a vital role in maintaining and enhancing our identity infrastructure stack, particularly within the Government Cloud ("GovCloud") systems (Fedramp Moderate & Fedramp High DOD IL 4 & 5). Your primary focus will be on ensuring operational excellence, security, and scalability while supporting internal applications and user access within the US-Gov-1 and US-Gov-2 environments.

Join us at CrowdStrike as we revolutionize access governance within the Federal Cloud Infrastructure. If you're passionate about identity and access management, automation, and security, we encourage you to apply and join our dynamic team!

What You'll Do:

  • Manage operational tasks related to identity provider operations, application lifecycle management, and documentation.

  • Work closely with Engineering and IT teams to integrate solutions, address identity-related issues, and ensure compliance with FedRAMP/DoD requirements.

  • Implement and maintain security measures, conduct security impact analysis, and ensure adherence to government security controls.

  • Identify and automate repetitive tasks, develop automation workflows, and contribute to the development of monitoring and alerting tools.

  • Provide tier 2 and tier 3 support for architecting/designing solutions, troubleshooting complex issues, and conducting root cause analysis.

  • Regularly update stakeholders on the status of support requests and coordinate support activities with IT personnel.

  • Contribute actively to the IT Federal Engineering team, including participation in the on-call rotation for federal cloud support.

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8-11 years of relevant work experience or Master’s degree with 6-7 years of relevant work experience, preferably in identity and access management.

  • Proficiency in Directory Services, Group Policy Management, DNS, and other related technologies.

  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate cross-functionally.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and drive resolution.

  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Scripting Skills: Proficiency in Python and PowerShell for automation tasks.

  • Cloud Experience: Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, and GCP, preferably within government cloud environments.

  • Identity Provider Experience: Knowledge of Keycloak, PingIdentity/NokNok, and other identity providers.

  • Authentication Protocols: Familiarity with SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, and MFA integration.

  • Experience with monitoring/alerting tools, SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk), and security best practices.

  • Technical Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Plus to have Certifications: CJIS background investigation clearance and relevant training as required by company policy.

  • Technical Expertise: Can apply technical knowledge and skills effectively in complex situations and can guide others in the application of technical knowledge and skills.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs.excerpt: About the role: We are building a greenfield, document-driven lending platform that automates the full lifecycle of a loan application — from document intake and OCR-based extraction, through human-in-the-loop review, to final approval and downstream submission.
jobs.description:
About the role:
We are building a greenfield, document-driven lending platform that automates the full lifecycle of a loan application — from document intake and OCR-based extraction, through human-in-the-loop review, to final approval and downstream submission. The system is a modular monolith with a clear separation between backend services and multiple trust-boundaried web front ends, deployed natively on Azure.
We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer who is equally comfortable designing clean, testable back-end architecture in C#/.NET and building modern, production-grade UI in React/Next.js. You'll work across the stack: domain modeling, API design, background/async processing, and customer- and operations-facing web applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build business logic and domain modules in an ASP.NET Core API following Clean Architecture principles (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API layers).
  • Build and maintain asynchronous background processing services (a .NET worker) for document-heavy workflows, coordinated through message queues.
  • Develop and maintain multiple Next.js/React applications serving different user populations (internal operations/back-office tooling and external/customer-facing portals), sharing a common package layer.
  • Design relational data models and write efficient data access code (EF Core / PostgreSQL).
  • Integrate with cloud-native infrastructure: message queues, blob storage, secrets management, and managed identity providers.
  • Implement authentication and authorization across multiple identity boundaries (workforce vs. external/customer identity).
  • Collaborate on API contracts and shared TypeScript types consumed by front-end applications.
  • Participate in architectural decisions that keep a growing monolith modular, maintainable, and well-tested (unit, integration, contract, and architecture tests).
  • Work within a human-in-the-loop product model: build tooling that lets operators review, correct, and approve AI-assisted extraction results, with full traceability of how each data point changed from raw intake to final approval.
  • Write and maintain automated tests across the stack and participate in CI/CD pipeline health.
  • Participate in code review, technical design discussions, and mentor less experienced engineers.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core).
  • 4+ years building production front-end applications with React, including Next.js (App Router, server components/actions, route handlers).
  • Strong understanding of Clean/Layered Architecture, domain modeling, and separation of concerns in non-trivial back-end systems.
  • Experience with relational databases and ORMs (EF Core or equivalent), including migrations and query performance.
  • Solid TypeScript skills and comfort working in a monorepo with shared, versioned internal packages.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP equivalents considered) — messaging/queues, object storage, secrets management.
  • Experience implementing or integrating OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication, ideally with enterprise identity providers (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID or similar).
  • Strong automated testing discipline: unit, integration, and contract testing on both back end and front end.
  • Comfortable working across the full stack without hand-offs — from database schema to API to UI.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working in a small, senior, high-autonomy engineering team.

jobs.title: Director of Data Analytics & Outcomes Research
jobs.excerpt: About Us:The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected.
jobs.description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

Nadia Care is seeking an experienced Director of Data Analytics & Outcomes Research to build and lead the function that turns our data into conviction — conviction about what actually drives member retention and clinical outcomes, and conviction our payer clients can act on.

This person will own analytics from data architecture through outcomes measurement to client-facing reporting. This role partners closely with Engineering on technical implementation and with Product on how reporting and outcomes work is delivered to end users.

You will lead a small, growing team (data science, data analytics, and health economics/outcomes research) and will be accountable for turning their output into decisions the business and our clients can act on — not just dashboards and reports.

You are fluent in AI as a practitioner.

Responsibilities

Lead analytics team on data architecture, integration, analyses and reporting:

  • Data architecture: define the conceptual structure of our data — entity relationships, table design, and key attributes, and reporting structure
  • Outcomes measurement: build and maintain the analytical framework that identifies what is driving clinical outcomes, retention and Nadia Care’s ROI model for payers, and translate it into recommendations the business can act on.
  • Health economics and outcomes research (HEOR): produce the clinical and cost evidence that demonstrates program value to payer clients and members.
  • Analyses, inquiries, accuracy: ensure all data analyses are accurate, consistent, and repeatable across contracts/markets.
  • Governance: define metric definitions, data limitations, and guardrails that keep dashboards and reporting consistent across the organization.
  • Collaborative People Leader: Build, manage, and develop a team of data scientists, analysts, and outcomes research specialists. A key member of the Senior Leadership Team with influence and collaboration goals across the organization.

Qualifications

  • 8-12+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, or health economics/outcomes research, including people management experience leading a data team.
  • Expert level experience with a mix of statistical tools for economic and statistical analyses, presentation and visualization including R, Python, SQL, SAS, Excel or Google Sheets and Tableau
  • Prior experience at a healthcare services company — ideally value-based care, payer-facing, or a company managing outcomes-based contracts .
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data into actionable recommendations — not just descriptive reporting, but a defensible perspective on what to do next.
  • Expertise in data modeling (entity relationships, table layouts, metric definitions), and experience supporting CEO, COO, and other executive leaders in a health care services company with experience partnering closely with engineering teams on technical implementation.
  • Expert in health economics, statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology comparative effectiveness, or real-world evidence methodology
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, early-stage, environment with a lean, dynamic team that can develop and pivot when needed
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills — able to represent data and outcomes credibly to internal leadership and external payer stakeholders alike.
  • Own the development of white papers, presentations, and impact briefs that communicate our clinical and cost evidence to payer clients and internal leadership.
  • PhD with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or Master's with 8–12 years, in data analytics, data science, or health economics/outcomes research, including people management experience leading a data team.

Why join us:

Working with us is a chance to build something from the ground up, shape the future of maternal health, and grow with a team that values impact, ownership, and care. As an early team member, you’ll help define how we deliver care and support at scale.

At Nadia Care, we recognize that great talent deserves great rewards. The expected base salary for this position is between $185,000–$195,000 per year, based on years of relevant experience.

For full-time employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally:

Time Off That Works for You

  • Recharge with annual paid holidays off.
  • Full-Time Salaried Employees (Exempt): Enjoy unlimited time off after the 90-day introductory period.
  • Full-Time Hourly Employees (Non-Exempt): Receive three weeks of paid time off after the 90-day introductory period.

Comprehensive Health & Wellness Coverage

  • Medical Insurance: Access top-tier healthcare, covering hospital, surgical, and prescription drug benefits. Coverage begins the first of the following month.
  • Dental Insurance: Coverage for preventive care, as well as basic and major procedures.
  • Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine eye exams and eyeglasses.

Security & Future Planning Options

  • Stock Option Grant: We believe in shared success.
  • Life Insurance: Financial protection for your beneficiaries.
  • Disability Insurance: Short-term and long-term coverage in case of illness or injury.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Opportunity to save for the future.

We’re building something great and want you to be part of it. If you're looking for a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contributions make an impact, apply today!

Remote positions are open to candidates in the contiguous US only. Due to operational and compliance requirements, we are unable to hire candidates residing in ND, AL, HI, PR or outside the contiguous US.

Please note that our recruitment team will only contact candidates via an official company email address ending in @nadiacare.com. Be cautious of scams; Nadia Care will never ask for financial information or payments at any stage of the hiring process.

Alteryx is searching for a Lead Architect, Professional Services - Agentic AI Solutions. This position is remote-friendly.

The Lead Architect, Professional Services - Agentic AI Solutions is a senior technical architect responsible

for guiding complex enterprise AI/ML engagements, leading Agentic AI solution architecture and deployment, and elevating technical excellence across a new Professional Services team focused on AI-driven customer outcomes.


Lead Architects serve as trusted advisors to customers and internal teams, helping organizations move

Agentic AI solutions from strategy and discovery through development, production deployment, governance, and scale. This role will place particular emphasis on Office of Finance use cases and regulated business environments where security, controls, auditability, and reliability are critical.


In addition to leading complex solution design and implementation, Lead Architects mentor other architects, establish reusable patterns and standards, and partner closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and customer executives on strategic AI opportunities.

  • Lead architecture, development, and deployment for complex enterprise Agentic AI solutions, with particular emphasis on Office of Finance use cases and workflows.

  • Lead architecture reviews and technical decision-making across Alteryx Designer, Server, and the Alteryx One enterprise analytics platform, together with cloud AI/ML services, modern data platforms, and enterprise systems of record.
  • Define production-readiness patterns for security, governance, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation, observability, auditability, reliability, cost, and performance.
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for challenging AI architecture scenarios, high-risk engagements, and critical deployment decisions.

  • Engage customer executives, business leaders, and technical stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into practical AI roadmaps and deployment plans.
  • Mentor architects and provide technical guidance on enterprise AI/ML architecture, Agentic AI development, and customer delivery practices.

jobs.description:
Summary

Are you a frontend engineer who treats rendering pipelines, frame budgets, and library API design as a craft? Topstep is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help build a custom charting engine for the TopstepX trading platform — a framework-agnostic library that renders the real-time charts thousands of active traders rely on every day.

The library is organized as overlapping rendering layers — candles, grid, indicators, positions, drawings — most rendered on Canvas 2D. Your work spans the layer system, real-time data plumbing, indicator math, drawing tools, and the public API the rest of the platform builds against. You'll also build and maintain the React binding that adapts the core for the TopstepX web app; a React Native binding will follow as the mobile app matures. A WebGL layer may be added later for higher-density visualizations. The core has no framework dependencies; the bindings are thin wrappers above it.

This role is ideal for someone who has shipped a production charting or visualization library before, understands what it takes to keep an interactive UI smooth while data flows in the background, and has strong opinions on what makes a good API. You'll set the bar for performance, write the abstractions other engineers will consume, and help define what engineering excellence means for this initiative.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build core systems of the charting engine — rendering primitives (layer system, hit testing, dirty-region rendering, text measurement) and domain features (drawing tools, indicator math).
  • Own the framework-agnostic core library architecture, including the public API that React, React Native, and direct consumers integrate against.
  • Build and maintain the React binding — the thin wrapper layer that adapts the core's public API into framework-native components, hooks, and lifecycle integration. The React Native binding follows as the mobile app matures.
  • Drive architectural decisions on canvas compositing, layer strategy, and main-thread vs. worker-thread boundaries.
  • Define and uphold rendering performance standards across the engine — 60fps frame-budget discipline and pointer-interaction responsiveness under continuous data flow.
  • Build the data integration layer that bridges the existing real-time data pipeline into the charting engine.
  • Ensure charting engine is consistent and performant across a wide range of devices, from desktop to tablets to mobile.
  • Establish visual testing standards including pixel diffing, deterministic replay-based tests, and golden-image regression discipline.
  • Lead architectural reviews and RFCs for the charting library, driving consensus on library architecture across the trading platform without direct authority.
  • Mentor engineers on the charting team through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and technical coaching.
  • Balance technical debt with feature delivery based on long-term library health and consumer needs.
  • Communicate technical direction, trade-offs, and risk clearly to engineering peers and platform leadership.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

  • 8 + years of frontend engineering experience building and shipping production systems.
  • Prior experience building or contributing to a production charting library, data visualization framework, or comparable interactive rendering system.
  • Working knowledge of financial markets — OHLCV, tick data, and futures conventions — sufficient to make informed product and architectural trade-offs.
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript including strict mode, advanced generics, and designing public APIs that other engineers consume.
  • Deep proficiency in React, including production experience designing component libraries, hooks APIs, or framework binding layers.
  • Production experience with frontend graphics rendering, particularly Canvas 2D — multi-layer compositing, dirty-region rendering, and text metrics.
  • Demonstrated performance discipline for 60fps real-time rendering — Chrome profiler fluency, frame-budget analysis, and the ability to keep pointer-driven interactions smooth while data flows continuously in the background.
  • Production experience with Web Workers and SharedArrayBuffer — zero-copy data pipelines, typed-array views over shared memory, Atomics for generation counters, and off-main-thread compute architecture.
  • 2D math fluency — coordinate transforms, viewport projection, and hit testing.
  • Track record of architecting libraries with public APIs that consumers integrate against without leaking implementation details.
  • Discipline around visual testing — pixel diffing, deterministic replay-based tests, and willingness to write and maintain them.
  • Proven ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct authority.

Nice to Have

  • Production experience with real-time streaming systems — WebSocket lifecycle, backpressure, reconnection, and replay.
  • React Native, react-native-skia, expo-gl, or JSI experience.
  • Order flow and market microstructure knowledge — footprint charts, volume profile, DOM, cumulative delta.
  • MessagePack or protobuf experience for binary serialization on the data pipeline.
  • WebGL2 experience — for a possible future high-density rendering layer.
  • WebGPU / WGSL experience (long-term migration target).
  • Rust + WASM experience (the indicator compute layer is the most likely candidate for a Rust rewrite).
  • PineScript or other charting DSL familiarity (for transpiler/runtime work in a later phase).
  • Open source contributions to graphics, charting, or financial libraries.

Company Culture & Perks

  • Topstep is an engaging working environment which ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration with cameras on during meetings and a robust Slack environment for communication.

What you will do


The Senior Associate, Neurology Medical Marketing - Operations & Programs will provide operational coordination and executional support across the U.S. Neurology Medical Marketing organization, including the Opinion Leader Engagement & Peer-to-Peer and Insights & Congress Strategy sleeves. Reporting to the Neuro Medical Marketing Lead, this individual will convert strategic priorities into clear project plans, reliable operating rhythms, accurate trackers, and well-prepared teams across gMG and NMOSD.

The Senior Associate will work closely with Senior Manager and Manager leaders, HCP Operations, agencies, and cross-functional partners to support congresses, Speaker Bureau and P2P programs, advisory boards, field insights, budgets, and team operations. The role will own defined operational workstreams and receive structured stretch opportunities to build broader marketing judgment, customer understanding, and strategic capability.

Strengthen Medical Marketing Operations

Support Congress Planning and Execution

Enable Speaker Bureau and P2P Program Readiness

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

To manage and oversee regulatory reporting activities for the bank for UAE / overseas branch jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable regulatory standards. The role is responsible for maintaining a strong control environment around regulatory submissions, driving issue resolution, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and supporting strategic regulatory and reporting initiatives. The role also supports automation, digitization, data transformation, and AI-enabled initiatives aimed at enhancing reporting efficiency, scalability, data quality, and governance across the regulatory reporting function.

Key Result Areas

Manage preparation, review, and submission of regulatory reports for UAE / overseas branches / SCA / DFSA / Subsidiaries / Islamic banking within prescribed timelines, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Manage reporting related to Basel regulatory requirements including Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR), Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), Leverage Ratio, large exposure reporting, and other prudential and statistical returns.

Ensure compliance with Central Bank regulations, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.

Maintain a strong control environment around regulatory reporting processes, including reconciliations, validations, data quality checks, governance controls, and supporting documentation.

Coordinate with Finance, Risk, Treasury, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and overseas branch teams to ensure integrity and consistency of regulatory reporting data.

Monitor and assess impact of new regulatory requirements, business changes, and financial transactions on regulatory reporting obligations.

Drive timely resolution of reporting issues, reconciliation breaks, data inconsistencies, regulatory queries, and audit observations.

Support Central Bank examinations, regulatory reviews, internal audits, and external audits by coordinating responses, providing reporting analysis, and ensuring timely closure of observations and action items.

Review and enhance reporting methodologies, assumptions, mapping logic, and reporting processes to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations and best practices.

Lead and support automation, digitization, and AI-enabled initiatives aimed at improving reporting efficiency, scalability, controls, and data quality.

Support implementation and enhancement of regulatory reporting systems, dashboards, reconciliation tools, and data governance frameworks.

Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and strengthening of reporting governance across UAE and overseas reporting environments.

Provide reporting analysis, insights, and updates to senior management and relevant governance forums.

Contribute to regulatory reporting transformation initiatives and continuous improvement programs across the bank.

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

Operates within a highly regulated banking environment with responsibility for ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant regulatory reporting across UAE and overseas jurisdictions. The role functions within established regulatory frameworks, governance standards, delegated authorities, internal control requirements, and bank policies while supporting a strong control environment around regulatory submissions, reconciliations, issue resolution, and data governance.

The role requires close coordination with Finance, Risk, Treasury, Operations, Compliance, Technology, Data Governance, Internal Audit, overseas branches, regulators, and external auditors to manage reporting obligations, regulatory queries, system enhancements, automation, digitization, and AI-enabled reporting initiatives. The position is expected to exercise sound professional judgment, manage competing priorities under tight timelines, identify process improvement opportunities, and contribute to strengthening reporting governance, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance across the bank.

Problem Solving

Investigate and resolve complex reporting issues, reconciliation breaks, data inconsistencies, and regulatory interpretation matters.

Analyze root causes of reporting variances and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Assess impact of new products, transactions, regulatory updates, and organizational changes on reporting obligations.

Evaluate process inefficiencies and recommend control enhancements and technology-driven solutions.

Escalate material reporting issues and regulatory risks appropriately while proposing practical remediation plans.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance reporting accuracy, controls, operational resilience, and process efficiency.

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

Review and approve regulatory reporting outputs prior to submission in line with delegated authority.

Exercise judgment on reporting interpretations, materiality assessments, control exceptions, and issue escalation.

Recommend enhancements to reporting frameworks, governance standards, controls, automation opportunities, and reporting processes.

Coordinate prioritization of reporting deliverables, issue resolution, regulatory commitments, and transformation initiatives.

Support senior management in managing regulatory reporting risk, governance, and compliance obligations.

Act as a key point of contact for regulatory reporting matters across relevant jurisdictions.

Contribute to strategic decisions relating to reporting transformation, automation, digitization, AI adoption, and process optimization initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Chartered Accountant with 13 -15 years of relevant banking experience, preferably within regulatory reporting, finance control, financial reporting, or banking finance functions.

Experience dealing with regulators, auditors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Experience in large banking environments with complex reporting structures and regulatory requirements.

Knowledge of prudential regulations, capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, and regulatory governance.

Understanding of banking products, treasury activities, risk concepts, and financial control processes.

Exposure to reporting automation, data transformation, analytics, or AI-enabled reporting environments is preferred.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to interpret regulations and translate requirements into reporting processes and system requirements.

Strong attention to detail with a control-oriented mindset.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight regulatory timelines.

jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

AlphaSense is seeking an exceptional engineer to own our Excel plugin strategy, bringing the power of AI-driven market intelligence directly into the workflow of financial professionals worldwide. You'll build the bridge between our cutting-edge AI platform and the tool that millions of analysts, investors, and researchers use every day – Microsoft Excel.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of enterprise desktop development, financial technology, and AI. You'll create experiences that feel magical to users – imagine Excel formulas that can query 1.6 billion documents, or financial models that update with real-time market intelligence. Your work will directly impact how the world's leading financial institutions make critical decisions.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years building production software, with significant experience in desktop applications or Office add-ins
  • Deep expertise in C#, .NET and modern development practices
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, state management, and event-driven architectures
  • Experience with enterprise software deployment, updates, and version management
  • Track record of building performant applications with excellent error handling and recovery
  • Excellence in debugging complex integration issues and memory/performance optimization
  • Strong testing philosophy adapted to desktop environments
  • Ability to mentor teams and establish development best practices

Preferred:

  • Production experience with C#, VSTO, or COM add-ins
  • Knowledge of Excel's calculation engine, object model, and common power-user patterns
  • Knowledge of AWS
  • Understanding of financial modeling, data analysis workflows, or trading systems
  • Experience with web development technologies
  • Familiarity with financial data formats (XLSX, CSV, JSON) and transformations
  • Background in building offline-capable applications with sync mechanisms
  • Experience with WebSocket, real-time data feeds, or streaming architectures

Technical Environment

  • Visual Studio & Visual Studio Tools for Office (VSTO)
  • REST APIs and WebSocket connections to AlphaSense platform
  • Complex state management between local and cloud data
  • Enterprise authentication (SSO, OAuth, SAML)
  • Cross-platform support (Windows and Mac)
  • AWS

What You'll Do

  • Architect the Excel Experience: Design and build a production-grade Excel plugin that seamlessly integrates AlphaSense's AI capabilities while respecting Excel's performance and stability requirements
  • Master Complex Integration: Navigate Excel's object model, calculation engine, and event system to create features that feel native while accessing cloud-based intelligence
  • Ensure Enterprise Excellence: Build plugins that work flawlessly across Excel 2016, 2019, and Office 365, handling corporate proxies, SSO, offline scenarios, and IT restrictions
  • Optimize Ruthlessly: Make complex operations feel instantaneous, managing memory carefully and ensuring our plugin never slows down Excel
  • Bridge Worlds: Translate between financial users' needs and technical possibilities, creating intuitive interfaces for sophisticated AI capabilities
  • Establish Best Practices: Define patterns for desktop development excellence, mentoring the team on testing, deployment, and monitoring strategies for Office plugins

You'll fundamentally change how AlphaSense's own equity research analysts turn raw market data into finished financial models. Our internal Excel add-in is how every analyst builds, updates, and validates company models without ever leaving Excel. Within your first year, you'll ship improvements used daily across our entire internal research org, migrating the tool off legacy infrastructure onto AlphaSense's own platform and making powerful research workflows as simple as typing a formula. You'll eliminate the context-switching between Excel and outside data sources, saving analysts hours daily while improving the quality of every model that ultimately powers the platform our clients rely on.

More importantly, you'll establish the technical foundation and best practices that will guide our Office integration strategy for years. You'll mentor a team of engineers in the unique challenges of desktop development, raising the bar for quality and performance in an environment where every millisecond matters.

Why This Role is Unique

This isn't just another plugin development role. You'll be working with:

  • Cutting-edge AI capabilities that need to feel simple in Excel
  • Financial professionals who depend on Excel for critical decisions
  • Complex technical constraints that require creative solutions
  • A team eager to learn desktop development best practices

You'll need to think like a financial analyst, architect like a distributed systems engineer, and optimize like a game developer. It's a rare opportunity to work on deeply technical challenges while directly impacting how the financial world operates.

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

$132,000—$181,700 CAD

  • Review application projects our development teams build.   • Own new projects for advancing security in our environment. Be the deep technical expert and collaborate with others on the teams to ensure project success. Your impact here cannot be understated, you are a core contributor and have deep influence to empower Datavant greatness

What You Need to Succeed

  • You are heavily focused on delivery and being impactful; Understand how to operate and succeed in a very fast-paced environment where the security team should be a partner and enabler for the engineering team rather than a blocker
  • We lean deeply into individuals who have experience and have practical knowledge of applying standards in low friction ways
  • Broad scoped projects don’t scare you, they energize you. However, you like to get things done fast (and help others) with limited dependencies

役割と責任 🛠️🧪✨

  • 自身のタスクを見積もり、期限内に完遂する

  • 関連する全ての経験を活用し、設計と実装における問題を予見するコードレビュー分析を行う

jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer with deep expertise in .NET and C# to design and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services for enterprise platforms.

This role focuses on domain-driven service design, API and integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and building highly observable systems. You will work closely with product managers, architects, and engineers in an Agile environment to solve complex business problems and deliver reliable, evolvable services on cloud platforms.

You will also champion modern engineering practices such as automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and AI-assisted development to improve quality, delivery speed, and developer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, build, and evolve robust and maintainable backend services using .NET / C#
  • Model complex business domains and design data structures that support change over time
  • Define clear service boundaries, API contracts, and integration patterns
  • Contribute to shared backend architecture, standards, and reusable patterns
  • Evaluate trade-offs between performance, consistency, scalability, and delivery speed

Integration & Event-Driven Solutions

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs with proper versioning, error handling, and contract validation
  • Implement asynchronous messaging and event-driven patterns for reliable and decoupled integrations
  • Design events that reflect meaningful business state changes
  • Support both synchronous and asynchronous service communication

Software Quality & Testing

  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code
  • Implement unit, integration, and contract testing
  • Build fast, reliable automated regression test suites
  • Contribute to test data strategies and quality standards

DevOps, Cloud & Observability

  • Work with automated CI/CD pipelines for build, test, security scanning, deployment, and rollback
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code and environment automation where applicable
  • Deploy and operate services in a cloud environment (Azure or similar)
  • Design and maintain logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term fixes for production issues

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work in a distributed Agile/Scrum team across multiple time zones
  • Analyze requirements, identify risks and dependencies, and propose technical solutions
  • Participate in architecture and code reviews
  • Maintain clear and accurate technical documentation
  • Contribute to engineering process and tooling improvements

AI & Developer Productivity

  • Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly for code generation, refactoring, testing, and documentation
  • Help define effective team practices for adopting AI in the development lifecycle

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience

Experience

  • Demonstrated senior-level capability in backend software engineering using .NET
  • Strong experience in system integration, messaging, and event-driven architectures

Core Technical Skills

  • Deep hands-on experience with .NET / C# backend development
  • Strong understanding of clean, layered, or hexagonal architecture styles
  • Advanced domain and data modelling skills
  • Experience designing and implementing REST APIs and service contracts
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging, pub/sub, and event-driven systems
  • Strong automated testing experience (unit, integration, contract testing)
  • CI/CD pipeline implementation and optimization
  • Infrastructure-as-code and containerized development (e.g., Docker)
  • Cloud platform experience (Azure or similar)
  • Observability and monitoring (logs, metrics, tracing, dashboards)
  • Performance, scalability, and resilience design

Ways of Working & Soft Skills

  • Strong systems thinking and complex problem-solving capability
  • Excellent communication skills in English for technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to collaborate across teams, cultures, and time zones
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Mentoring mindset and strong teamwork skills
  • Continuous improvement and innovation focus

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Financial Services or other highly regulated domains

What You’ll Gain

  • Opportunity to design and build enterprise-grade, cloud-native backend platforms
  • Work with modern architecture, integration, and observability practices
  • Collaborative, high-performing distributed engineering environment

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About the Role

The Professional Services team at Fivetran is growing and you can join a function that is building from the ground up. The approaches, methodologies, working practices and team culture that we put in place now will be the template for what is to come, so if you are excited about having a hand in steering the approach of a critical function within the organization, then this may be the role for you!

As a Principal Solution Architect at Fivetran Professional Services, you will play a pivotal role in guiding our most strategic, complex, and high-impact customer engagements across the modern data ecosystem — with a strong focus on Data Lakes, Transformations, and extended Modern Data Architectures.
You will serve as a technical thought leader and trusted advisor, shaping our customers’ data integration and AI journeys, while also mentoring fellow architects and influencing Fivetran’s product and delivery evolution.

You will lead by example — defining architectural standards, developing reusable frameworks, and ensuring delivery excellence across engagements. As a trusted partner to Fortune 500 and high-growth customers, you’ll work directly with executive and technical stakeholders to architect secure, scalable, and high-performance data integration frameworks that drive time-to-value and business outcomes.
You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success to influence roadmap direction, drive innovation, and enable field and customer teams through scalable technical enablement programs.

This is a full-time position based remotely in the US.

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Fivetran Data Integration Products:

  • Databases (Source Target Systems):

  • Cloud Data Warehouses Lakehouses:

  • Cloud Object Storage Data Lakes:

    • Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Google Cloud Storage (GCS)

    • Modern open table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake

  • Cloud Platforms Infrastructure:

    • Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure

  • Operating Systems:

    • Linux and Unix-based systems, Windows Server environments

  • Containerization Orchestration:

    • Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, Helm

  • Modern Data Transformation, Orchestration, and Activation:

  • Developer, Scripting Infrastructure Tools:

    • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

    • CI/CD tooling experience is a plus

  • Security, Secrets Governance (Optional but Valued):

    • Vault, AWS KMS, and enterprise IAM integrations (optional, relevant for sensitive deployments)

What You’ll Do

As a key leader of our customer-facing team, you’ll be directly leading the customer implementation journey successfully and optimize Fivetran products across various data environments. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead Enterprise Architectures: Design and deliver complex, enterprise-grade data integration and transformation architectures across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments.

  • Drive Customer Success: Partner with senior customer stakeholders to define business objectives, translate them into scalable technical designs, and drive measurable business value.

  • Scale the Field: Develop and maintain reference architectures, delivery frameworks, and internal training assets that uplift the PS organization and enable efficient scaling.

  • Mentor Guide: Serve as a mentor and coach to architects and consultants, uplifting team skills in advanced data replication, hybrid deployments, and lakehouse integrations.

  • Engage Cross-Functionally: Partner with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap decisions, and guide enterprise customers through the rollout of new features and deployment models.

  • Thought Leadership: Represent Fivetran in customer workshops, partner discussions, and executive briefings — contributing to our industry presence as a strategic advisor.

  • Innovation AI Readiness: Lead engagements that help customers prepare for AI workloads (LLMs, ML pipelines), advising on best practices for data quality, lineage, and compliance.

  • Customer Enablement: Produce enablement assets and lead sessions that help customers adopt new architectures confidently — ensuring long-term success and self-sufficiency.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, solution engineering, or consulting leadership, with specialization in modern data integration platforms, data lakes, transformation pipelines, and large-scale implementation programs.

  • Deep technical fluency with the modern data stack, including data ingestion tools, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt, SQLMesh, Prefect), and observability or metadata catalog solutions.

  • Demonstrated expertise in enterprise replication from transactional databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, SAP) into analytical or data lake platforms — with experience designing and tuning log-based replication, schema mapping, and network/security controls within customer-managed environments.

  • Practical implementation experience with open table formats like Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg, including schema evolution, time travel, compaction strategies, file pruning, and optimization for cost-effective, high-performance analytics.

  • Strong command of containerized environments, Linux-based deployments, and infrastructure orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Vault, KMS), particularly in customer-managed deployment architectures.

  • Proven ability to architect solutions at scale—leading end-to-end design for large enterprise clients, optimizing ingestion and transformation flows, driving data governance alignment, and ensuring platform reliability and scalability.

  • Highly proficient in SQL and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell — with the ability to build automation frameworks, troubleshoot deployments, and guide teams in operational hand-offs and best practices.

  • Experience producing internal frameworks, reusable assets, and technical enablement collateral for onboarding, delivery excellence, and team-wide knowledge sharing.

  • Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional collaboration — working with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Engineering stakeholders to influence roadmap priorities, surface customer feedback, and drive delivery quality.

  • Ability to engage executive stakeholders and technical sponsors to articulate architectural trade-offs, business value, and ROI in complex enterprise environments.

  • Experience working with Fortune 500 or high-growth enterprise customers, including those undergoing data modernization, cloud migration, or building AI/ML-enabled pipelines on open lakehouse architectures.

  • Passion for mentoring solution architects, sharing architectural vision, and enabling delivery teams through direct coaching, scalable documentation, and strategic advisory input.

Reporting to the Head of Legal Operations and working closely with the full Legal & Compliance and Legal Operations teams, this role serves as the department's primary technical builder, developing AI-powered solutions, workflow automations, integrations, applications, and reporting capabilities that enable modern legal service delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with an understanding of legal processes and a passion for leveraging emerging technologies to solve business problems. This individual thrives in a hands-on environment and enjoys rapidly translating ideas into practical solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Systems Integration & Data Engineering

  • Develop API-based connections and data flows between applications.
  • Establish a modern legal data and knowledge infrastructure to improve accessibility, searchability, and decision-making.
  • Support data migration, transformation, validation, and synchronization efforts.
  • Design and maintain structured data models that enable automation, reporting, and AI capabilities.

Technical Enablement & User Support

  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for legal technology users.
  • Develop user documentation, technical documentation, and training materials.
  • Assist with implementation and launch of new technologies and automation solutions.
  • Gather user feedback and translate enhancement requests into future development initiatives.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Create visualizations and reporting tools that support data-driven decision making.
  • Analyze usage patterns and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Circana Behavior
