jobs.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we’ve spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we’re now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We’re at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We’re growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you’re energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer to help set the technical direction of Alti, our AI agent product. Alti launched in July 2026 and has moved past MVP. The next step is scaling it into a core product of our platform: more agents, more automated routines, and our own machine learning models alongside LLMs.

You’re a product engineer who has built AI features in production and can raise the bar for the whole squad. You’ll own technical decisions across Alti, define how we evaluate and monitor AI features, and become a reference for AI across our product teams. This is a technical leadership role, not a people management role.

This is a remote position based in Brazil.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical direction of Alti features, from conversational AI to agents and automated routines.

  • Define the standards for LLM evaluation, prompt management, monitoring and observability.

  • Lead the design of RAG pipelines and agent architectures, and make the trade-off calls.

  • Drive the move from LLM-only features to proprietary ML models, including taking them to production with monitoring and continuous feedback.

  • Identify new ML use cases across the AP platform (e.g., invoice payment prediction) and shape them with Product.

  • Act as a reference for AI inside the product org: review designs, pair with engineers and share practices.

  • Keep shipping hands-on: this role writes code every week.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience as a software engineer, with a track record of owning technical decisions on product features end to end.

  • Hands-on work on AI products in the last 12 months (LLMs, agents, AI features), with ownership of meaningful parts of the system.

  • Experience with chatbots/conversational AI, RAG and LLM evaluation pipelines.

  • Strong skills in at least one of Go, TypeScript/JavaScript or Python.

  • Autonomy to define a process in a new area, not only execute one.

  • A product mindset: you care about what gets delivered to users, not only the model.

  • Comfort in a fast-paced environment where you own many parts of the delivery chain.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience putting ML models into production with monitoring and feedback loops.

  • AI monitoring and observability tooling.

  • Prompt engineering experience.

  • Autonomous or personal agents working across channels (Slack, Teams, WhatsApp).

  • Background in fintech, payments or financial products.

  • Experience at both an early-stage startup (Seed to Series B) and a larger tech company.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

  • The total compensation range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, and education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you need any accommodations during your application or interview experience, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

jobs.excerpt: Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back.
jobs.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

What We’re Looking For

We're seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our mission of revolutionizing payments for service-based companies by building the robust, scalable infrastructure that powers our accounts receivable automation platform.

You’ll join our Product Expansion team, which owns two of our core products: Accounts Payable, where we’re currently building multi-use virtual cards, and Analytics.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on architecting and developing core backend services, design event-driven data pipelines, and ensuring the reliability and performance of systems that process critical financial transactions for our clients.

Working closely with Product and Operations teams, you'll leverage your expertise in Go (or other similar language) and distributed systems to deliver high-quality features rapidly while maintaining the transparency, dependability, and partnership values that define Alternative Payments.

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on how businesses manage their payment processes, contributing to a platform that reduces costs and complexity for companies while working alongside a global, diverse and collaborative team.

This role is available to candidates who are eligible to work in Brazil, fully remote.

What You’ll Do

  • Build backend services: Develop and maintain core services that handle data processing, transformations, and business logic.

  • Design event-driven pipelines: Craft idempotent, queue-based workflows (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.) to process messages without duplication.

  • Write clean, maintainable code: Author services in Go (or a similar language) and SQL (Postgres or equivalent), following clear coding standards and review practices.

  • Drive quality & reliability: Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; instrument metrics (throughput, latency, error rates) and alerts; rapidly diagnose and resolve issues.

  • Collaborate & iterate: Partner with Product and Operations to deliver features quickly; pair with teammates to share knowledge and continuously refine our tooling and processes.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong in Go (or comparable backend language) and SQL (Postgres or equivalent).

  • Experience working on payment platforms or with payments/financial transactions.

  • Comfortable with event buses/queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).

  • Solid testing discipline: unit, integration and end-to-end.

  • Familiarity with Git workflows, code reviews and CI/CD pipelines.

  • 4–7 years in professional software development, with senior-level responsibilities.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Data lake or analytics engineering experience (ClickHouse, dbt, Dagster, Spark/Databricks, Snowflake or similar).

  • Experience working on analytics products.

  • Frontend experience with TypeScript.

  • Prior work on financial/data reconciliation.

  • Hands-on experience integrating with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Netsuite or similar APIs

  • Understanding of accounting principles (e.g. double-entry).

  • Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana).

  • Basic compliance/security exposure (encryption, audit trails).

  • Track record of mentoring, leading projects, or driving organizational improvements.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, dynamic, and high-impact environments.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

  • The total compensation range for this role is $90,000 - $105,000, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, and education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.

  • Resourcefulness: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You Will Build

  • Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

  • Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

  • Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

  • Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

  • Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

What We Look For

  • Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

  • Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

  • Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

  • Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

  • Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

  • Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

  • People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

  • Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role:

Lyra is looking for an exceptional Sr. Software Engineer to accelerate how Lyra itself works. We care deeply about making a difference in people's lives and hope you do too! Our goal? To embed AI into the daily workflows of teams across the company, from engineering and operations to clinical support functions, so that Lyrians spend less time on repetitive work and more time on what matters: getting people the mental health care they need.

This is not a platform team role at arm's length from its users. You will embed directly with internal teams, sit with them to understand how work actually gets done, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and then design, build, ship, and iterate on AI-powered solutions in production. You own outcomes, not just code: adoption and measurable efficiency gains are the finish line, not the deploy.

We care deeply about making a difference in people’s lives and hope you do too!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Role Overview

This position sits within the Media Data Scientist Team and focuses on product Development. The key objective is to develop data science code, supporting Circana’s Media & Product Innovation practices. You will support data science aspects of the end to end media product development cycle. This includes exploratory data analysis, developing and implementing the end-to-end modeling platform, statistical methodology development and empirical experiment design. You will also work with big databases from different sources and assemble them into analysis and insights exploration ready format.

Job Responsibilities

  • Apply and design best-in-class methodologies and statistical algorithms to answer business questions.
  • Build and maintain modeling engines for Circana analytics platforms using various tools, such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
  • Utilize advanced computations/statistics and machine learning/AI methodologies.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (e.g., Technology, Product, Commercial, etc.) to build analytical solutions for some of the largest retailers and manufacturers in the world, utilizing granular data at scale.
  • Work directly with clients including the top advertising platforms to gather detailed requirements and communicate results.
  • Document and present methodologies and research findings to internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage and mentor junior data scientists, guide them in problem-solving and help them develop their technical skills.

Requirements

  • Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Econometrics or related quantitative field; Masters or PhD preferred
  • 6+ years’ experience of Python/R development. Strong proficiency for statistical analysis, data visualization, and statistical modeling. Familiarity with packages like Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib in Python, dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr in R.
  • SQL: Ability to write complex queries, perform joins, aggregations, subqueries, window functions, and optimize queries for performance.
  • Data extraction and manipulation: Skill in retrieving and integrating data from multiple sources and formats.
  • Deep understanding of statistical concepts, including descriptive statistics, inferential statistics, hypothesis testing (t-tests, ANOVA, chi-squared), regression analysis (linear, logistic), time series analysis, A/B testing.
  • Solid understanding of various Machine Learning and AI algorithms
  • Able to build and convey impactful insights drawing from multiple data sources. Skilled at explaining technical subject matter to non-technical audiences.
  • Nice to have: Previous experience in Marketing Mix Modeling and other Media measurement techniques.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.
